title: YouSee søger kunderådgivere til vores kundecenter i Aarhus
description:
Bliv den, kunderne ringer til, når teknikken driller – og gå fra “det virker ikke” til “tak, det spillede bare” 💪

Hos YouSee søger vi dig, der bevarer overblikket, når en kunde er frustreret, og som trives med at finde løsninger, skabe ro og identificere den rette løsning, når behovet opstår.

Det her er ikke bare et klassisk callcenterjob.

Du bliver en del af en hverdag med indgående opkald, teknisk problemløsning, kundeservice og behovsbaseret salg. Du hjælper kunder med tv, internet og mobil – og du vejleder dem videre, når den rigtige løsning også indebærer, at de skal opgradere, samle eller tilpasse deres produkter.

Er du til fart over feltet, tydelige mål, tæt samarbejde og masser af ny viden, kan dette være en god mulighed for dig.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

  • at tage imod indgående opkald fra kunder, der har brug for hjælp
  • at fejlfinde og rådgive om tv, internet og mobil
  • at skabe ro og overblik i samtaler, hvor kunden måske starter frustreret
  • at behovsafdække og anbefale relevante løsninger, når det giver mening for kunden
  • at levere både god kundeservice og gode salgsdialoger – i samme samtale

Skal jeg også sælge som kunderådgiver? 😊

Det korte svar er, JA!

At afdække behov er en vigtig del af arbejdet med at skabe en god oplevelse for kunden. Du skal være nysgerrige på de løsninger, som kunderne allerede har hos os, og de muligheder, de får ved at samle hele husstandens løsning hos YouSee.

Du har ansvar for at tage disse nysgerrige dialoger, da kundernes behov ændrer sig med tiden, og vi i YouSee løbende tilpasser vores produktportefølje til fordel for kunderne.

Et performance-miljø – med støtte, sparring og retning

Du kommer ind i en hverdag, hvor der er fokus på mål og udvikling.

Det betyder, at vi følger med i, hvordan det går – både på kundetilfredshed, struktur og salg. I de interne materialer beskrives rollen som en del af en KPI-baseret hverdag, hvor salg fylder lige så meget som kundeservice, og hvor behovsafdækning skal være en del af hvert kald.

Det er vigtigt for os at sige det tydeligt, fordi det også er her, nogle enten trives virkelig godt – eller finder ud af, at jobbet ikke er det rigtige match.

⭐ Jobbet passer til dig, hvis du ⭐

  • motiveres af tydelige mål
  • gerne vil blive bedre og få feedback
  • har overskud til at navigere i en travl hverdag
  • ser performance som noget, der skaber udvikling – ikke bare pres
  • kan lide at tale med mennesker og skabe tillid hurtigt
  • har overskud og ro i stemmen – også når kunden ikke har det
  • finder teknik spændende og er åben for at tilegne sig ny viden
  • er motiveret for at sælge og kan se værdien i at rådgive professionelt
  • trives i en struktureret hverdag med klare mål og mange opgaver
  • tager ansvar for din egen udvikling

Hvorfor søge?

Fordi det her job kan mere end bare være et job.

  • en stejl læringskurve
  • gode kollegaer- og venner
  • erfaring med kundedialog, teknik og salg
  • en hverdag, hvor du bygger robuste færdigheder hurtigt
  • mulighed for at udvikle dig videre internt

Kulturen

I vores teams er der fokus på god trivsel, teamwork og på din udvikling. Vi prioriterer tid til læring og arbejder med at løfte vores færdigheder sammen! Vi stiller krav til hinanden og arbejder struktureret i et uformelt miljø.

På @yousee_inside deler vi glimt fra hverdagen, kollegerne, kulturen og de små øjeblikke, der gør YouSee til et godt sted at være.

youSee inside Informationsfolder

HUSK:

  • “Vi hjælper hinanden på gulvet”
  • “Der er altid en kollega eller teamleder tæt på”
  • Vi fejrer resultater – både små og store
  • Vi står samlet og bidrager hver især
  • ”Vi har altid kunden i centrum”

Du tilbydes 👇

  • Fast timeløn på 143,40 og weekendstillæg (Lørdag 32,12 kr og søndag 64,48 kr)
  • Individuel provisionsordning
  • Pensionsordning, fritvalgskonto (10%) og PFA sundhedsordning
  • Rabat på bredbånd, tv og mobilabonnementer
  • Konkurrencer, som gør hverdagen lidt sjovere
  • Sociale arrangementer

Godt at vide 💡

  • Fuldtid - Du får gennemsnitlig 37 timer i ugen
  • Åbningstiderne er således; Alle hverdage fra kl. 8.00-18.00. Weekend fra kl. 9.00-18.00

title: Shipping Specialist
description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

About GenScript

Founded in 2002 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2015, GenScript has an established global presence across Greater China, North America, the EU, and Asia Pacific. Today, over 300,000 customers from over 160 countries and regions around the world have used GenScript’s premier, convenient, and reliable products and services. GenScript currently has more than 3900 employees globally, 36% of whom hold master’s and/or Ph.D. degrees. In addition, GenScript has a number of leading commercial technologies developed in the fields of synthetic biology, immunotherapy, antibody design, chemical synthesis and bioinformatics, including more than 140 patents and over 450 patent applications. As of 2020, GenScript's products and services have been cited by over 40,300 scientific papers worldwide. GenScript is committed to striving towards its vision of being the most reliable biotech company in the world to make humans and nature healthier through biotechnology.

Position: Shipping Specialist

Location: Singapore

Report to: AP Regional Logistics Manager

Position Summary

GenScript Singapore is seeking a Shipping Specialist to oversee both the physical shipment process and customs compliance for imports and exports.

Key Responsibilities:

Regulatory Compliance and Updates

  • Stay up-to-date with changes in customs laws and regulations, advising internal teams on any impact to operations.
  • Conduct regular audits of shipping and customs procedures, implementing corrective actions when necessary to maintain compliance.

Customs Documentation and Compliance

  • Perform tariff classification and ensure correct customs documentation for all imports and exports.
  • Submit necessary import/export permits via TradeNet/Crimsonlogic and liaise with customs brokers to ensure timely and accurate customs clearance.
  • Manage the application of Strategic Goods permits for dual-use products.

Shipment Handling and Packaging

  • Ensure all incoming and outgoing shipments are properly packaged, labelled, and ready for dispatch according to company and regulatory standards.
  • Coordinate with warehouse staff to manage the physical handling of goods, ensuring safe and secure packaging of products.

Collaboration with Internal and External Teams

  • Work closely with logistics, finance, and other departments to ensure smooth operations and compliance with customs requirements.
  • Collaborate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and other third-party service providers to ensure accurate and timely processing of shipments.

Shipping Tracking and Monitoring

  • Track all shipments from initiation to delivery, resolving any issues or delays promptly.
  • Ensure proper record-keeping of shipping documentation and GST permits for monthly submissions and claims.

Customs-related Audits and Record Keeping

  • Maintain accurate and updated records of all customs-related activities and documentation, ensuring proper audit trails.
  • Perform regular internal audits to identify areas of improvement in customs processes and work on corrective actions.

Cost Management

  • Review of freight cost, packing material cost and all cost related to Logistic
  • Cost tracking, Uploading and Analysis
  • Vendor Billing Management
  • Freight cost uploading into system

Ad-hoc Tasks

  • Any other tasks or project assigned by superior

Qualifications

  • Degree with major in Supply Chain or other Business-related studies
  • Having SC401 customs declarant certification is a plus
  • 3-5 years of experience in shipping, logistics, and customs affairs or related fields, are considered.
  • Experience working with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and third-party logistics providers is preferred.
  • Experience in handling import/export shipments, packaging, and customs clearance.
  • Familiarity with TradeNet/Crimsonlogic platforms for permit applications.
  • Demonstrated strong communication and negotiation skills, with solid data analysis capabilities to support decision-making.
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-border teams, particularly with stakeholders in China.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), with strong capability in data handling, reporting, and presentation.
  • A collaborative team player with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset; adaptable to dynamic environments and willing to take on additional responsibilities or role rotations.
  • Open to continuous learning and capable of adopting advanced technologies and practices, including AI, automation, compliance frameworks, and customs regulations.

Benefits:

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well-being initiatives, and peer-to-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work.

  • Ability to stay organized and maintain a clean, safe environment

title: Building Safety Monitor
location: 9550 Blue Ridge Blvd - Kansas City, MO 64134
description:
Make a Difference as a Building Safety Monitor with ReDiscover

Join ReDiscover’s Safety & Security Department and be part of a mission-driven organization that’s been transforming lives for over 50 years. As a non-profit community mental health center serving southeastern Jackson County, Missouri, we’re passionate about helping individuals impacted by mental illness or substance use find hope, support, and healing.

Why ReDiscover?

  • 500+ dedicated professionals
  • Over five decades of community impact
  • A culture grounded in compassion, collaboration, and growth

About the Safety & Security Department

The Safety & Security Department ensures that ReDiscover provides a safe, welcoming environment for our clients, staff, and guests by maintaining full compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Our team plays a key role in developing and implementing safety plans across all ReDiscover locations and special events—and often serves as the first friendly face to greet everyone who walks through our doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Greet and monitor all persons entering and leaving ReDiscover facilities.
  • Monitor building camera systems as needed.
  • Monitor external walkways, parking lots, lobbies, entryways, internal hallways, restrooms, and other areas as needed.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of safety plans for various locations and special events.
  • Respond to all 911 calls, notify appropriate ReDiscover personnel of emergency situations, and communicate with emergency response agencies as appropriate.
  • Maintain reliable attendance by working scheduled shifts and notifying the Safety & Security Team Leader as soon as possible of any anticipated or unexpected absence.
  • Support Building Safety operations across multiple ReDiscover locations to ensure continuous, high-quality service.
  • Maintain flexibility to work at different locations and occasional varying shifts based on staffing and operational needs.

description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Why this role is on the menu

The Billing Operations Lead oversees and optimizes the end-to-end billing lifecycle across all Instacart Marketplace retailers, ensuring accurate invoicing, compliance with financial controls, and timely month-end close. This role serves as the operational and strategic anchor for the billing team, partnering closely with Finance, BD, Financial Systems, Legal, Product, and Engineering to drive accuracy, scalability, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate brings deep billing operations experience, strong analytical ability, and a bias for operational excellence — someone equally comfortable mentoring junior team members as they are collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to scope system enhancements and automation opportunities.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Billing portfolios across strategic retail partners and multiple revenue streams are owned and operating accurately, with day-to-day billing operations executed with a focus on revenue recognition inputs and timely month-end close.
  • Billing policies, SOPs, and quality standards are developed and maintained, with discrepancies and escalations resolved in close partnership with Finance Systems, BD, and Revenue.
  • Dashboards, reporting, and KPIs that track billing health are built in collaboration with Finance Systems, enabling continuous improvement and proactive identification of issues.
  • Billing system enhancements, integrations, and automation opportunities are scoped and delivered in partnership with Product and Engineering, reducing manual workload and improving operational scalability.
  • Internal controls, audit requirements, and contractual billing terms are enforced, with junior team members mentored and billing operations scaled to support Instacart's growth.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Billing Operations, Order-to-Cash, or Accounts Receivable within technology, ecommerce, marketplace, or subscription/SaaS environments.
  • 2+ years leading cross-functional billing or quote-to-cash projects as an individual contributor, from requirements through UAT and launch.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ and at least one billing platform (e.g., Zuora, Chargebee, Stripe Billing) plus one ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).
  • Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups) and basic SQL for reconciliations and data analysis.
  • Working knowledge of billing controls, SOX requirements, and revenue considerations (e.g., ASC 606) as they apply to invoicing, credits, and adjustments.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated success leveraging data modeling tools such as Alteryx to automate billing processes.
  • Aptitude and demonstrated success leveraging AI solutions to improve billing processes.

title: Associate Director, Translational Medicine Lead, Antibody-Drug Conjugates
location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America
description:
Do you feel passionate about the possibilities of great science changing lives of cancer patients? Do you have a background within oncology and/or translational research and have interest in working with antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) and an exciting portfolio? If so, this may be the role for you.

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Associate Director to join our team of translational medicine leads supporting our exciting internal ADC programs.

The Translational Medicine function exists within AstraZeneca R&D to ensure effective and strategic biomarker studies for Oncology project teams. Closely interacting with the pre-clinical Discovery, Early Clinical Development, and Precision Medicine & Biosamples diagnostics functions, the Translational Medicine team is the single point of accountability for delivery of robust, scientifically-driven biomarkers to all project teams, providing feasibility assessments, technical validation, centralized biomarker analysis capability for clinical samples, delivery of translational science research and early clinical phase engagement. AstraZeneca has focused its efforts in developing drugs based on a strong data-driven translational approach. As part of this global initiative, Translational Medicine (TM) Oncology works closely with discovery, research and clinical development teams to integrate biomarker strategies to guide clinical translation of our new molecule entities (NMEs) across a wide variety of targeted therapies. To this end, TM Oncology group leads the biomarker strategy and execution to establish mechanism of action and predictors of response in early clinical trials. The team also implements biomarker strategies for all clinical programs. We are looking for a highly motivated translational medicine leader to support biomarker activities in early as well as late-stage clinical development.

We are seeking an Associate Director in Oncology Translational Medicine Strategist to develop biomarker strategies and ensuring delivery within our internal ADC oncology project portfolio teams.

Working in partnership with the Translational Medicine team, lead the implementation of strategic vision that enables indication selection, early indication of biological activity and patient stratification/selection in Oncology

Responsibilities

  • Delivering translational science and biomarker strategies for early and late development oncology assets through Ph1 to Ph 3 clinical studies based on the best available science and technologies.
  • Generating disease linkage data to guide indication selection and targeted patient populations.
  • Measuring target engagement and pharmacodynamic biomarkers reliably and quantifiably to advise clinical decisions for selecting therapeutically relevant doses and schedules.
  • Understanding key cancer pathway interactions, feedback mechanisms, and features of tumor microenvironment in clinical samples to guide rational drug combinations.
  • Defining novel mechanisms of resistance targeted therapies by studying tumors at relapse.
  • Influence translational strategy across the AZ portfolio.
  • Collaborate with Oncology Research, Translational Medicine, and global product development teams to facilitate appropriate incorporation of Translational Medicine strategies for molecules in early to late phases of development in Oncology.
  • Collaborate with clinical operations and clinical teams to define sample collection, lab manuals and clinical study protocols, and biomarker analyses in clinical studies related to oncology.
  • Contribute to and ensure the quality of Translational Medicine clinical study reports, data reviews and interpretations, presentations, scientific publications and recommendations to development teams and management
  • Lead internal and external research collaborations in areas of clinical technologies and oncology translational research.

Essential for the role

  • PhD and/or MD with experience in oncology drug development.
  • A minimum of 5 years’ of relevant experience
  • In-depth knowledge of oncology disease area biology (solid tumors) and translational science.
  • Ability to drive, manage, execute and deliver results for complex multi-functional projects.
  • Highly developed problem solving and risk management skills, and attention to detail.
  • Highly developed collaborative working skills.
  • Ability to act as an external ambassador and to influence external organisations to enhance the image and reputation of AstraZeneca.
  • Proven ability to motivate and develop others.

Desirable for the role

  • Expertise in antibody drug conjugates.

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Naturally curious, we are forever connecting and collaborating. Uncovering new insights that equip us to challenge convention and push the boundaries. We are a global, science-led biopharmaceutical company and our innovative medicines are used by millions of patients worldwide.

Committed to living our values – they guide our behaviours, actions and decisions, everyday. With our ground-breaking pipeline comes a bright future – exciting opportunities and varied work. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



We are building a cutting-edge ecosystem for Docusign that will empower developers to seamlessly integrate and extend Docusign's features and applications by implementing custom APIs. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading medium to large initiatives and scaling the Developer and Extend platform - Strategic Al Initiatives, ensuring that it is robust, secure, and easy to use for builders looking to plug into Docusign's growing IAM ecosystem. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, driving platform architecture and feature development. Your work will impact multiple engineering and product teams as you lead the development of the platform's foundational features. Additionally, guiding architectural decisions, and managing incident response processes that require being on rotational on-call, and coordination both within the team and other teams within the organization.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Software Engineering.

Responsibility

  • Design and optimize secure and scalable systems, including queueing architectures, NoSQL, and SQL storage systems, to handle the diverse needs of the ecosystem
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and high performance within the engineering team
  • Create secure, efficient backend services and agents in Javascript or other object-oriented programming languages
  • Develop and maintain feedback loops for your Al Agents
  • Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand needs and iterate quickly
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies, coding languages and domains

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. What you bring

  • Experience with NodeJS, C#, Java, C++, or Go
  • Experience building Al Agents and prompt engineering

  • Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and microservices architecture and APIs at scale
  • Experience developing software solutions using object-oriented methodologies and design patterns

Preferred

  • Knowledge and experience in high scale, highly available systems
  • 3+ years professional experience building complex, scalable applications
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Curiosity and ability to learn new technologies and tool sets
  • Experience with NodeJS technology stack and various databases
  • Familiarity with Microservice architecture

  • Care deeply about writing high-performance, reusable code for components that will be used across our product

California: $164,700.00 - $266,000.00 base salary

Global benefits provide options for the following:

Life at Docusign



Working here

The CTC will lead multi-disciplined practice transformation and practice performance improvement initiatives. Primary Responsibilities:

  • Accountable for successful deployment of UHC's Clinical Support program at the practice level, including but not limited to, introducing and educating practices on the value/use of reporting tools, patient registries and delivery of reports via UHC's Physician Portal

  • Regularly facilitate efficient, effective practice improvement meetings with the practice to monitor, present, and discuss progress on the transformation action plan and achievement in milestones
  • Develop strategies; based on performance analysis, for improvement that includes specific outcomes and metrics to monitor progress to a goal and make recommendations for improvement
  • Design practice transformation action plans and implement appropriate performance improvement initiatives designed to assist the practice in achieving contractually required transformation milestones
  • Monitor and review the progress of the practice in milestone achievement and insure the practice is accountable for successful completion

  • Demonstrated experience leading groups and strong presentation skills
  • Proven solid Microsoft Office Skills with Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint

title: Specialist til Låneadministration og Procesforankring i Realkredit Danmark
description:
Operation Specialist til RD Operations

Vil du forstå sammenhængene bag dansk realkredit og være med til at udvikle fremtidens processer?

I RD Operations søger vi en ny kollega, der er nysgerrig på, hvordan ting hænger sammen, og som motiveres af at skabe forbedringer. Du behøver ikke kende alle svarene på forhånd, men du skal have lysten til at finde dem.

Hos os kommer du tæt på maskinrummet i Realkredit Danmark, hvor lån, funding, systemer, processer og kunder mødes. Vores ansvar er at sikre, at komplekse processer fungerer sikkert og effektivt hver dag, samtidig med at vi løbende udvikler og optimerer dem.

Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?

Du bliver en del af et team med stor faglig bredde og mange forskellige opgaver. Nogle dage arbejder du med konkrete lånesager eller analyser, andre dage deltager du i projekter, udviklingsinitiativer eller procesforbedringer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Deltage i daglig drift af Operations opgaver
  • Sikre korrekt registrering og håndtering af lån og lånerettelser.
  • Analysere og dokumentere afvigelser og finde årsager på tværs af systemer og processer.
  • Arbejde med sammenhængene mellem lån, funding og pengestrømme.
  • Omsætte nye regler og forretningskrav til robuste arbejdsgange.
  • Identificere muligheder for automatisering og smartere processer.
  • Samarbejde med kolleger og interessenter på tværs af organisationen.

Hvem er du?

Du er nysgerrig og motiveres af at forstå, hvorfor ting fungerer, som de gør. Når du møder en udfordring, er din første tanke ikke, at det bliver svært, men hvordan du finder løsningen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra den finansielle sektor eller en lignende kompleks organisation.
  • Har interesse for processer, systemer og datadrevne analyser.
  • Drives af at få ting fra hånden
  • Trives med at samarbejde og skabe resultater sammen med andre.
  • Er struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, også når tempoet er højt.
  • Griber en sag selv om du ikke kender løsningen.

Det får du hos os

Vi tilbyder en rolle, hvor du både får et stærkt fagligt fundament og mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på udviklingen af RD Operations.

Du bliver en del af et team, der:

  • Prioriterer høj faglighed og ansvarlighed.
  • Ansvaret for at deltage og køre daglig drift
  • Arbejder aktivt med optimering og automatisering.
  • Deltager i tværgående projekter med stor betydning for forretningen.
  • Hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen.

Har du mod på en blanding af driftsopgaver krydret problemløsning, hvor du motiveres af at forstå komplekse sammenhænge, løse problemer, drive forbedringer og være med til at forme fremtidens operationelle setup i Realkredit Danmark, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at række ud til Head of Operations, Maria Rieks på riek@rd.dk.

title: Head of Composite Manufacturing Engineering
description:
Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.

We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece.

As Head of Composite Manufacturing Engineering you will own how iCOMAT makes composite parts, across every plant. You will set the process standards, technical governance and long-term manufacturing engineering strategy that our plant Manufacturing Engineering Leads deliver locally, taking Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) from a proven technology to a repeatable, rate-capable production system at multiple sites. The role is based at Factory 1 in Gloucester, reports to the Director of Engineering, works closely with the Director of Global Manufacturing Operations, and includes regular travel to our UK facilities.

What will you be doing?

Ways of Working & Standards

Setting the day-to-day tempo and way of working for the Manufacturing Engineering team. You will own the process standards, specifications, routings, Methods of Manufacture and ME practices used on the shop floor, so that every part is built the same way, every time, at every site.

Leadership & Team

Leading the plant Manufacturing Engineering Leads and, through them, the Manufacturing Engineering and Tooling teams at each site. You will set objectives, build capability and succession, and grow the function as we open new factories. This is a hands-on role: you will get stuck into the hardest technical problems yourself.

Process Development & Industrialisation

Owning industrialisation of new parts and processes from order to production release through APQP, PFMEA, control plans, FAIR and production readiness reviews. You will work with the RTS machine, software and design teams to turn development processes into robust, documented production processes covering layup, cure, trim, machining, bonding and NDT.

Quoting & Cost Estimation

Owning the manufacturing engineering input to every quote. You will work with Business Development to define the manufacturing methodology, estimate cycle times, labour, materials, tooling and cost per part for new programmes, and make sure what we quote is what we can build, at the rate and margin we committed to.

Rate, Cost & Capacity

Driving cycle time, yield, scrap and cost per part in the right direction with lean and structured problem-solving. You will provide the manufacturing engineering input to business cases, capacity plans and new factory layouts, and support Business Development with manufacturing methodology, cost estimates and quotations for new programmes.

Quality & Customer Interface

Partnering with the Head of Quality to build quality into the process rather than inspect it in, through AS9100-aligned documentation, root cause analysis and effective corrective action. You will represent Manufacturing Engineering in technical reviews and audits with customers and OEMs.

What do we need from you?

• Composite manufacturing engineering is the number one requirement: 10+ years in aerospace, defence or space production, including taking parts from development into rate production

• 5+ years leading manufacturing engineering teams, ideally including leads or managers, and ideally across more than one site

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of composite processes: prepreg layup, autoclave and out-of-autoclave cure, trimming and machining, bonding and NDT, and how materials behave throughout

• Strong command of industrialisation tools (APQP, PFMEA, control plans, FAIR, production readiness reviews)

• Working knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace quality requirements

• Proven record of improving yield, cycle time and cost using lean and structured problem-solving (8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone)

• Solid understanding of composite tooling design, materials and qualification

• Degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Aerospace or Materials Engineering, or equivalent working experience

• Clear communicator who can set direction for engineers and hold their own with customers, operations and the executive team

• Proactive and resilient mindset, comfortable building structure in a fast-moving scale-up

Nice to have

• Experience with automated composite processes such as AFP or ATL

• Experience standing up a new factory, production line or greenfield site

• Exposure to US aerospace and defence manufacturing, including ITAR environments

• Nadcap experience and OEM customer-specific requirements

• Six Sigma Black Belt or Chartered Engineer status

Working conditions

• Manufacturing and office environment, based at Factory 1 in Gloucester

• Regular travel to Swindon and abroad plus occasional travel to customers and suppliers

• Flexibility to work extended hours when production or programme launches need it

Our Values: Uncompromising Excellence

  • Discipline over excuses. We commit. We follow through. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard, especially when the pressure is on.

  • Push the edge. iCOMAT was built on a refusal to accept that curved fiber could not be manufactured at scale. We innovate where others hesitate.

  • Aligned and accountable. Everyone owns their lane, communicates openly, and delivers without being chased. No silos. No ambiguity.

Why iCOMAT?

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including private healthcare, pension scheme.

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Join us at a pivotal time as we scale up, offering unmatched professional growth opportunities in the rapidly advancing field of composite materials.

  • Innovation-Focused Culture: We pride ourselves on our inclusive, forward-thinking work environment. Recognized by Bloomberg as a "UK Startup to Watch," iCOMAT celebrates diversity and encourages all applicants, regardless of background, to apply.

  • Global Impact: Be a part of our mission to redefine lightweight structures for the automotive, aerospace, and space industries, working with some of the most influential companies worldwide.Ready to be part of something big?

Apply now to learn more and join us on our exciting journey!

title: Head of Growth
description:
Grimes & Company Wealth Management, LLC is a thriving Registered Investment Advisory firm headquartered in Westborough, Massachusetts with satellite offices and employees strategically located across the U.S. As our firm continues to grow, we are looking to add a Head of Growth to our dynamic and client-focused team. Recently named one of the 2025 Best RIAs to Work For, this is an exciting opportunity to join a trusted and expanding organization dedicated to helping high-net-worth individuals and families achieve their financial goals.


About the Role

Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer, the Head of Growth will create the strategy, processes, expectations, tools and accountability required to turn business-development activity into measurable growth.


This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both strategic thinking and active participation in significant opportunities, advisor coaching, referral partner relationships and pipeline management.


Key Responsibilities

Organic Growth Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive organic growth strategy aligned with the firm’s long-term growth objectives.
  • Establish clear growth priorities across Custodial Referral Programs (CRP), client referrals, share of wallet, Centers of Influence, events, digital campaigns, other lead-generation channels, and other leads.
  • Translate the strategy into annual and quarterly goals, initiatives, campaigns, and measurable activities.
  • Maintain an appropriate balance between near-term asset gathering and longer-term relationship development.
  • Evaluate emerging organic growth opportunities, including direct-to-consumer platforms, strategic partnerships, corporate relationships, professional associations and targeted geographic expansion.
  • Ensure organic growth efforts reinforce the firm’s planning-led, relationship-focused positioning.


Regional Director Leadership

  • Directly lead, manage and develop the Regional Director team.
  • Establish clear roles, territories, expectations and performance standards for each Regional Director.
  • Define the Grimes sales process from lead generation through discovery, advisor, introduction, proposal, follow-up and close.
  • Clarify ownership and responsibilities between Regional Directors and Wealth Managers throughout the prospect journey.
  • Coach Regional Directors on pipeline development, branch relationships, Centers of Influence, client discovery, objection handling and closing strategies.
  • Conduct regular individual and team pipeline reviews.
  • Evaluate capacity, territory coverage and staffing needs as the firm expands into new markets.


Custodial Referral Programs (CRP) and Strategic Referral Programs

  • Own the overall strategy and performance of the firm’s performance within the CRP.
  • Manage senior relationships with Fidelity, Schwab, Robinhood and other strategic referral partners.
  • Establish differentiated strategies for each referral platform, market and branch opportunities.
  • Monitor referral volume, lead quality, response time, close rate, average relationship size, sales cycle length and client retention.
  • Improve the firm’s position with referral partners by communicating its comprehensive planning, investment, tax, trust, insurance and high-net-worth capabilities.


Advisor-Led Organic Growth

  • Partner with Wealth Managers to create practical, measurable organic growth plans.
  • Help advisors increase referrals from existing clients, expand share of wallet and build relationships with clients’ family members and professional advisors.

title: Associate Director, Engineering
description:
About Us

MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) is a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform that provides consumers with actionable insights to discover, compare, and choose the best financial products with confidence — bringing data intelligence and seamless digital access across insurance and banking solutions. The Company operates in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Philippines. Its brand portfolio includes B2C platforms MoneyHero, SingSaver, Money101, Moneymax and Seedly, as well as the B2B platform Creatory. The Company also holds a preference share investment in Jirnexu Pte. Ltd. MoneyHero had over 280 commercial partner relationships as at June 30, 2026, and had approximately 3.7 million Monthly Unique Users across its platform for the three months ended June 30, 2026.


About the Job

You will lead a team of frontend and backend engineers, ensuring high-quality delivery, adherence to best practices, and effective collaboration across disciplines. You will own architecture decisions, conduct code reviews, debug production issues, and maintain reliable deployments, while working closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to translate requirements into scalable, well-engineered solutions.

We rely heavily on AI tools for coding and code review: 80-90% of our code is written with AI, with engineers directing, reviewing, and refining the output. This role leads that adoption across the team, setting the standards for AI-assisted development and keeping quality, architecture, and review practices strong as the volume and pace of code grows.

The team lead will be responsible for:

  • AI-Assisted Development: Define how the team uses AI coding and review tools day to day. Set the standards for shipping AI-generated code safely and keep quality standards high for what gets merged.
  • Architecture & Patterns: Own the architecture of the team's services. Define and apply proven patterns (microservice boundaries, event-driven design, domain-driven design, clean API contracts) and keep systems modular, coherent, and maintainable as AI increases the volume and pace of code.
  • Coding (70%): Write, review, and optimize production-ready code in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, working with AI tools from design through review and testing, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Code Review & Quality: Enforce best practices and high code quality standards, with review practices adapted to AI-generated code: automated checks handle routine issues, human review focuses on correctness, architecture, and business logic. Guide engineers through constructive feedback.
  • Mentorship: Coach and support engineers through regular feedback, pair programming, and technical guidance, including effective use of AI tools.
  • Issue Resolution: Debug and resolve production issues, coordinate incident response, and ensure root-cause analysis and prevention.
  • Planning & Delivery: Plan and prioritize development work, balance workloads, and manage release deliverables.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to align on requirements, timelines, and technical feasibility.
  • CI/CD & DevOps: Maintain reliable build and deployment pipelines, monitor system health, and enforce security and automation standards.
  • Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks, propose tooling or workflow improvements, and drive overall engineering efficiency.

In this role, we are looking for someone with :

  • Expert in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, with strong experience building full-stack web applications and reusable components.
  • Strong grasp of software architecture and design patterns (microservices, event-driven systems, domain-driven design, API design), with experience designing high-load distributed systems that stay scalable and maintainable.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in production work (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot): generating, reviewing, and correcting AI-written code, and helping others do the same. Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and evals is a plus.
  • Skilled in designing and maintaining microservices and GraphQL APIs for scalable, distributed architectures.
  • Proficient with SQL databases and modern NoSQL solutions such as MongoDB and Redis, including schema design, query optimization, and caching strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including container orchestration, automated deployments, and system monitoring, plus working knowledge of AWS and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Proficient with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing, building, and deployment.
  • Strong understanding of web security standards, authentication flows, data protection, and secure coding practices.
  • Familiar with SEO optimization, web performance metrics, and best practices for improving visibility and user experience.
  • Committed to clean code, testing, observability, and production-grade reliability.
  • Skilled in leading cross-functional teams, conducting code reviews, mentoring engineers, and aligning technical work with business objectives.
  • Good to have: familiarity with Java/Kotlin/C#, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and scalable caching or storage solutions.
  • 10+ years in software engineering, delivering secure, scalable, and high-performance applications.
  • Excellent business mindset and execution skills, with strong presentation and communication skills in English.


#MoneyHeroGroup #LI-AK1 #LI-Hybrid

title: Project Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Program / Project Manager to lead two strategic, interdependent capital initiatives at a GMP pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Manatí, Puerto Rico: a Site Master Planning Program and a Cogeneration / Combined Heat and Power (CHP) Project.

This individual will serve as the single point of accountability for both programs, providing leadership across project execution, engineering coordination, schedule, budget, risk, contractor management, permitting, commissioning, and stakeholder communication. The selected professional must be comfortable managing multiple complex work-streams simultaneously while maintaining alignment between long-term facility planning and energy infrastructure initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead overall program and project governance, including schedule, budget, scope, risk, and resource management.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact across Engineering, Operations, Quality, EHS, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Develop, manage, and maintain integrated project master schedules, milestones, budgets, forecasts, and risk registers.
  • Lead day-to-day coordination with A&E firms, contractors, vendors, engineering teams, and technical specialists.
  • Support capital budgeting, cost estimating, business case development, and capital appropriation activities.
  • Facilitate site master planning workshops and coordinate assessments of facility layout, production flow, space utilization, utilities, capacity, and future expansion requirements.
  • Support development of long-range site development strategies and phased capital investment roadmaps.
  • Integrate power, steam, water, HVAC, and other utilities infrastructure into long-term facility planning.
  • Manage the development and execution of a Combined Heat and Power / cogeneration project, including feasibility, technology and vendor evaluations, engineering design, procurement, construction, installation, startup, and commissioning.
  • Coordinate electrical and utility integration associated with the cogeneration system.
  • Support applicable environmental, utility, and construction permitting activities.
  • Coordinate energy savings, ROI, utility cost, and project performance assessments.
  • Ensure project execution supports cGMP requirements and minimizes disruptions to ongoing pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
  • Support commissioning, startup, performance testing, reliability qualification, and final project handover.
  • Manage project change controls and document management activities.
  • Identify conflicts or resource constraints between concurrent project work-streams and proactively develop mitigation plans.
  • Prepare and present weekly/monthly progress, financial, risk, and project status reports to leadership.
  • Maintain project execution plans, meeting minutes, decision logs, risk registers, schedules, and final closeout documentation.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Strong Project/Program Management experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, biologics, or other cGMP manufacturing environments.
  • Proven experience managing large, complex capital projects through design, construction, commissioning, startup, and closeout.
  • Experience with Site Master Planning and long-term facility/capital planning.
  • Experience with cogeneration/CHP, industrial power generation, energy infrastructure, or similar utility projects.
  • Strong knowledge of Facilities & Utilities, engineering, construction, contractor/vendor management, schedules, budgets, forecasting, risk management, and change control.
  • Experience coordinating A&E firms, contractors, vendors, procurement, construction teams, and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
  • Experience with utility integration/interconnections and environmental or construction permitting.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent and interdependent projects while minimizing disruption to ongoing manufacturing operations.
  • Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulated manufacturing requirements.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to maintain a significant on-site presence in Manatí, Puerto Rico.
  • English/Spanish bilingual proficiency strongly preferred.
  • PMP, CCM, or similar Project/Construction Management certification preferred.
  • Previous capital project experience in Puerto Rico, including familiarity with local permitting, utilities, engineering, and construction practices, is strongly preferred.

title: Rådgivningscenterdirektør til Hvidovre

Rådgivningscenterdirektør, Hvidovre

Bliv en del af vores Advisory Network som Rådgivningscenterdirektør i Hvidovre.
Du får ansvaret for et dynamisk center med 18 ansatte, og er med til at forme, hvordan vi skaber stærke relationer til privatkunder og sikrer, at de får den rådgivning, de har brug for til at træffe velinformerede økonomiske beslutninger ved hjælp fra vores rådgivningsværktøj, Panorama.

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dine ledelseskompetencer, samtidig med at du gør en meningsfuld forskel for både medarbejdere og kundeoplevelsen.

Det skal du arbejde med

Som Rådgivningscenterdirektør i Hvidovre skal du lede et team med fokus på at levere rådgivning af høj kvalitet til privatkunder. I tæt samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af banken skal du sikre, at kunderne får helhedsorienteret rådgivning og støtte til deres bankbehov, samtidig med at der opbygges langvarige relationer.

Din ledelse bliver afgørende for at skabe et samarbejdende og engagerende miljø, hvor dit team kan trives og udvikle sig. Udover Rådgivningscenteret i Hvidovre vil du ligeledes have ansvaret for vores mødecenter i Rødovre, som er en del af dine 18 nye kollegaer.

  • Skabe en stærk og engagerende teamkultur, der fremmer samarbejde og succes.
  • Forandringsledelse via ADKAR som sikrer hurtige og succesfulde implementeringer
  • Sikre høje standarder for servicekvalitet og kundetilfredshed ved bl.a. sammøder, stærk træningskultur og Værdiskabende Kundedialog
  • Udvikle teamets mål i tråd med afdelingens målsætninger
  • Støtte teammedlemmer gennem coaching, performance management og karriereudvikling
  • Føre tilsyn med kunderådgivning og muligheder for krydssalg inden for privatkundeområdet samt have den ansvarlige rolle for kreditbeslutninger.
  • Selvstændigt arbejde med rekruttering af nye medarbejdere

Om dig

  • Dokumenteret ledelseserfaring med personaleansvar inden for bank.
  • Stærke kompetencer inden for personaleledelse og flair for at rekruttere og udvikle medarbejdere.
  • Teamorienteret tilgang og evne til at skabe et positivt arbejdsmiljø
  • Erfaring med kunderådgivning eller relationsstyring
  • Kendskab til produkter og services inden for privatkundeområdet
  • Fremragende kommunikationsevner i dialogen med kunder og kolleger
  • Certificeret indenfor bolig, investering og pension

Tidligere erfaring som Rådgivningscenterdirektør eller i en lignende kundevendt lederrolle indenfor bank vil være en fordel.

Det tilbyder vi dig

Du vil arbejde efter en hybrid model med 3 til 4 dage om ugen på kontoret, hvilket understøtter samarbejde og opbygning af kultur. Vi tilbyder omfattende læringsmuligheder og mentorprogrammer, der understøtter din fortsatte udvikling som leder.

Du får mulighed for at videreudvikle din karriere i vores voksende Advisory Network, samtidig med at du gør en reel forskel for kundeoplevelsen i en af Danske Banks store filialer i Danmark.

Er du klar til næste skridt?

Vi vil meget gerne høre fra dig, hvis denne mulighed matcher dine karriereambitioner. Har du spørgsmål til rollen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lars Ahrens Hansen på lahan@danskebank.dk.

Send din ansøgning senest den 14. oktober 2026. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så vi opfordrer dig til at søge hurtigst muligt.

title: CMF Designer, RBKS ID Team
description:
RBKS is seeking a talented and experienced Color, Material and Finish (CMF) Designer to join our Industrial Design team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end development of CMF strategies that enhance the aesthetics, functionality and durability across diverse hardware product portfolio. You will play a pivotal role in defining design vision — forecasting trends, developing innovative material solutions and ensuring alignment with product requirements and strategic objectives.

You will manage multiple projects simultaneously whilst maintaining accurate documentation, tracking and release of CMF information. Working closely with suppliers, engineers, industrial designers and cross-functional teams, you will translate creative concepts into manufacturable solutions — ensuring feasibility, consistency and successful implementation into mass production.

This role requires a forward-thinking designer who thrives on material research and innovation, driving sustainability, manufacturing advancements and next-generation material applications. You will proactively identify emerging trends, analyze industry insights and explore innovative materials and finishes to position the hardware portfolio at the forefront of quality and innovation. You will also leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate concept development, streamline design workflows and enhance decision-making across the CMF pipeline.

Given our global operations, this role requires coordination across multiple time zones and international locations — including participation in weekly early-morning or late-evening online meetings and one to two international trips annually.

Key job responsibilities
-Lead the development and execution of CMF solutions across RBKS hardware product portfolio. Establish and maintain design consistency, ensuring that CMF strategies align with brand identity, user experience and long-term product vision.
-Identify opportunities for new or refreshed color palettes — leveraging market research, consumer insights and industry trends to inform strategic decisions. Conduct trend analysis using data from fashion, technology and material innovation services, ensuring that CMF direction remains competitive and forward-thinking.
-Develop digital and physical presentation materials to effectively communicate CMF design strategies. Present comprehensive CMF proposals to development teams, product managers and executives — ensuring alignment with product objectives and manufacturing feasibility.

Performance will be of the required standard when the following have been achieved:

  1. Design Quality & Innovation

  2. Project Timeliness & Efficiency
    Adherence to Deadlines: The ability to consistently meet project milestones and deadlines, including the timely delivery of design work, technical drawings, and documentation.
    Project Turnaround Time: Efficiency in completing assigned tasks, while maintaining quality. This includes how well the architect manages their workload to deliver results on time.
  3. Communication & Collaboration
    Communication Effectiveness: Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with the local team, consultants, and clients. This includes participation in virtual meetings, providing timely updates, and ensuring clarity in design intent.

title: Senior Research Associate, In Vivo Pharmacology
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Abiologics, Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company on a mission to make biology better through an innovative therapeutic modality. We are pioneering the development of Synteins™, a transformational class of macromolecular medicines unlocked by novel synthetic and computational technologies. Abiologics is actively seeking exceptional scientists who are passionate about driving therapeutic modality innovation in biotechnology.

Abiologics was founded in Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine, where companies such as Moderna Therapeutics (NASDAQ: MRNA) and Generate Biomedicines were conceived and created. Since Flagship’s founding in 2000, the firm has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures resulting in more than 500 issued patents and more than 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly motivated, broadly skilled Senior Research Associate to join our growing Pharmacology team. In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible for hands-on execution of rodent in vivo studies as well as coordination of studies with contract labs to support the progression of Abiologics’ pipeline. The incumbent may also contribute to in vitro and ex-vivo pharmacology activities to progress projects and the platform, including molecular and cell biology assays and histology. This role will collaborate cross-functionally with a diverse design-make-test team across Abiologics and have the opportunity to impact platform and company growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct in vivo (mouse) studies to characterize and assess the function, pharmacokinetics, and biodistribution of SynteinsTM, with increasing ownership of study design and interpretation.
  • Perform hands-on dosing of mice (including intravenous and other routes) and isolation/processing of mouse blood and tissues.
  • Comply with IACUC regulations regarding animal welfare and care.
  • Collect and prepare tissues for histology, including fixation and embedding.
  • Execute and optimize lab procedures such as tissue lysis and cell isolation, ELISA, Western blot, RNA/DNA extraction, qPCR, and related cell/molecular biology assays supporting in vivo studies, including some cell culture.
  • Coordinate with CROs to support the execution of external in vivo studies, including formulation and shipment of compounds.
  • Analyze, interpret, and accurately document study and assay results in an electronic lab notebook and present findings in internal meetings.
  • Apply troubleshooting and data analysis skills to resolve issues and improve study quality and throughput.
  • Collaborate with the Pharmacology team and cross-functionally to support lead optimization and platform advancement.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in Biology or related discipline with 5–7 years of relevant research experience, or MS with 3–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in a biotech or pharmaceutical setting.
  • Well-established, independent experience with rodent in vivo dosing and handling techniques with expertise in multiple routes of substance administration (e.g., PO, IP, IV, SC) and ability to efficiently execute study protocols involving multiple blood collection time points.
  • Experience in tissue dissection and preparation for RNA, protein analysis, and histology, including fixation and embedding.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute or learn various molecular and cell biology techniques, such as ELISA, Western blot, qPCR, cell-based functional assays, and flow cytometry.
  • Proficiency with software such as Excel, GraphPad Prism, and PowerPoint for experimental documentation and data analysis/presentation.
  • Strong organizational and analytical problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and industry-level experience with best practices related to data documentation and integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively across highly skilled, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and technically complex environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in cell culture techniques, including primary cell isolation, culture, characterization.
  • Experience with tissue sectioning and immunohistochemistry techniques, including antibody validation, multiplexing, and imaging.
  • Experience in flow cytometry and data analysis (e.g., FlowJo) is a plus.

ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING:

Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at .

At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths without fulfilling every qualification. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background and interest in Flagship.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. title: Director, AI Enablement & Legal Engineering
location: Burbank, California, United States of America
description:
The Director, AI Enablement & Legal Engineering will partner with attorneys, business partners and technology teams to redesign legal workflows, implement technology-enabled solutions, and create scalable ways of working that improve how legal services are delivered across Legal & Global Affairs.


As a key member of the LIFT team, this role will focus on AI-enabled process engineering, workflow modernization, automation, knowledge enablement, and practical adoption of new tools and ways of working. The role will help translate legal practice needs into repeatable processes, operating models, and solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, scalability, and business impact.


Key Responsibilities


Architect and Deploy AI Solutions

  • Keeps legal data accurate, well-organized, and responsibly used, treating it as the foundation AI capability is built on and improves alongside
  • Design end-to-end AI solutions, using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic frameworks, for contract review, legal research, regulatory analysis, and compliance workflows. Build & enhance the underlying document processing pipelines, including intake, parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing, that turn contracts, playbooks, and regulatory filings into a system that supports fast, intelligent search and analysis
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to build and ship production solutions faster.
  • Establish testing, validation, and quality control practices so AI-enabled legal work meets LGA's standards for accuracy and reliability.

Own Vendor and Technology Stack Strategy

  • Evaluate and influence the legal technology portfolio, including build-versus-buy decisions across platforms and specialized providers.
  • Track and report the return on investment of AI usage across the department to guide where further investment makes sense.
  • Assess external platforms, many of which already run on comparable AI capability, against the case for building in-house and vice-versa. Platform and build decisions should be made with a view toward where AI in Legal is heading, not just its current state.

Build AI Fluency and Legal Engineering Capability

  • Design enablement programs calibrated to where each practice area sits on the AI maturity curve, rather than a single training path for everyone.
  • Coach and develop talent toward legal engineering skills and help expand the existing network of AI-advanced colleagues across practice areas.
  • Measure adoption and effectiveness to guide where further investment in tools or training makes sense.

Partner Across Senior Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior LGA leaders and cross-functional partners in Technology, Finance, and HR on AI strategy and priorities.
  • Translate technical capability into practical, business-relevant recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Navigate a matrixed organization and competing priorities to keep initiatives moving.

Lead with a Service Mindset

  • Keep attorneys' and paralegals' daily experience at the center of every solution, so tools solve real friction rather than add process.
  • Stay responsive and available to legal teams as they adopt new workflows and tools.
  • Build trust through consistent follow-through, not just technical delivery.

Qualifications


Required

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and licensed attorney in good standing.
  • 10+ years of experience in legal practice, legal operations, legal technology, consulting, transformation, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience improving legal workflows, processes, service delivery, or operational effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of legal processes, process redesign, legal technology, knowledge management, automation, and workflow tools.
  • Experience with AI-enabled solutions, legal technology implementation, workflow platforms, or innovation initiatives.
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with attorneys, senior legal leaders, technology teams, and business stakeholders.

Preferred


  • Experience in Legal Operations, legal transformation, legal innovation, consulting, or legal technology organizations.
  • Expertise in process engineering, workflow design, Lean, Six Sigma, design thinking, product management, or related methodologies.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management, matter management, legal intake, knowledge management, document automation, or workflow automation platforms.
  • Experience helping legal teams adopt AI-enabled solutions, automation, or new ways of working.

  • Orients the patient and patient's family to the facility and the policies and procedures.
  • Escorts the patients to off-unit appointments and activities using therapeutic interventions to ensure the safety of the patient, hospital staff, and other University patients and visitors.
  • Assists with providing a therapeutic milieu for patients by encouraging patients to participate in recreational activities and group therapies.
  • Assists with supportive therapy for select patients by leading activity and conversation groups.
  • Assists in the development of patient behavioral expectations.
  • May functions as a preceptor to new Psychiatric Technicians.
  • Assists with the unit's training and quality assurance programs, as well as ordering, stocking, and maintaining clerical and patient supplies. Provides an annual educational in-service to co-workers.
  • Functions as a member of the interdisciplinary treatment team and may coordinate with leadership to maintain department forms.
  • Assists with initiating and contributing to patient treatment planning, teaching and discharge planning.
  • Participates in patient care team conferences by sharing observations of patient's progress toward identified goals and assists the primary Registered Nurse with the development, evaluation, and revision of patient care plans.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Ability to recognize when a patient is having an adverse reaction to medication and report it in a timely manner to the Registered Nurse.

  • Interpersonal skills to acquire the trust of the patients and respond appropriately in a crisis situation.
  • Ability to utilize the principles of group dynamics when co-leading a group to facilitate the development of social, behavioral, and communication skills among group members.
  • Knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served on his or her assigned unit.
  • Knowledge of the principles of life span growth and development and the ability to assess data regarding the patient's status and provide care as described in the department's policies and procedures manual.
  • Demonstrated human relations and effective communication skill.

Qualifications

Required
