  • Build trusted relationships with customers by providing technical guidance and maintaining consistent communication.
  • Stay current on International Codes, industry standards, and certification requirements.
  • Travel regularly throughout your local territory, with occasional overnight travel (up to approximately 25%).

title: Lead Analytics Product & Services "Data Platform" F/M/X
description:
Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

Here is where your greatest challenge awaits you:

You will join the Data Platform Tribe , which is responsible for the Group's foundational Data technology stack, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable access to data and analytical services on a global scale.

Within the OPEN Feature Team, you will contribute to the transformation of Accor's analytics ecosystem, as well as the structuring and evolution of its self-service analytics offering. The team's mission is to provide and evolve data access tools (such as new conversational interfaces), enhance user experience, and support Business Analysts in mastering their solutions.

In short, this team is responsible for empowering data users and builders to accomplish their own missions autonomously, while maximizing value and minimizing costs.

This position holds a key leadership role, combining the definition of the product strategy for the OPEN scope, management of the feature team's Product Owners, and a strong contribution to aligning product vision, business needs, and technological capabilities.

Your mission:

Your responsibilities will be structured around five key areas:

1. Product Strategy

  • Champion the vision, roadmap, and priorities for self-service analytics, data access, and data democratization solutions.
  • Identify user needs, drive product discovery activities, and ensure initiatives are aligned with business challenges and the overall Data strategy.

2. People Management & Leadership

  • Mentor and support the team’s Product Owners in their professional growth and skill development, ensuring clear product ownership of high-priority initiatives.
  • Map, align, and engage a complex ecosystem of international stakeholders; act as a key facilitator to arbitrate priorities, communicate roadmap progress, and maximize the adoption of self-service solutions.
  • Manage and foster relationships with technical counterparts from third-party solution vendors.

3. Product Delivery

  • Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Analytics products and services, including:
    • The new democratization solution designed for all data personas, replacing the current portal;
    • Data products enabling the measurement of Data ROI.
  • Ensure functional and technical consistency across the ecosystem, in close collaboration with the Product, Data, and Engineering teams.
  • Monitor service quality, solution adoption, and user value creation.

4. AI & Automation

  • Define the product strategy, use cases, and roadmap for AI and automation solutions dedicated to data users and builders (Augmented Data Platform, support agents, onboarding/offboarding workflows, self-service request orchestrators, etc.).
  • Measure their impact and contribute to the evolution of the platform's practices and services.

5. Data Adoption

  • Develop onboarding, training, and support programs for users both within and outside the Data team.
  • Advise business departments on expressing their requirements, promote Data best practices, and contribute to strengthening the data culture across the Group.

And you?

  • Proven experience in Product Management or Product Leadership within a Data & Analytics environment, with the ability to define a product vision, lead user discovery, and prioritize a backlog based on business value.
  • Strong product and technical leadership experience, including the operational management of consultants or project teams, leadership of Product Owners and/or product teams, while remaining a hands-on contributor capable of assessing technical feasibility.

Technical Skills

  • Ability to define a product vision (user research, PRDs, OKRs, RICE), lead discovery activities (user interviews, Jobs-to-Be-Done, value metrics definition), build strategic roadmaps, and prioritize initiatives based on business value.
  • Strong understanding of modern Data & Analytics platforms, including self-service analytics environments, data governance, and large-scale analytics architectures.
  • Experience with Modern Data Stack technologies (ideally Snowflake), Business Intelligence tools (Tableau, Dataiku), orchestration solutions, and data transformation practices.
  • Deep understanding of Generative AI and AI agent use cases applied to Data & Analytics challenges.

Soft Skills

  • Strong ability to collaborate within cross-functional environments, combined with a service-oriented mindset, a continuous improvement approach, and a strong focus on value creation.
  • Ability to provide strong product leadership, articulate a strategic vision, and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Experience managing, coaching, and developing talent within Product teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and engage both technical and business audiences

Accor dares to impact:

- The world:

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.

  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

- Your career:

  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.

  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.

- Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:

  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.

  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.

  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.

  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

and also,

  • ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide.

  • Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours).

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, regardless of gender, so go ahead and apply!

Recruitment is all about people!

title: Senior Tax Analyst - Avalara for Accountants
description:
What You'll Do

Avalara’s Accounting Channel is at the heart of how we serve the accounting and CPA community, and the Managed Returns for Accountants (MRA) team is where that commitment becomes real. As a Senior Tax Analyst on the MRA team, you are the primary compliance expert and relationship anchor for a select portfolio of accounting firms. You own the end-to-end returns experience for those firms, from onboarding through filing, notice resolution, and continuous improvement.

This is not a passive service role. We expect you to bring deep tax compliance expertise, a relentless drive to improve how work gets done, and a genuine commitment to making your teammates and your customers better. You will be the firm’s most trusted resource on multi-jurisdictional transaction tax compliance, and you will use that expertise to drive automation, improve quality, and elevate the capability of everyone around you.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Compliance and Filing Operations

  • Prepare, review, and file multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax, business and occupation, and gross receipts tax returns for monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual filing cycles
  • Manage a select portfolio of accounting firms as their dedicated primary point of contact for all returns-related questions and escalations
  • Research and resolve jurisdictional tax notices on behalf of customers with clear, timely, and well-documented communication
  • Perform quality assurance reviews related to sales and use tax content and jurisdiction form changes

Customer and Relationship Management

  • Serve as the first point of contact for accounting firm returns questions, setting clear expectations and relaying complex compliance information in an accessible, actionable manner
  • Own the onboarding and validation of new sales and use tax returns customers, ensuring a smooth transition into Avalara’s platform
  • Communicate regularly and effectively with customers, jurisdictions, and internal teams as part of research and resolution workflows
  • Take full ownership of customer satisfaction, demonstrating empathy and proactive responsiveness to customer needs

Process Improvement and Team Enablement

  • Identify, develop, and implement automation improvements to serve customers across a variety of market and tax verticals
  • Identify process and technology gaps and recommend improvements that reduce risk, increase throughput, and improve customer outcomes
  • Assist with implementation, training, and documentation initiatives in support of the broader team
  • Coordinate and lead training for junior-level employees, serving as a knowledge resource for critical troubleshooting and in-cycle risk reduction
  • Apply expert knowledge of jurisdiction websites and taxpayer-facing portals, including data input nuances and system limitations

What You'll Need to be Successful

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance AND a minimum of 5 years of directly related experience in multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax compliance, returns preparation, or tax operations
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work through ambiguous compliance scenarios
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tax concepts into clear guidance for accounting professionals and internal stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities to meet strict filing deadlines
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new software applications, platforms, and tools
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with depth in Excel (including Power Pivot, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, and related functions)
  • Must be available and working during US business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Masters) in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance
  • Experience with a Big 4 firm, a large corporate tax department of a multinational company, or a large ERP integration
  • Expert understanding of an Avalara customer’s data flow from AvaTax portal to Returns Console
  • Deep understanding of user platform features related to jurisdiction configuration, including nexus, exemptions, marketplace rules, filing calendars, reporting, and transaction data
  • Working knowledge of transaction flow across the business and the downstream impact on returns preparation and filing
  • Familiarity with returns content areas including transaction tax calculation, transaction data flow, returns mapping, and returns filing automation

Bar Raiser Expectation

We hire people who make Avalara better. This role is not just about performing the job, it is about joining Avalara with the expectation that you will raise the standard for everyone around you. We expect this person to leave the team measurably stronger than when they arrived.

  • You are expected to set a higher standard for quality, rigor, and accountability in compliance work, not just meet existing standards
  • You will actively mentor and develop junior team members, sharing your expertise in ways that multiply the team’s capability
  • You will challenge current processes, identify gaps, and implement improvements rather than accepting the status quo
  • You will bring a perspective and depth of experience that pushes your peers to think more critically and work more effectively
  • You will demonstrate Avalara’s values in how you operate: integrity, accountability, and a commitment to the customer
  • Candidates who are not prepared to actively contribute to team growth and organizational improvement are not the right fit for this role, regardless of technical skill

AI Bar Raiser Expectation

We expect every Senior Tax Analyst to be an AI Bar Raiser on their team. This means more than using AI tools; it means you bring stronger AI fluency and applied AI capability than the team you are joining, and you actively use that expertise to elevate the team’s overall capability.

  • You will demonstrate a working command of AI-powered tools applied to tax compliance workflows, including automated return preparation, anomaly detection, notice pattern recognition, and data reconciliation
  • You will identify high-value opportunities to apply AI and automation to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and increase throughput across MRA operations
  • You will teach, model, and coach your teammates on effective AI-assisted workflows, raising the floor of AI fluency across the team
  • You will critically evaluate AI outputs, understanding where automation adds value and where human judgment and expertise must remain central
  • You will contribute to Avalara’s broader AI adoption strategy within the Returns organization by piloting new approaches, documenting what works, and sharing findings across teams
  • Candidates who have general familiarity with AI tools but cannot articulate how they would apply AI to elevate team performance will not meet the AI Bar Raiser standard for this role

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Head of Discipline - Roads & Airports
description:
Vil du have ansvaret for et fællesskab med høj faglig kvalitet, hvor mennesker, trivsel og faglighed går hånd i hånd? Motiveres du af at skabe retning, udvikle talent og samle et team om et fælles mål? Og tror du på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem tillid, samarbejde og tydeligt lederskab?

Så har du nu muligheden for at være med til at udvikle både mennesker og projekter i rollen som Head of Discipline, Roads & Airports.

Skab klar retning, fremdrift og holdbare løsninger

For at styrke vores afdeling inden for Roads & Airports søger vi en engageret Head of Discipline til at lede et team på 25 dygtige kolleger i Aarhus. Disciplinen er en del af COWI's Engineering Unit Transportation West, som består af syv fagdiscipliner, der samarbejder tæt, både om ledelse, kompetenceudvikling og projektleverancer.

Vi arbejder med nogle af Danmarks mest betydningsfulde infrastrukturprojekter. Projekterne omfatter vej- og lufthavnsprojekter for både lokale kunder, offentlige myndigheder og internationale aktører samt anlægsopgaver inden for energi, datacentre og byggeri, både lokalt og internationalt. Fælles for opgaverne er, at de gør en reel forskel for samfundet.

Som disciplinleder får du en central rolle i at skabe sammenhæng mellem strategi, mennesker og resultater. Du skal sikre høj faglig kvalitet og solid projektgennemførelse, men lige så vigtigt er det, at du skaber engagement, trivsel og udvikling i teamet. Du bliver kulturbærer og inspirator for et miljø, hvor faglig stolthed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Bidrage til og omsætte strategier og handlingsplaner til konkrete initiativer, der understøtter disciplinens udvikling og forretning.
  • Indtage rollen som seniorspecialist, projektleder eller disciplinleder på nøgleprojekter og sikre høj kvalitet i leverancerne.
  • Skabe overblik over kompetencer og kapacitet i teamet og sikre den rette bemanding gennem rekruttering, udvikling og optimering af ressourcer.
  • Udvikle og coache medarbejdere gennem tydelige mål, løbende dialog og konstruktiv feedback.
  • Understøtte et inkluderende og tillidsbaseret arbejdsmiljø, hvor forskellighed ses som værdi.

Ledelse med retning og menneskelig indsigt

Du tror på, at ledelse handler om at inspirere og sætte en klar og meningsfuld retning – og samtidig skabe rum for, at andre kan vokse og tage ansvar. Måske har du allerede ledelseserfaring, eller måske står du over for dit første formelle lederansvar. Det vigtigste er, at du har lysten, nysgerrigheden og modet til at træde ind i rollen og udvikle dig som leder.

Du skaber følgeskab gennem dialog, nærvær og tydelige forventninger. Du trives med ansvar, giver konstruktiv feedback og motiveres af at se andre lykkes. Samtidig har du blik for både forretning og kvalitet og motiveres af at omsætte ambitioner og strategi til konkret handling i hverdagen.

Derudover har du:

  • En relevant ingeniørfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund eller tilsvarende.
  • Indgående kendskab til infrastruktur, veje og/eller lufthavnsgeometri.
  • Erfaring med ressource- og projektledelse.
  • Solid forretningsforståelse og evnen til at omsætte strategi til praksis.
  • Gode evner til at formidle budskaber klart og at håndtere relationer med forskellige interessenter.
  • En oprigtig motivation for at opbygge mangfoldige og højtydende teams.

Har du flere spørgsmål?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Vibeke Poulsen, Head of Engineering, Transportation West på vnp@cowi.com.

Du kan også lære os endnu bedre at kende på vores hjemmeside, , hvor du kan læse mere om vores projekter, strategi, mål og hverdagen hos COWI.

En arbejdsplads og meget mere

Hos COWI arbejder vi sammen med vores kunder for at skabe en bæredygtig verden. Det gør vi ved at anvende vores viden og nysgerrighed – og til tider endda vores mod – til at skabe de løsninger, verden har brug for i dag, for at muliggøre en bedre fremtid i morgen. Derfor bestræber vi imod, at størstedelen af vores omsætning skal komme fra aktiviteter, der hjælper vores kunder med at bevæge sig mod bæredygtighed.

Vi værdsætter forskellighed og udvikling og skaber et miljø, hvor der er plads til alle, og hvor vi har det sjovt. For det er netop det, der bringer det bedste frem i dig – både på arbejdet og derhjemme. Med kontorer primært i Skandinavien, Storbritannien, Nordamerika og Indien er vi i dag 7.500 medarbejdere, der bringer vores tekniske kunnen inden for ingeniørarbejde, arkitektur, energi og miljø i spil.

Mangfoldighed er fundamentalt for COWI, og inklusion er nøglen

Vi er forpligtet til at skabe et respektfuldt og retfærdigt arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle medarbejdere har en følelse af tilhørsforhold og oplever lige muligheder for at trives og vokse. Vi sikrer, at vores ledere er rollemodeller for inkluderende lederskab ved at dyrke en kultur, hvor forskellige perspektiver og forestillinger ses som styrker. Vi tager hensyn til mangfoldighed og inklusion i alle relevante beslutninger og processer, og når vi sammensætter teams og fora. Vi gør det, fordi det er en del af vores værdier, og fordi det er det rigtige at gøre.

title: Køkkenchef til Peter Lieps Hus i Dyrehaven
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for køkkenet på et af hovedstadsområdets mest markante restaurant- og eventsteder?

Peter Lieps Hus har i mere end 100 år været et naturligt samlingssted i Dyrehaven. I dag er huset en veletableret destination med frokost- og aftenservice, bryllupper, selskaber og erhvervsarrangementer.

Under Madkastellet er køkkenet udviklet til et ambitiøst dansk sæsonkøkken med respekt for husets historie, de klassiske restauranttraditioner og naturen omkring os. Opgaven er nu at fastholde det høje niveau og videreudvikle køkkenet, teamet og driften.

Vi søger en erfaren og operationel køkkenchef, der er en stærk gastronom, en tydelig leder og dygtig til at drive en kompleks køkkenforretning.

Om jobbet

Som køkkenchef får du det samlede ansvar for køkkenets daglige drift, kvalitet, økonomi og medarbejdere. Hverdagen spænder fra travl frokost- og aftenservice til bryllupper, konferencer og større selskaber. Flere produktioner kører ofte sideløbende, og kvaliteten skal være den samme på tværs af restaurant og events.

Peter Lieps Hus er en sæsonpræget forretning, hvor gæstetal, åbningstider og aktivitetsniveau varierer gennem året. Du skal derfor kunne planlægge i god tid, tilpasse bemandingen og skabe sammenhæng mellem bookinger, produktion og økonomi.

Du bliver en synlig leder tæt på både medarbejderne, maden og den daglige service. Samtidig får du mulighed for at sætte dit eget faglige præg på køkkenet i tæt samarbejde med husets ledelse og Madkastellets faglige organisation.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder

  • Ledelse og udvikling af køkkenteamet
  • Sikring af høj gastronomisk kvalitet til frokost, aften og selskaber
  • Planlægning og afvikling af à la carte-service og events
  • Udvikling af menuer med afsæt i sæsonen og husets identitet
  • Planlægning af bemanding, kapacitet og vagtplaner
  • Ansvar for budgetter, vareforbrug, lønprocent og øvrige nøgletal
  • Styring af indkøb, lager, produktion, svind og egenkontrol
  • Tæt samarbejde med restaurantchef, driftschef og bookingteam

Hvem er du?

Du er køkkenchef eller en erfaren souschef, der er klar til at tage det fulde ansvar.

Du har et stærkt gastronomisk håndværk og erfaring fra en restaurant, et hotel eller et eventsted med flere samtidige produktioner. Du bevarer overblikket i travle serviceforløb og kan omsætte budgetter og nøgletal til konkrete beslutninger om menu, indkøb og bemanding.

Som leder er du tydelig, ordentlig og samlende. Du sætter retning, følger op og skaber en kultur, hvor medarbejderne lykkes som et hold.

Du har respekt for husets historie og traditioner, men også ambitionerne og fagligheden til at udvikle køkkenet videre.

Vi tilbyder

  • Stor indflydelse på køkkenets drift og gastronomiske udvikling
  • Ansvar for en varieret forretning med à la carte, bryllupper og events
  • Tæt samarbejde med husets ledelse og Madkastellets faglige bagland
  • Ordneede forhold, pension og sundhedsordning
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer
  • En arbejdsplads midt i Dyrehaven

Du refererer til husets driftschef, som har sin daglige gang på Peter Lieps Hus.

Har du gastronomien, lederskabet og det økonomiske overblik til at føre Peter Lieps Hus videre? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

title: Director of Front Office (FT)
description:
LOCATION

The Lodge at Torrey Pines
Step into the timeless craftsman charm of The Lodge at Torrey Pines. Overlooking the world-renowned Torrey Pines Golf Course with views of the Pacific Ocean, the AAA Five Diamond rated resort features 170 rooms and suites, 2 restaurants, a full-service spa, versatile meeting spaces, and unprecedented service.

The Lodge at Torrey Pines is owned by Evans Hotels, LLC, a family-owned and operated business committed to supporting and enhancing employee well-being through a variety of programs that nurture our staff professionally and personally. We offer hands-on manager and leadership training, employee appreciation days, and staff awards and recognition. Our team is also dedicated to serving our community through initiatives like company-wide beach clean-ups and volunteer opportunities.

SUMMARY
The Director of Front Office (“Director/a de Recepción”) is responsible for the overall leadership, operation, and performance of Front Desk, Concierge, Guest Services, Valet, and Transportation. This position provides direction and oversight to the Front Office leadership team and ensures effective daily operations, staffing, guest service, service recovery, and performance management. The Director partners with Hotel leadership and the Yield team to support occupancy, rate, and revenue objectives while managing departmental budgets, forecasts, and expenses. Through visible and engaged leadership, the Director ensures the Front Office operation consistently meets AAA Five Diamond and hotel service standards while delivering an exceptional guest experience.

PAY & PERKS

  • Compensation: $90,000 - $100,000 DOE**
  • Earn $1000 for Culinary, Engineering, Housekeeping, and $350 for all other roles for each hired referral at any Evans Hotels property.
  • Discounted Hotel Rooms for you, family and friends
  • Free Employee Parking and/or discounted MTS Pronto card
  • Free Meals & Refreshments during working shifts
  • Career advancement opportunities!
  • Health (including SIMNSA), Dental, Vision, 401k with match, life insurance, sick and vacation time.
  • Discounts on cell phone bills, shoes, gym memberships, and more!


ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Convey a favorable image of the organization by projecting a positive, professional, poised, well-groomed appearance and polished demeanor to our guests.

title: Senior UX Designer, Web
description:
The role

Neat is leading the way in business video communications with smart, simple solutions built to adapt to people and the way they work.

Our award-winning Neat devices are simple to buy, set up, use, and manage. We deliver uncomplicated and natural audio and video experiences, and a growing ecosystem of apps, through our intentionally-focused yet versatile hardware and software options.

These are the same core ideas we want to extend to our customers who visit and use our ecommerce-enabled product website. This is a senior, high-impact role, and the person who takes it will build the practice, process, and standards that define UX at Neat going forward.

As a senior User Experience Designer, you will work closely with our product and design teams to translate those core design principles and experiences to the website and various digital experiences. Our devices cut through the noise of modern technology, and our website has to do the same.

The brand is built around simplicity and clarity, and as such, we're not afraid of space. We'd rather remove a section than add one, and we care about the small things: the weight of a line of type, the pace of a scroll, the moment a product first comes into view. Every detail is considered. Our name sets a standard, and every page has to live up to it.

This role is for someone who can see the big picture and how it all ties together. You'll have real ownership and be responsible for directing the user experience on the website, setting the direction rather than following one, and ensuring it meets the same standards that our devices bring to our customers.

The work you do here will naturally bleed out to the rest of the organization, across marketing, customer service, support, and other areas. You will define the standards and hold others accountable to them, even outside your direct team. You'll be inheriting a brand that's been carefully built and carefully kept: calm, precise, Nordic, and unmistakably Neat in a category that mostly shouts or imitates.

What you'll do

  • Own the UX direction for the website as a whole, setting the standard other work is measured against.

  • Establish the UX processes, rituals, and standards for web, including design reviews, research cadence, and a shared design language.

  • Act as the senior voice for web UX across the company.

  • Lead UX for major product launches on the website, from early concept through to launch day.

  • Lead design for our evolving ecommerce experience, from browsing and product pages through checkout.

  • Work closely with the product marketing team to own and build a consistent narrative on the website.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UX designs.

  • Partner with product managers and engineers to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

What you'll bring

  • Relevant education (bachelor's or higher) in UX/interaction design or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 9+ years of UX design experience, including senior-level ownership of complex web products and experience establishing or leveling up UX practice within a team or organization.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing real-world ecommerce or high-traffic consumer web experience design. Experience presenting technology products in a simple, uncomplicated way is a big plus.

  • Experience with UX and interaction design across mobile, web, and desktop.

  • Proficient in wireframing, prototyping, and visualization tools such as Figma, Sketch, or the Adobe Suite.

  • Professional experience working on UX or UI design projects within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Expertise in content architecture and information design to improve website navigation.

  • Comfort working directly with engineers, with a good instinct for what's feasible to build.

  • Experience running and applying user research, not just producing deliverables from it.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable influencing senior leadership and driving alignment across teams that don't report to you.

  • Clear communication skills. You can explain and defend a design decision as well as you can make one.

  • A calm, collaborative approach to feedback and ambiguity, balanced with the confidence to push back when the work calls for it.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for hardware or physical products alongside digital ones.

  • Background in design systems at scale.

  • Experience in video conferencing, collaboration tools, or B2B hardware.

title: Senior Planner
description:
Do you want to play a key role in some of Denmark’s largest and most complex energy infrastructure projects? Are you an experienced planner who creates structure, transparency, and progress in complex projects? Then join us at COWI and help shape the future of sustainable energy infrastructure.

Become a vital part of our Energy team

As a Senior Planner, you will play a key role in planning and delivering large and complex energy and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will work at Energinet as part of a COWI team supporting some of Energinet’s important projects. You will take ownership of project schedules and work closely with project managers, technical specialists, contractors and suppliers to create transparency, manage dependencies and risks, and keep projects moving forward.

Furthermore, you will support projects throughout their lifecircle – from early development and design through tendering and execution. Beyond maintaining schedules, you will function as a trusted sparring partner to project management, using planning and schedule analysis to support informed decision-making, identify challenges and drive corrective actions. Through your work at Energinet, you will gain the opportunity to contribute directly to projects that are central to Denmark’s energy infrastructure and green transition.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Planner, you will:

  • Develop, maintain, and optimise integrated project schedules using Primavera OPC and MS Project.
  • Monitor project progress together with project managers and technical leads, identify deviations and support corrective actions.
  • Identify and manage critical paths, dependencies, interfaces, and schedule risks across project activities.
  • Perform baseline management, what-if analyses and schedule risk assessments.
  • Review and validate schedules from contractors, suppliers, and other project partners.
  • Prepare clear progress and status reports, providing transparency on milestones, risks, dependencies, and deviations.
  • Ensure schedules support effective progress, risk, and resource management.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of robust planning methodologies, processes, and tools across our projects.
  • Provide planning expertise and constructive challenge to project management and project teams.

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

You are an experienced and proactive planner who is comfortable taking ownership of complex project schedules. You understand that good planning is about more than maintaining a programme – you use the schedule to create transparency, challenge assumptions, identify risks and support project management in making informed decisions.

You enjoy working across disciplines and are confident engaging with project managers, technical specialists, customers, contractors, and suppliers. You bring a structured and analytical approach while being able to communicate complex information in a clear and practical way.

On top of that, you will have:

  • Extensive experience in project planning and project controls, preferably from large and complex energy, infrastructure, construction, or engineering projects.
  • Strong experience developing, managing, and integrating complex project schedules.
  • Strong working knowledge of Primavera and MS Project. Primavera OPC experience is a requirement.
  • Experience with progress monitoring, critical path analysis, baseline management, schedule risk assessments and what-if analysis.
  • Experience reviewing and validating contractor and supplier schedules.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to turn complex schedule information into clear and actionable decision support.
  • Excellent oral and written Danish skills.

Experience from major energy infrastructure, transmission, utilities or other large-scale construction projects in Denmark will be a strong advantage.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com or Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui at iatu@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it’s a part of our values and because it’s simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Make a Difference as a Building Safety Monitor with ReDiscover

Join ReDiscover’s Safety & Security Department and be part of a mission-driven organization that’s been transforming lives for over 50 years. As a non-profit community mental health center serving southeastern Jackson County, Missouri, we’re passionate about helping individuals impacted by mental illness or substance use find hope, support, and healing.

Why ReDiscover?

  • 500+ dedicated professionals
  • Over five decades of community impact
  • A culture grounded in compassion, collaboration, and growth

About the Safety & Security Department

The Safety & Security Department ensures that ReDiscover provides a safe, welcoming environment for our clients, staff, and guests by maintaining full compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Our team plays a key role in developing and implementing safety plans across all ReDiscover locations and special events—and often serves as the first friendly face to greet everyone who walks through our doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Greet and monitor all persons entering and leaving ReDiscover facilities.
  • Monitor building camera systems as needed.
  • Monitor external walkways, parking lots, lobbies, entryways, internal hallways, restrooms, and other areas as needed.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of safety plans for various locations and special events.
  • Respond to all 911 calls, notify appropriate ReDiscover personnel of emergency situations, and communicate with emergency response agencies as appropriate.
  • Maintain reliable attendance by working scheduled shifts and notifying the Safety & Security Team Leader as soon as possible of any anticipated or unexpected absence.
  • Support Building Safety operations across multiple ReDiscover locations to ensure continuous, high-quality service.
  • Maintain flexibility to work at different locations and occasional varying shifts based on staffing and operational needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Safety & Security Team Leader, in collaboration with the Director of Physical Infrastructure.

Requirements of the Position

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of relevant security experience required.
  • Consistent and regular attendance is an essential function of this position.
  • Experience with digital control systems and a variety of building automation systems preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a reliable vehicle
  • Strong communication and customer service skills

Schedule Requirements

  • This is a stationary position
  • The regular schedule for this role is Monday – Friday from 11:00 PM – 7:30 AM
  • ReDiscover has programs that operate seven (7) days per week, candidates must be available to work rotating weekends and holidays as needed.

Grow With Us

We’re committed to your professional development and will support your growth as a Building Safety Monitor through training, collaboration, and meaningful work.

Ready to join a team that’s passionate about people? Apply today and help make wellness accessible for all.

title: Senior IT Support Specialist
description:
Senior IT Support Specialist

About Us

MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) is a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform that provides consumers with actionable insights to discover, compare, and choose the best financial products with confidence — bringing data intelligence and seamless digital access across insurance and banking solutions. The Company operates in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Philippines. Its brand portfolio includes B2C platforms MoneyHero, SingSaver, Money101, Moneymax and Seedly, as well as the B2B platform Creatory. The Company also holds a preference share investment in Jirnexu Pte. Ltd. MoneyHero had over 280 commercial partner relationships as at June 30, 2026, and had approximately 3.7 million Monthly Unique Users across its platform for the three months ended June 30, 2026.



What We Offer

You will be entitled to a competitive salary and attractive benefits, including:

  • Annual leave, birthday leave, tenure leave, international remote work leave, and more
  • Five-day work week, remote work arrangement
  • Professional trainings, career advancement and internal mobility opportunities
  • Competitive benefits including insurance and mental wellness program

About the Job

The Senior IT Support Specialist will be responsible for delivering end-to-end technical support, IT asset management, and service delivery for end users across the organization. This role requires strong ownership in handling day-to-day support requests, maintaining accurate asset records, coordinating with vendors and stakeholders, and supporting security and compliance activities. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with strong technical troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and the ability to manage a high volume of requests while maintaining proper documentation and SLA compliance.



The Senior IT Support Specialist will be responsible for:

  • End-User Support
    • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, and other end-user equipment.
    • Diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, software, connectivity, and application-related issues.
    • Provide remote support to end users as required.
    • Support multiple business applications and integrated systems simultaneously.
    • Assist users with account, access, configuration, and basic application-related issues.
    • Support new-hire onboarding and departing-employee offboarding, including account provisioning, equipment issuance, and access revocation in coordination with HR.
    • Document troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and relevant technical information in the ITSM/ticketing system.
  • IT Asset Management
    • Coordinate and assist with IT asset procurement in collaboration with relevant teams and personnel.
    • Maintain accurate records of IT assets, including assignment, ownership, location, status, and lifecycle information.
    • Manage, maintain, and physically handle IT equipment and other technology assets.
    • Coordinate asset deployment, retrieval, transfer, and disposal, including remote coordination where applicable.
    • Administer equipment checkout/handover processes, ensuring condition is documented at issuance and return.
    • Use asset management systems or tools (e.g., JumpCloud, internal asset trackers) to maintain accurate mapping between system records and physical assets.
    • Support periodic asset inventory, reconciliation, and disposal activities across supported markets.
  • Service Management
    • Manage day-to-day IT support requests and incidents in accordance with established ITSM processes and SLAs.
    • Prioritize and respond appropriately to incidents based on urgency, impact, and business requirements.
    • Perform proper incident escalation and coordinate with teams, vendors, or other technical stakeholders when required.
    • Maintain clear and timely communication with users throughout the resolution process, particularly for urgent or high-impact incidents.
    • Handle a high volume of support requests, while maintaining proper documentation, prioritization, and follow-through.
    • Ensure all incidents, requests, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions are properly logged and documented.
    • Prepare and maintain service management reports, audit documentation, ticket records, SLA performance reports, and other operational metrics as required for service reviews, compliance, and audit activities.
    • Draft and maintain internal documentation such as SOPs and Confluence knowledge base articles to support consistent service delivery and team knowledge-sharing.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination
    • Liaise with external vendors and service providers on hardware delivery, repairs, disposal, and support escalations.
    • Track vendor response times and follow up on outstanding vendor actions to ensure timely resolution.
    • Support the collection of vendor compliance documentation (e.g., SOC reports) as required for audit and security review purposes.
    • Coordinate cross-functionally with HR, Finance, and regional office stakeholders on asset, access, and onboarding/offboarding matters.
  • Security & Compliance Support
    • Monitor and action security alerts and policy compliance notifications (e.g., device encryption status, expired credentials, unenrolled devices) within assigned tools.
    • Support periodic access reviews and audit evidence collection, including offboarding verification and look-back checks.
    • Escalate suspicious activity or potential security incidents promptly in accordance with incident response procedures.
    • Maintain awareness of and adherence to company IT policies, including acceptable use, data protection, and asset handling standards.

In this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • Technical Skills:
    • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Identity Provider (IdP) platforms such as JumpCloud, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or similar.
    • Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Freshservice, or similar ticketing platforms.
    • Practical experience troubleshooting laptops, desktops, peripherals, and other hardware devices through remote support tools.
    • Working knowledge of common endpoint operating systems (Windows, macOS), productivity applications (Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365), networking basics, and basic user-access troubleshooting.
    • Familiarity with collaboration and documentation tools such as Atlassian Confluence and JIRA.
    • Understanding of basic ITSM processes, including Incident Management, Service Request Management, Escalation Management, and SLA management.
    • Basic understanding of IT asset lifecycle management and hardware disposal/compliance practices is an advantage.
    • Experience with automation and AI-enabled IT support tools is not required but considered an advantage.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong logical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to systematically troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
    • Demonstrates a strong sense of urgency, ownership, accountability, and sound judgment, particularly when handling business-critical incidents.
    • Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
    • Able to manage multiple concurrent tasks, incidents, and user requests while maintaining appropriate prioritization.
    • Proactive and self-driven, with a high degree of ownership and initiative in identifying and resolving issues.
    • Able to work effectively with internal teams, technical specialists, vendors, and business stakeholders.
    • Customer-service oriented, professional, and able to remain composed when handling urgent or challenging support situations.
  • Preferred Experience:
    • 3-5 years of relevant experience in IT support, service desk, or IT operations role.
    • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-market environment with regional stakeholders.

title: Senior Information Security Risk Specialist
description:
Do you want to turn complex information security risks into decisions and actions that protect the business and enable its strategic ambitions? At COWI, you will work at the intersection of cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business operations, technology, and digital transformation. You will play a central role in identifying the information security risks that matter most and ensuring they lead to clear ownership, informed decisions, and effective risk reduction.

At COWI, we create sustainable solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and generations to come. Our experts work across infrastructure, energy, water, environment, architecture, and buildings, delivering projects that shape societies and support critical services around the world.

As a trusted advisor to clients and partners, information security is an essential part of how we deliver projects, protect information, manage risk, and maintain trust. Our increasing use of digital platforms, data, artificial intelligence, and software-based delivery models creates new opportunities, but also increases our exposure to cybersecurity, regulatory, supply-chain, and delivery risks.

Your role, responsibilities, and team

COWI is strengthening its approach to information security risk management as part of a broader development of Information Security and Enterprise Risk Management across the Group.

Our ambition is to identify and understand the most important information security risks facing COWI, enable informed management decisions, drive effective risk treatment, and provide transparency and assurance to Executive Management and the Board.

This role has been established to help turn that ambition into practice.

As Senior Information Security Risk Specialist, you will be responsible for driving the information security risk management process across COWI. You will develop a consolidated and business-relevant risk picture, facilitate complex risk assessments, challenge assumptions, and translate material risks into decision-ready treatment options.

An important part of the role is ensuring that significant risks are not simply recorded in a risk register. You will help transform prioritized risks into clearly defined initiatives and projects, with accountable business owners, realistic delivery plans, measurable outcomes, and transparent reporting.

You will be part of the Group CISO and the ERM function, and you will work closely with IT, Legal, Procurement, Process & Quality, Transformation Office, and Business Lines, incl. operational risk owners across all of these.

Your primary responsibilities will include

  • Leading the identification, analysis, evaluation and prioritization of information security risks across COWI’s business operations, projects, digital solutions, information assets, and third-party dependencies.
  • Translating technical, regulatory and operational security issues into clear business-risk scenarios, including credible causes, consequences, existing controls, risk exposure and treatment options.
  • Facilitating strategic risk assessments and cross-functional risk workshops with senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, and accountable risk owners.
  • Preparing decision-ready risk analysis and reporting for the Group CISO, Executive Management, the ERM Committee, the Audit Committee, and the Board of Directors.
  • Developing risk treatment proposals and project charters for prioritized risks, including proposed scope, ownership, governance, outcomes, dependencies, resource requirements, milestones and measures of risk reduction.
  • Supporting risk owners in defining practical key risk indicators, treatment progress measures and evidence that demonstrate whether risk exposure is being reduced.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You are a proactive and accountable driver who identifies what needs to happen, aligns stakeholders, and delivers results—not just recommendations. Structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, you thrive in fast-paced environments, manage diverse requests effectively, and stay focused on the priorities that create the biggest impact. You build trust across teams, challenge yourself constructively, and drive decisions when security requirements must be met. At the same time, you are curious and committed to continuous learning, staying ahead of threats, standards, and best practices while turning knowledge into practical improvements.

On top of that, you will have:

  • Strong experience with information security, governance and risk management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex topics into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Strong analytical skills, a structured approach, and the ability to drive multiple parallel initiatives from idea to implementation.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence and create momentum
  • Educational background?

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it’s a part of our values and because it’s simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

title: Master Technician
description:
We Build Better Communities

Be Part of the Hawthorne Difference!

Hawthorne Cat is a family-owned company that has led its markets for over 60 years in the sale, rental, and servicing of construction machinery and power generation equipment for industries on which our communities depend like agriculture, construction, marine, and government.

Every member of our team plays a significant role in our success. Hawthorne Cat hires individuals who share our vision of Building Better Communities with our Customers and our values of Passion, Respect, Integrity, Dedication and Excellence (PRIDE).

If you are looking to build your future with an established, thriving company with countless opportunities for growth and advancement, you’ve come to the right place! At Hawthorne Cat, we’re always looking for exceptionally skilled, hardworking individuals interested in contributing to our success and the success of the communities that we serve.

Our people are our most valuable asset. That’s why at Hawthorne Cat we are committed to a comprehensive employee benefit program that helps our employees stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain a work/life balance.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Master Technician

Reports to: Service Manager

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

Division: HPC

Department: Service

Union: OE

Locations: Waipahu

POSITION SUMMARY: Without supervision, the Master Technician performs duties as assigned by the Service Manager in the repair, maintenance, and rebuilding of equipment in the service shop or field, in a safe, efficient, and capable manner in the least amount of labor hours possible and without rework.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. The Master Technician is required to complete work within 95% or less of a flat rate time that is established as a target.
  2. As well as performing mechanical repairs as directed, the Master Technician assists in training personnel and travels to all parts of the HPC territory to assist less skilled technicians in solving problem jobs.
  3. Must be proficient in the use of test and diagnostic tools and makes adjustments to machines and components. Is capable of troubleshooting mechanical problems in CAT and Allied products.
  4. Makes warranty recommendations and prepares reports when performing warranty service jobs, resulting in 100% of warranty claims being accepted by the manufacturers.
  5. Accomplishes work according to preventative maintenance quality standards and within the time allotted.
  6. Attends all required training classes as directed and obtains passing grades in all.
  7. Reconditions or overhauls major components to manufacturers specifications and is capable of assembling, adjusting, testing, and ensuring equipment performs to specifications.
  8. Performs the minimum number of tests necessary to identify the cause of the problem and recommends action to correct the failure or problem.
  9. Maintains a favorable business relationship with customers, suppliers, and personnel from other HPC departments.
  10. Understands fluid sampling, including hydraulic, oil, cooling, and fuel systems.
  11. Uses all diagnostic tools and correctly diagnoses electrical systems, engine components, hydraulic systems, and powertrain systems within 30 minutes.
  12. Reports all unsafe and equipment deficiencies (other than those in the job assignment) to the supervisor immediately.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

  1. Must have a high school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Must have a valid Drivers License with a good driving record.
  3. Must have PC skills.
  4. Must have the ability to communicate clearly, both orally and in writing.
  5. Must be forklift certified or able to be certified within 60 days.
  6. Must own hand tools that are suitable to perform the work noted above.
  7. Must have 10 years experience in the repair and maintenance of CAT equipment and has all the experience as outlined in HPC training classes.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  1. Walking: Moves about on foot, often through uneven terrain.
  2. Hands/arms: Operates equipment and hand and power tools.
  3. Handling: Seizes, helps, or works with hands.
  4. Lifting: Raises or lowers miscellaneous equipment parts and tools.
  5. Reaching: Extends hands and arms in any direction.
  6. Stooping: Bends body downward and forward by bending at knees or waist.
  7. Standing: Remains in standing position if required to perform various functions of the job.
  8. Climbing: In and out of equipment.
  9. Raising/Lowering: Goes up and down in man lifts.
  10. Vision: Reads work tickets and parts and service books and operates heavy equipment.
  11. Talking: Communicates by radio, phone, and in person.
  12. Hearing: Hears well enough to discern mechanical problems for safety in and around shop and construction sites and to receive communication by radio, phone, and in person.
  13. Sitting: Sits in equipment and vehicles for extended periods.
  14. Laying: Lies in prone position under vehicles and equipment for extended periods.
  15. Lifting: Lifts up to 60lbs. daily, frequent exertion.

ENVIRONMENTAL:

  1. Noise: Works in conditions with constant or intermittent noise.
  2. Temp/Weather: Works outside and in shop with variations of temperature and weather.
  3. Exposure: Subject to foul odors, fumes, and harsh substances.

Here’s what we Offer…

  • Competitive Compensation
  • A great work environment and culture
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities
  • Training
  • Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Medical video appointments available
  • Health Savings Account available
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) Pay
  • 401(k) Plan + Company Matching
  • Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Legal Plan
  • Travel Assistance Plan
  • Wellness Programs
  • Referral Bonus Program
  • Longevity Bonus Program
  • Recognition Programs and much more
  • Hawthorne CAT discounts
  • Boot Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Company-Supplied Uniforms
  • Advanced Technical Training

title: Skarp speditør/disponent til Italiens Trafik
description:
Nu har du chancen for at komme ind i en spændende Road trafik, i en afdeling, hvor teamwork, engagement, ansvar og en positiv indstilling er nøglen til succes i en hverdag, der byder på højt tempo og mange afvekslende opgaver.

Bliv en del af et stærkt team
Du bliver en del af et stærkt team, hvor dine primære arbejdsopgaver er disponering af vejtransporter imellem Danmark og Italien. I afdelingen arbejder vi hver dag på at styrke og forbedre vores forretning, yde den bedste kundeservice samt på at optimere processer og arbejdsgange.

Som vores nye kollega forventer vi, at du bidrager med et drive og en lyst til at tage del i det daglige arbejde for at optimere og disponere vores biler bedst muligt samt finde de bedste løsninger for vores kunder.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Disponere biler mellem Italien og Danmark
  • Søge de gode løsninger med både leverandører og samarbejdspartnere
  • Afgive ad-hoc tilbud
  • Behandle indkomne bookinger
  • Kontakt til agenter og underleverandører
  • Sikre god kontakt og koordinering med vognmænd og chauffører
  • Styrke forholdet med kunderne, gennem tæt kontakt og god service
  • Bidrage til løbende optimering af processer og arbejdsgange

Vi søger:
En kollega som har lyst til skabe de bedste løsninger for Blue Water, vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere:

  • Erfaren speditør/disponent - Du kan også være nyuddannet med stort drive
  • Kendskab til Italiens trafik er en fordel – men ikke et krav
  • Har lysten til at udvikle dig og lære nyt
  • Kommunikerer godt på dansk og engelsk
  • Flair for IT – herunder Office-pakken
  • Er struktureret og omhyggelig

Vi tilbyder dig:
Hos Blue Water har vi et uhøjtideligt miljø, hvor vi har fokus på at folk trives for at kunne levere på opgaverne. Vi har en rigtig god arbejdsplads, som vi værner meget om, og vi ønsker, at kollegaer bidrager til sikre dette for fremtiden. Samtidig er det en vigtig del af vores kultur, at vi har det sjovt, imens vi arbejder for at nå vores fælles mål. Vi tilbyder dig;

  • Ansættelse i en uformel virksomhedskultur, som vi er stolte af
  • Ansvar og udfordringer
  • Et stærkt fællesskab, i et fantastisk team med godt humør og højt til loftet
  • En spændende hverdag hvor ingen dage er ens
  • Arbejdstiden vil som udgangspunkt ligge i tidsrummet kl. 08.00 – 16.30

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.
Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker yderligere oplysninger, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Kasper Jessen, Manager Road United Kingdom, Ireland & Italy, +45 41124938.

Together we create solutions

Vi er en stolt familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt i Danmark i 1972, og global leverandør af alle logistik tjenester inden for moderne supply chain management. Vores værdigrundlag lever i dag i bedste velgående og er drevet af en udpræget entreprenørånd og godt købmandskab. Vores medarbejdere tilbydes derfor et stærkt fagligt miljø med store frihedsgrader, som sikrer vores kunder den bedste service.

Blue Water Shipping er blandt Danmarks mest alsidige speditører og vores kunders lokale samarbejdspartner. Vi er repræsenteret verden over med et stærkt globalt netværk med lokal ekspertise, som gør at vi kan tilbyde komplette og skræddersyede løsninger til ethvert forsendelsesbehov overalt i verden.

description:

## Senior Staff Systems Engineering - Avionics

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems

Poway

California

Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

With limited consultative direction, this position exercises considerable latitude in determining technical objectives and approaches for the analysis, development, integration, modernization, and sustainment of complex avionics and unmanned aircraft systems.

Functions as a senior technical authority and technical lead for assigned avionics systems, subsystems, capabilities, or projects/programs. Applies extensive systems engineering and avionics expertise to develop and evaluate system requirements, architectures, interfaces, integration approaches, verification strategies, and engineering solutions throughout the system lifecycle.

Provides technical leadership across multidisciplinary engineering teams and supports the successful integration of new and modified avionics capabilities into existing aircraft configurations. Evaluates impacts across hardware, software, electrical power, communications, flight controls, mission systems, payloads, ground systems, safety, cybersecurity, test, and other interfacing system elements.

Participates in planning and oversight of requirements development, architecture, design, integration, qualification, verification, flight test, fielding, sustainment, and modernization activities. Represents the organization as a senior technical point of contact with internal engineering organizations, program leadership, suppliers, customers, and government representatives.

Duties and Responsibilities

- Determines technical objectives and engineering approaches for assigned aircraft avionics systems, subsystems, capabilities, and projects.

- Serves as a senior technical lead and subject matter resource for aircraft avionics and associated system interfaces.

- Leads systems engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle, including:

  - Stakeholder and system requirements analysis.

  - Requirements development, decomposition, allocation, and traceability.

  - Functional and physical architecture development.

  - Interface definition and management.

  - Trade studies and technical assessments.

  - Integration planning.

  - Verification and validation planning.

  - Qualification, ground test, and flight-test support.

  - Sustainment and modernization assessments.
- Leads or supports development and maintenance of aircraft avionics architectures and associated system/subsystem specifications.

- Evaluates proposed avionics changes for impacts to existing aircraft configurations, interfaces, requirements, software, hardware, verification, and regression testing.

- Leads technical assessments associated with integrating or modifying avionics equipment, including:

  - Navigation systems.

  - Communication systems.

  - Identification systems.

  - Flight control and vehicle-management interfaces.

  - Aircraft computers and controllers.

  - Sensors.

  - Data buses and aircraft networks.

  - Mission and payload interfaces.

  - Electrical power and signal interfaces.
- Develops and reviews system, subsystem, component, and interface requirements for avionics capabilities.

- Ensures requirements are traceable to applicable stakeholder, system, and program-level needs.

- Leads development, review, and maintenance of Interface Control Documents, system specifications, architecture products, interconnect definitions, and related technical documentation.

- Evaluates compatibility and integration impacts between legacy avionics and new or modernized hardware and software.

- Coordinates avionics integration activities across systems engineering, electrical engineering, software, mechanical engineering, systems integration, test, safety, cybersecurity, configuration management, and other engineering organizations.

- Leads or participates in troubleshooting complex aircraft integration and test issues and supports root-cause and corrective-action activities.

- Supports hardware/software integration in laboratory, SIL/HIL, aircraft ground-test, and flight-test environments.

- Defines or supports verification methods and verification planning for avionics requirements.

- Evaluates regression-test impacts associated with avionics hardware, software, interface, and configuration changes.

- Supports system configuration and release assessments to ensure technical changes are properly allocated to applicable aircraft configurations.

- Participates in engineering change review and configuration-control activities.

- Leads technical trade studies involving avionics architecture, interfaces, obsolescence, modernization, reuse, performance, cost, schedule, and technical risk.

- Supports avionics obsolescence and sustainment planning for fielded aircraft systems.

- Supports modernization efforts involving replacement or upgrade of legacy avionics equipment and associated interfaces.

- Reviews supplier and subcontractor technical data and coordinates resolution of system-level interface and integration issues.

- Represents assigned avionics areas at technical interchange meetings, customer meetings, engineering working groups, and major program reviews.

- Develops and presents technical material for reviews such as SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR/FDR, TRR, and other applicable technical reviews.

- Provides technical guidance, mentoring, and review of work performed by less-experienced engineers.

- May lead small multidisciplinary technical teams or significant avionics work packages.

- Supports engineering planning, estimating, scheduling, staffing, and resource planning for assigned technical activities.

- Identifies technical issues and develops recommendations for resolution or escalation.

- Contributes to systems engineering process, architecture, requirements-management, and integration improvements.

- Maintains strict confidentiality of sensitive information.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

- Responsible for observing all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.

- Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.


We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

- Typically requires a bachelor's, master's, or PhD in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution, plus progressive engineering experience: 12+ years with a bachelor's, 10+ years with a master's, or 7+ years with a PhD. Equivalent engineering experience may substitute for education.

- Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline preferred.

- Demonstrates extensive technical expertise and application of engineering principles, concepts, theory, and practice to complex aerospace or defense systems, including aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems, avionics, or similarly complex multidisciplinary systems.

- Demonstrated ability to independently resolve highly complex technical problems involving multiple systems, interfaces, and engineering disciplines.

- Extensive experience in one or more avionics areas, including navigation, communications, identification/IFF, aircraft networks and data buses, flight-control interfaces, vehicle-management systems, aircraft computers/controllers, sensors, mission-system interfaces, or electrical and signal interfaces.

- Experience developing, reviewing, and managing system and subsystem requirements, including decomposition, allocation, traceability, verification, and baseline control; developing or managing avionics interfaces and Interface Control Documents; and integrating avionics hardware, software, and system-level interfaces.

- Experience evaluating technical changes for impacts across requirements, architecture, interfaces, hardware, software, test, and aircraft configuration, and developing recommendations based on those impacts.

- Experience supporting system integration, laboratory, aircraft ground, qualification, and/or flight testing. Experience troubleshooting complex hardware/software/interface integration issues is highly desired.

- Experience with avionics modernization, technology insertion, sustainment, obsolescence management, and common avionics communication interfaces/data buses is highly desired.

- Experience with requirements tools such as Jama, DOORS, or equivalent; MBSE and architecture tools such as Cameo/MagicDraw, SysML, or equivalent; and systems engineering products such as functional decompositions, sequence diagrams, interface models, and other architecture products is desired.

- Experience with configuration management, engineering change control, baseline/release management, and major technical reviews such as SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR/FDR, and TRR is desired.

- Experience with unmanned or military aircraft and with suppliers, subcontractors, customers, and government organizations is highly desirable.

- Strong technical leadership, communication, presentation, interpersonal, mentoring, and technical-direction skills. Must communicate complex avionics and system-level issues clearly to engineering teams, program leadership, suppliers, customers, and government representatives; work independently with limited direction; coordinate across multidisciplinary organizations; and balance technical performance, integration, cost, schedule, and program constraints.

- Must be able to work extended hours as required and obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.


**Highly Desired Experience**

- UAS aircraft avionics architecture.

- Integration of new avionics into mature or fielded aircraft.

- Avionics hardware and software modernization.

- Aircraft network and data-bus integration.

- Navigation, communications, IFF, flight-control, or vehicle-management systems.

- Requirements and ICD ownership.

- SIL/HIL and aircraft-level integration.

- Ground and flight test.

- Configuration-specific change-impact analysis.

- Verification and regression-test planning.

- Sustainment and avionics obsolescence management.

- Foreign language proficiency relevant to international customers, partners, suppliers, or program activities.
