title: Document Controller
description:
We are seeking a skilled and proactive Document Controller to join our Infrastructure Department at Egis, Bengaluru. In this role, you will be a key contact of our information management operations, ensuring that all project-related documentation is meticulously handled, stored, and accessible to authorized team members. You will play a critical role in maintaining the integrity of our document management systems in compliance with ISO standards, while upholding the highest standards of security and confidentiality. If you're passionate about precision, organization, and supporting collaborative teams through efficient document management within a Common Data Environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Undertakes day-to-day project document control tasks, quality checking, and correspondence in accordance with ISO 9001 quality management requirements.
  • Works closely with Egis Infrastructure Department project teams to ensure all documentation is managed and distributed through the project's Common Data Environment (CDE), in line with ISO 19650 principles for information management.
  • Operates within pre-established Egis procedures and document management protocols, contributing to their continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates with team members and end-users to troubleshoot document control issues and ensure smooth CDE adoption across the project.

The role involves the following tasks (but is not limited to):

  • Maintains and administers the project CDE (e.g. Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or equivalent platform), ensuring data distribution is managed in accordance with client, project, and supplier requirements and aligned with ISO 19650 naming and metadata conventions.
  • Reviews and revises the document distribution schedule and CDE workflows as required to ensure timely approvals, transmittals, and distribution.
  • Ensures documents are updated and issued in a timely manner to meet project deadlines, managing revision control and document status codes in line with ISO 19650 standards.
  • Coordinates with internal Egis Infrastructure teams and external parties to ensure document edits, reviews, and approvals are completed, proofed, and properly recorded within the CDE.
  • Tracks, logs, and maintains records of all project documents, drawings, and correspondence, ensuring full audit trails are preserved.
  • Applies discretion and judgement where required to resolve document control challenges while operating within standardised procedures.
  • Maintains the document tracking and production system, ensuring version control, document registers, and transmittal logs are kept up to date.
  • Prepares and maintains a document control system for all forms of documentation, including drawings, specifications, reports, RFIs, submittals, and correspondence.
  • Ensures all completed documents carry the appropriate sign-offs and approvals from designated personnel before issue or archiving.
  • Distributes controlled copies of documents to the appropriate personnel through the CDE, ensuring recipients are notified and records are retained.
  • Implements and follows Egis Quality Assurance procedures in line with ISO 9001 requirements, and supports quality audits as required.
  • Administers and maintains the Project Contact List and distribution matrix.
  • Supports the team in ensuring compliance with ISO 19650 at each project stage, including CDE state management (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archived).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a document control role, preferably within engineering, infrastructure, or construction projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ISO 19650 (information management using BIM) and ISO 9001 (quality management systems).
  • Hands-on experience working within a Common Data Environment (CDE) — familiarity with platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, ProjectWise, or SharePoint is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of document naming conventions, revision control, and transmittal management.

title: VP, Client Services - AI Agency
description:
The VP, Client Services is a leader within EVERSANA’s AI agency service line, responsible for driving growth, excellence, and innovation across a portfolio of pharmaceutical and biotech brands. This leader fuses Agentic AI with human expertise to reinvent how clients plan, execute, and optimize their commercialization and marketing efforts, ensuring EVERSANA’s AI agency becomes an indispensable partner across the product and patient journey.​​

  • Track record of leading large, cross-functional teams and complex portfolios, with accountability for revenue, profitability, and client satisfaction.​

  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior client relationships, navigate ambiguity, and make sound, timely decisions in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.​​

  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and influence skills, with comfort presenting to executive audiences and representing the agency externally.​​

title: Engineer I, Combustion Tuning
description:
Engineer, Combustion Tuning Company Overview At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.

Role Overview

Apply advanced controls and combustion engineering principles to the commissioning, startup, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of Mitsubishi Power heavy-duty gas turbines. This role specializes in combustion tuning, emissions optimization, combustion dynamics mitigation, and operational performance improvement of Mitsubishi Power gas turbine fleet. Responsibilities include analyzing combustion and turbine operating data, developing and implementing tuning strategies, supporting field startup and commissioning activities, diagnosing combustion-related issues, and ensuring reliable, compliant turbine operation across a range of operating conditions.

Key Responsibilities
  • These duties and responsibilities are in addition to Engineer I and Engineer II, Turbine Controls.
  • Have a thorough understanding of the theory of the combustion process in industrial/large frame gas turbines.
  • Have a thorough knowledge of the combustion dynamics that occur in an industrial/large frame gas turbine.
  • High-level knowledge and capabilities within Digital Control Systems (Netmation, Ovation, SPPA-T3000, TXP, Speedtronic Mark VI/VIe, etc.).
  • Knowledge of control and complex areas within control scheme as well as use and application as it relates to operation and troubleshooting for onsite execution.
  • Able to perform combustion tuning on all classes of Mitsubishi Power gas turbines. This is to include the procedure for tuning, the process to perform countermeasures for pressure fluctuations encountered, and performance of special tuning such as load overshoot and Fuel Gas Temperature tuning.
  • Knowledge and application of advanced control concepts such as Cascade Control, Feed Forward, PID tuning, bumpless transfers, etc.
  • Have a thorough knowledge of the administrative requirements at the completion of combustion tuning to include customer and internal reporting.
  • Provide start-up commissioning, operations and/or troubleshooting support for equipment failures and determine root cause analysis and implement solutions.
  • Perform on-site combustion tuning of Mitsubishi Power gas turbines, using knowledge of combustion dynamics and Mitsubishi combustion tuning software.
  • Provide calibration of field devices.
  • Verify slot assignment, output, transmitter, failsafe structure, connections, display, system/loop check, operational, functional and tuning of Mitsubishi Power GT controllers.
  • Program Mitsubishi logic controllers.
  • Perform instrument loop calculation and operation set points.
  • Prepare and submit accurate reports regarding conditions, required actions and obtained results.
  • Review of other teams members controls and tuning reports for accuracy;
  • Perform other such duties as may be required.
  • Heavy overnight travel (at least 70%) by land and/or air.
Other Duties and Responsibilities
  • Comply with all safety policies, practices and procedures, reporting all unsafe activities to Management and/or Human Resources.
  • Participate in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals.
  • Contribute to building a positive team spirit.
  • Communicate effectively with all levels of employees.
  • Protect confidential information by not communicating, disclosing to, or using it for the benefit of third parties.
  • Always maintain the highest degree of honesty and integrity.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree (BA) in Engineering from four-year college or university plus three (3) years of experience; or at least five (5) years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. In lieu of experience, the candidate will have successfully completed the Controls and Tuning Training Development Program.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Knowledge of database, project management, spreadsheet and word processing software, electronic mail, graphics, technical diagrams, flow charts, etc.
  • Travel is required in this role, as you will be assigned to be on-site during outages

  • Tuition reimbursement and on-the-job training.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
  • Committed to quality products and services.
  • Great working environment and culture.

You will blend strategic planning, hands-on problem-solving, and team leadership. You will navigate between managing preventative maintenance programs, coordinating with operations teams, and responding to emergencies that require quick, decisive action while also balancing proactive planning with real-time problem resolution.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include but are not limited to:

title: Director of People and Talent
description:
Lead isofy's people function, from first interview to career growth.

Summary:

We are seeking a hands-on and experienced Director of People & Talent to own the employee experience, from recruiting and onboarding through development, compensation, performance, and retention. This role will lead our recruiting efforts, manage day-to-day People operations, help employees and managers grow, and build practical systems that allow us to attract and retain exceptional talent as the company continues to scale.


This is a highly hands-on role. The Director of People & Talent will personally manage recruiting, payroll and benefits administration, employee programs, and many of the day-to-day activities of the People function while also serving as a trusted advisor to company leadership. They will help create a culture where expectations are clear, feedback is productive, strong performance is recognized, employees have opportunities to grow, and people enjoy working together.


Key Duties:

  • Lead recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding across the company.
  • Own day-to-day People operations, including payroll, benefits, employee records, policies, and employee lifecycle administration.
  • Build and improve career development, compensation, performance management, and employee development practices.
  • Serve as a trusted resource to employees and managers while helping strengthen engagement, retention, teamwork, and company culture.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead full-cycle recruiting across technical, operational, sales, and other roles, working directly with hiring managers to define needs, source candidates, conduct interviews, and make strong hiring decisions.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent recruiting and interview process, including job descriptions, interview plans, candidate evaluation, reference checks, offers, and candidate communication.
  • Represent the company at career fairs, university events, community events, and other opportunities to develop relationships with prospective employees.
  • Own the employee onboarding process and continuously improve how new employees are introduced to the company, their teams, expectations, and responsibilities.
  • Manage payroll, benefits administration, employee records, HR systems, and relationships with relevant People and benefits vendors.
  • Maintain employment policies, employee documentation, and People processes, coordinating with outside advisors and employment counsel when specialized guidance is required.
  • Partner with leadership on headcount planning and hiring priorities, helping determine what roles the company needs and when.
  • Develop and maintain practical career ladders, role levels, competencies, compensation bands, and promotion criteria that give employees greater clarity around expectations and advancement.
  • Advise leadership on employee compensation and executive compensation packages using market data, performance, and company needs.
  • Own the company's performance review and feedback processes and help managers establish clear expectations, provide constructive feedback, recognize strong performance, and address performance concerns.
  • Work directly with employees on professional development opportunities, including effective verbal and written communication, meeting leadership, giving and receiving feedback, organization, and other foundational workplace skills.
  • Coach managers on becoming stronger people leaders, including setting expectations, providing feedback, having difficult conversations, developing employees, and creating accountability within their teams.
  • Serve as an approachable, trusted, and discreet resource for employees who need guidance, want to raise concerns, or would benefit from support navigating workplace situations.
  • Help managers and leadership navigate employee relations matters, performance concerns, corrective action, conflict resolution, and other sensitive employee situations.
  • Develop practical initiatives to improve employee retention and identify emerging retention risks before they become departures.
  • Conduct exit interviews and use employee feedback and turnover patterns to identify opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Plan and coordinate company outings, team-building activities, recognition efforts, and other initiatives that create stronger relationships and a greater sense of connection across the company.
  • Help leadership identify employees ready for additional responsibility and work with managers and employees to create meaningful advancement and development opportunities.
  • Gather and monitor a focused set of People metrics, including hiring activity, retention, compensation, employee feedback, and other indicators useful to company leadership.
  • Continuously improve People practices as the company grows while avoiding unnecessary process, bureaucracy, or complexity.


Key Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience across Human Resources, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, People Partnership, or related functions.
  • Experience working in a growing organization where the People function requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
  • Strong recruiting experience with the ability to source, evaluate, attract, and close high-quality candidates across a variety of roles.
  • Experience managing or supporting payroll, benefits administration, HR systems, employee records, and other core People operations.
  • Experience with performance management, employee development, compensation, career development, or related People programs.
  • Ability to coach employees and managers on communication, feedback, performance, professional development, and leadership.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive employee matters and confidential information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build trust with employees at all levels of the company.
  • Practical, organized, and comfortable personally owning the details rather than relying on a large supporting HR team.
  • Ability to balance employee advocacy with the needs, expectations, and performance standards of the business.
  • Experience in a technology, SaaS, professional services, or similarly fast-moving organization is preferred.
  • Experience supporting distributed or international employees is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. SHRM, PHR, or comparable professional certification is a plus.


Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Professional development assistance
  • Vision insurance

title: ULP Uniform Loss Prevention
description:
Job Description

Pay Range: $18.00/hr-$22.00/hr

Position: ULP Uniform Loss Prevention Agent and ULP Uniform Loss Prevention Agent PT

Department: Loss Prevention

Supervisor: LP Field Supervisor

Status: Hourly, Nonexempt, Full Time and Part Time

The Uniform Loss Prevention Agent responsibility is to ensure the safety and security of our premises, assets, vendors, team members, and customers. Walking the premises, investigating suspicious behavior, and enforcing company policies.

Job Duties:

  • Investigate suspected shrinkage by employees
  • Following and confronting suspected shoplifters
  • Documenting theft and other security violations
  • Work with law enforcement to arrest/prosecute suspected shoplifters & dishonest employees
  • Safely apprehend and detain potential shoplifters
  • Provide court testimony

  • Observe all shoppers, vendors and team members
  • Develop and maintain records of apprehensions, and evidence
  • Maintain public order at assigned stores and/or company events

Requirements:

  • You must keep your supervisors and store managers informed of your activities, as well as interact with store management and store security to alert them to possible problems
  • Must be able to travel to different locations as assigned
  • Must be able to appear in all criminal court hearings and prosecutions

  • Able to work independently as well as on a team
  • Ability to quickly build rapport
  • High energy with a sense of urgency while remaining professional and collected
  • Fluent in English and Spanish a plus
  • Must have excellent report writing and documentation to identify: Who, what, where, when, why and how.

  • Must be able to approach and detain suspects. Including but not limited to: running, hands-on detaining suspects, physically blocking passage of suspects, etc.

  • Bending, Squatting, Kneeling, Reaching above shoulder level and below, Crawling

title: Projektleder til afløbs- & forsyningsprojekter
description:
Vil du have ansvaret for komplekse afløbs- og forsyningsprojekter? Kan du skabe fremdrift, samle forskellige fagligheder og opbygge stærke relationer til kunder og øvrige interessenter? Og motiveres du af at lede projekter, der skaber reel værdi for samfundet? Så bliv en del af COWI og vær med til at skabe de løsninger, der muliggør en bedre fremtid.

Arbejd på projekter, der skaber værdi for kommende generationer

For at understøtte den fortsatte vækst i vores forretningsområde Climate, Utilities & Infrastructure, søger vi en senior afløbsingeniør eller projektleder til vores team i Kgs. Lyngby. I COWI arbejder vi med nogle af Danmarks vigtigste separatkloakeringsprojekter samt afvandings- og klimatilpasningsprojekter, og vi udvider vores projektportefølje.

Som projektleder får du det samlede ansvar for at lede afløbs- og forsyningsprojekter fra de første idéer til færdigt anlæg. Du skaber retning og fremdrift, sikrer et tæt samarbejde med kunden og koordinerer tværfaglige projektteams. Samtidig bringer du din tekniske forståelse i spil, så projekterne leveres med høj kvalitet og skaber robuste og bæredygtige løsninger for lokalsamfund i hele Danmark.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Styre afløbs- og forsyningsprojekter fra tilbud og planlægning til projektering, udførelse og aflevering og sikre fremdrift og kvalitet på projekterne
  • Understøtte den faglige udvikling i teamet og bidrage med teknisk sparring inden for separatkloakering, afvanding og klimatilpasning
  • Udvikling af afvandings modeller og tekniske løsninger til håndtering af regnvand og separering af spildevand
  • Tæt kontakt med kunder, entreprenører, myndigheder og øvrige interessenter gennem projektforløbet
  • Bidrage til tilbudsarbejde, teknisk dokumentation og projektplanlægning
  • Holde dig opdateret på gældende praksis, lovgivning og innovation inden for separatkloakering og klimatilpasning

Dine kompetencer. Vores team. Sammen designer vi fremtiden

For at få succes i rollen er det vigtigt, at du trives med samarbejde og skaber stærke relationer til både kolleger, samarbejdspartnere og kunder. Du opbygger tillid gennem respektfuld adfærd og ved at levere på dine løfter. Samtidig er du nysgerrig og søger løbende nye indsigter og forbedringsmuligheder.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du har:

  • En uddannelse som civilingeniør eller tilsvarende inden for vej-, miljø-, vand- eller infrastrukturområdet
  • Minimum 5 års erfaring med separatkloakering, spildevands- og regnvandsprojekter
  • Erfaring med Byggeledelse og tilsyn
  • En engageret tilgang og stor interesse for bæredygtige vandløsninger
  • Behersker dansk på professionelt niveau i både tale og skrift og kan kommunikere klart og præcist med såvel tekniske som ikke-tekniske interessenter.

En arbejdsplads og meget mere

Hos COWI arbejder vi sammen med vores kunder om at skabe en bæredygtig og attraktiv verden. Vi bruger vores viden, nysgerrighed og mod til at udvikle de løsninger, verden har brug for i dag, for at skabe en bedre fremtid. Vi hjælper vores kunder i retning af øget bæredygtighed og går forrest ved at integrere miljøhensyn, social ansvarlighed og god virksomhedsledelse i vores arbejde og de løsninger, vi tilbyder.

Vi værdsætter forskellighed, udvikling og et solidt fællesskab. Vi ønsker at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til både faglighed, trivsel og arbejdsglæde, fordi det får det bedste frem i os alle.

Med kontorer primært i Norden, Storbritannien, Nordamerika og Indien er vi mere end 7.500 medarbejdere, som hver dag bringer vores faglige viden inden for ingeniørfag, arkitektur, energi og miljø i spil.

Har du spørgsmål?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller til COWI som arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Discipline Karina Finch Schandorf Petersen på KFSF@COWI.COM.

Du kan læse mere om os på , hvor du kan blive klogere på vores projekter, strategi og hverdagen i COWI.

Inden du søger

Vi har kun brug for dit CV. Du behøver ikke vedlægge hverken foto eller ansøgning. Til samtalen får du mulighed for at fortælle os mere om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af COWI. Vi foretrækker at danne vores første indtryk af dig personligt frem for gennem et billede.

Mangfoldighed er fundamentalt for COWI, og inklusion er nøglen

Vi er forpligtet til at skabe et respektfuldt og retfærdigt arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle medarbejdere har en følelse af tilhørsforhold og oplever lige muligheder for at trives og vokse. Vi sikrer, at vores ledere er rollemodeller for inkluderende lederskab ved at dyrke en kultur, hvor forskellige perspektiver og forestillinger ses som ressourcer. Vi tager hensyn til mangfoldighed og inklusion i alle relevante beslutninger og processer, og når vi sammensætter teams og fora. Vi gør det, fordi det er en del af vores værdier, og fordi det er det rigtige at gøre.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



The Unified Configuration Management team within Cloud & Production Engineering is mission-critical to Docusign's reliability and deployment speed. We architect and maintain internal platforms for progressive delivery, providing the infrastructure for feature flagging, experimentation, and configuration management. Our scope extends to Change Insights, where we develop advanced correlation models to pinpoint incident root causes within minutes. We empower engineering teams to release features with velocity and confidence while ensuring our customers benefit from granular feature control and system stability.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Engineering Manager, Unified Configuration Management.

Responsibility

  • Design, author, and audit technical designs for features and components. Own the end-to-end delivery of well-defined features by executing assignments independently with moderate guidance
  • Develop and maintain high-quality, scalable back-end services. This includes building and scaling the robust services, component libraries, and maintaining Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines for safe deployments across Azure and GCP
  • Author and own comprehensive testing plans, writing high-quality, reliable tests (unit, component, E2E). Drive quality by demonstrating competence in debugging across multiple components, environments, and external dependencies to ensure features are testable, observable, and safe to roll out
  • Implement and refine telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), dashboards, and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Participate in on-call rotations, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for issues, and use data to drive operational improvements and strengthen runbooks
  • Work within the Agile framework, proactively identifying dependencies and critical paths, proposing mitigation plans, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to resolve blockers. Drive continuous improvement by developing efficiencies to scale processes and staying current with emerging technologies

Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of professional experience building back-end, platform, or reliability-focused services
  • Experience with at least one modern programming language (C#, Java, or Go)
  • Experience in distributed systems, data structures, and production reliability fundamentals
  • Experience with web services, APIs (REST/gRPC), and working with JSON/structured data
  • Experience with Git, complex CI/CD workflows, automated testing frameworks, and Agile practices
  • Experience leveraging coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for problem solving, debugging, profiling, and documentation

Preferred

  • Experience building and operating back-end services in Azure or GCP, with hands-on experience using Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Expertise in progressive delivery, configuration management, or feature-flagging systems (e.g., Optimizely)
  • Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) to debug system health and correlate incidents
  • Strong incident response background: experience with on-call rotations, root-cause analysis (RCA), and operational readiness reviews
  • Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end, including design trade-offs, rollout strategies, and post-launch support

Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

description:

Vi arbejder med markedsdesign, kapacitetsberegning og flaskehalshåndtering, så elnettet udnyttes bedst muligt. Opgaverne spænder fra at forstå komplekse udfordringer til at udvikle løsninger med reel betydning for markedet. Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor dit arbejde er med til at skabe fremtidens energisystem.

”Vi er et team, der gerne afprøver nye tilgange og lærer undervejs. Når noget er komplekst, går vi systematisk til værks, deler vores viden og finder en enkel vej frem. Det vigtigste er, at du bringer din nysgerrighed i spil – resten finder vi ud af i fællesskab,” udtaler cheføkonom, Jim Vilsson.

I løbet at dit første år i jobbet har du:

  • Opbygget solid faglig forståelse for det europæiske elmarked og flow based kapacitetsberegning
  • Leveret analyser, der har skabt konkrete forbedringer i driftsprocesser
  • Bidraget til at udvikle og optimere flow based-modeller og -beregningsmetoder
  • Identificeret og realiseret muligheder for at automatisere og effektivisere

”Jeg lægger vægt på, at du bliver i stand til at tage ansvar for komplekse analyse- og optimeringsopgaver fra idé til implementering, samtidig med at du opbygger gode samarbejdsrelationer og bliver en faglig sparringspartner for kolleger og interessenter,” siger Nikolaj Nåbo Andersen, Senior Manager.

Analytisk profil med erfaring med dataanalyse

Du har en relevant længere videregående uddannelse fx ingeniør, matematik, økonomi, datalogi, energisystemer eller lignende. Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Har gode analytiske evner og trives med at arbejde med komplekse problemstillinger, data og modeller
  • Har forståelse for, hvordan data, modeller og processer kan anvendes til at optimere driften og understøtte beslutninger
  • Har erfaring med dataanalyse og programmering, fx Python, SQL eller tilsvarende værktøjer
  • Kan strukturere store og komplekse problemstillinger og omsætte dem til konkrete analyser, løsninger og anbefalinger
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau – og kan formidle komplekse tekniske og analytiske problemstillinger til forskellige målgrupper både skriftligt og mundtligt

Derudover er du en person, der stiller spørgsmål, udfordrer eksisterende løsninger og søger at forstå, hvordan tingene hænger sammen. Du kan dykke ned i detaljer uden at miste overblikket, og du er optaget af at finde og implementere løsninger, der skaber værdi. Samtidig trives du med at arbejde på tværs af fagligheder og skaber fremdrift gennem dialog og involvering.

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel sammen med os?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV senest 12. oktober. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online i uge 43, og
2. samtale i Fredericia 26. oktober.

Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Nikolaj Nåbo Andersen på tlf. 2333 8993.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Jobbet kræver desuden, at du kan opnå og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelse. På PET's hjemmeside kan du læse mere om sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Systemansvar, hvis kerneopgaver er at indpasse vedvarende energi, sikre lige adgang til nettene, udvikle markedsdesign, overvåge og balancere transmissionsnettet og at varetage forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

title: Specialist, Certification Exam Developer
company: ASSOCIATION FOR MATERIALS PROTECTION AND PERFORMANCE
description:
JOB TITLE: Certification Exam Developer Specialist
DIVISION: AMPP
DEPARTMENT(S): Certification
REPORTS TO: Sr. Director, Credentialing & Sr. Director Operations
FLSA STATUS: Exempt REVISION

SUMMARY
The Certification Exam Developer position is responsible for the development, maintenance, and performance monitoring of AMPP certification examinations including exam updates. In addition, the role will be required to perform facilitation of in-person and virtual meetings with subject matter experts to ensure that the end-result is based on actual job role requirements. Examples of tasks include exam development, item writing, item referencing, item bank maintenance, preparation of materials for item review and preparation of exam forms for Test Production. This individual will also ensure that all exams meet or exceed legal defensibility process and policy requirements as stipulated by the AMPP Certification program office. Detailed focus on items quality and exam security is central to this role.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
• Competency Model Facilitation: Organize and assist in the facilitation of face-to-face competency modeling workshops. Keep current the competency model that delineates performance and knowledge/skills used as the basis for development of exams. Frequency and criticality of tasks performed is collected so that the objectives are prioritized and weighted. Breakdown tasks that make up a specific role, based on input by subject matter experts (SMEs) who are currently performing that function. All high-stakes certification exams are based on the competency model through the blueprint process
• Blueprint Utilization: After the objectives are prioritized and weighted, the number of exam items is determined.
• Exam Quality Process: Organize and conduct face-to-face or remote item development workshops. Manage vendor-produced exam development work, activities, and deliverables. Train subject matter experts and vendors on writing technically sound exam items. Create items (questions) to ensure test takers meet a defined level of performance and knowledge/skills. Oversee item review for technical content, validity, items standards, and grammatical. Prepare the item bank for final exam publishing and ensure there is a complete Exam Preparation Guide (EPG).
• Standard Setting Methodology: Organize and assist in the facilitation of standard setting workshops: Manage SMEs recruiting, scheduling, set up and administration of exam and ratings in Exam Developer.
• Exam Performance: Given data analysis monitor the continued validity and reliability of exams during the period in which they are active. Track the performance of exams and items; when necessary, revise and/or remove items. Verify that the exams meet the target audience and program needs.
• Project Management: Manage development of certification exams. Organize and facilitate project meetings, develop status reports, manage schedules and deadlines, initiate and maintain strategic relationships and partnerships. Assure quality of deliverables
• Support team members: Collaborate with Exam development coordinator when responding to Certification Exam mailbox, posting volunteer opportunities, and workshop logistics.
• Translations: Implement appropriate methods for translating exams to maintain test security, reduce bias and improve quality.
• Board Liaison: work with the Boards to recruit SMEs, program changes and initiatives

title: Lamina Operator
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

This position is in charge of configurating the lamination machine and feed a foil laminated front sheet to match it to the back paper sheet, This operator ensures that registration, alignment and quality standards are being met.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Being able to feed a thin plastic sheet individually and efficiently to the machine
  • Guarantee that the material coming out of the machine is clean and according to quality standards.
  • Check the material for problems or abnormalities and report them to their lead supervisor
  • Ability to work as a part of a team.
  • Basic machine comprehension will be necessary

OTHER FUNCTIONS

  • Knowledge of machine operational procedures.
  • Filling out paperwork and reports.
  • Being able to differentiate different types of materials used.
  • Being able to look efficiently for blemishes or abnormalities on the material.
  • Inspect and adjust machine as necessary.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Being able to stand up for long periods of time
  • Being able to carry up to 40lbs
  • Sharp Vision
  • Bending down from time to time.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Being able to read and write.
  • Being able to follow instructions.
  • Mechanical skills preferred.

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

Skills/Experience:

  • 0-3 years previous experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred
  • Proficiency in operating manufacturing machinery

title: Principal Project Manager
description:
The principal Project Manager is responsible for planning, leading, executing, monitoring,
controlling, and closing of IFS projects. They are accountable for the entire project scope, project
team, resources, and the success of the project.


The Principal Project Manager is acting on behalf of IFS as a focal point of expertise to ensure the
Value Realization to the Customer and Revenue Generation to IFS. Key to this is a firm
understanding of Project Management in general and the IFS Methodologies in particular,
highlighting the ability to gain trust from both the Customer and the IFS teams.
The Principal Project Manager enjoys the challenge of being the key driver, decision maker,
engager, and motivator in projects, while consistently having control of both short- and long-term
revenue realization along with set KPIs.

As a Principal Project Manager, you will be responsible for core activities including, but not limited
to:

  • Act as a recognized authority on IFS contract structures, ensuring best practices in contract interpretation and application.
  • Develop and oversee enterprise-level project strategies, ensuring alignment with business
  • objectives.
  • Lead large-scale, high-impact projects, optimizing resource allocation for maximum efficiency.
  • Establish advanced project governance, integrating financial controls, forecasting, and risk management.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and strategic insights to the Project Steering Group and senior leadership.
  • Spearhead complex risk management initiatives, developing proactive mitigation strategies.
  • Define and oversee the strategic management of Change Requests, ensuring minimal disruption and maximum value.
  • Drive executive engagement on IFS Success Offerings, positioning them to support business growth.
  • Lead cross-functional teams, ensuring seamless coordination and optimal performance.
  • Shape talent development strategies, mentoring future project leaders.
  • Establish thought leadership within the Project Management network, influencing industry best practices.
  • Drive innovation in project delivery, leveraging industry trends and insights.
  • Champion upsell strategies through Sales Performance Incentive Fund (SPIFF), enhancing customer engagement and value realization.
  • Build and maintain high-level relationships with key stakeholders, positioning projects for long-term success.
  • Act as a recognized authority in ensuring project quality and adherence to the IFS Implementation Methodology.
  • Define strategic direction and best practices for service delivery, setting high performance expectations for consulting teams.
  • Provide thought leadership on implementation methodologies and ensure clarity of activities across all project phases.
  • Cultivate high-value relationships within IFS and externally, reinforcing trust and fostering long-term partnerships.
  • Drive executive-level communication and stakeholder engagement, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Champion seamless collaboration between Project Managers, Solution Architects, and Leads to enhance project efficiency and success.
  • Actively identify and leverage new business opportunities, engaging with Sales to expand IFS's impact.
  • Provide thought leadership on customer value drivers, ensuring IFS solutions are positioned as strategic enablers.
  • Drive commercial success by integrating business development efforts with the Sales team.
  • Lead by example, fostering a high-performance culture within the project team through motivation and strategic direction.
  • Resolve conflicts at an executive level, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Demonstrate expert-level political awareness, navigating complex stakeholder landscapes with professionalism.
  • Provide mentorship and coaching to other Project Managers, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to the IFS Global Consulting Strategy by assessing and improving methodologies, tools, and processes while considering their impact on other business functions.
  • Leverage global capabilities and best practices to enhance project delivery and business outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to IFS Global Consulting Management, R&D, and Unified Support, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Drive the advancement of best-in-class project management practices across the organization.
  • Influence and shape how IFS delivers services, challenging conventional approaches and driving cross-functional improvements.
  • Proactively assess and drive improvements in processes that impact multiple business units, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to refine methodologies, streamline workflows, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Influence and implement process optimizations that support continuous improvement across local, regional, and global teams
  • Lead and manage large, complex projects and programs, ensuring successful execution and alignment with business objectives.
  • Develop strategic plans that support long-term growth and sustainability within project management.
  • Cultivate high-performing teams by fostering collaboration, accountability, and a results driven culture.
  • Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities beyond the initial contract scope, including success offerings, upselling additional licenses, and managed services.
  • Leverage deep customer insights to recommend value-added solutions that enhance client satisfaction and drive business growth.
  • Provide strategic feedback to refine and improve IFS service and product offerings based on real-world project experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with sales, customer success, and consulting teams to align business opportunities with customer needs

In addition to this, you are also expected to:

  • Provide thought leadership on Enterprise Resources Planning (ERP) architecture, integrations, and best practices.
  • Define and implement project management strategies to optimize business outcomes.
  • Stay at the forefront of product advancements, shaping how they are leveraged in projects.
  • Champion IFS values, driving a culture of excellence and collaboration.
  • Lead high-level workshops and executive meetings to align stakeholders and drive strategy.

Essential:

  • University degree in a technical discipline, MBA, or equivalent processional qualification
  • Minimum 5-10 years of experience in project management.
  • Prior experience in managing ERP implementation projects (preferably full lifecycles)
  • Experience in working with C-level (Principal to Senior Principal)
  • Fluency in English and local language (verbal and written)


Desirable:

  • Solid knowledge of IFS Software
  • Participation in implementation of IFS Products
  • Specific Industry knowledge from target industries
  • Experience in delivering a broad range of IFS Consulting Services
  • Experience in conducting projects using an Agile methodology would be an asset
  • Certification in one of other Project Management methodologies Prince2 or Project
  • Management Professional (PMP) would be an asset

What We’re Offering

  • Salary Range: $133,600- $178,100 plus bonus
  • Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday
  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance
  • 401K with Company contribution
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Life insurance and disability benefits
  • Tuition assistance
  • Community involvement and volunteering events

At IFS, you will work in a growing global enterprise software company where informal hierarchies promote simplicity and trust with accountability. We strive to deepen our expertise by taking on challenging and varied work assignments in a collaborative environment alongside committed colleagues.

With professionalism and a strong customer focus in everything we do, from R&D to product development, we are committed to providing the best possible service to our customers. From sales to consulting, we are proud to serve world-class customers around the world with our flagship products.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity within our company.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. title: Senior Research Associate, Histology (Contract)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mirai Bio is a privately-held, Flagship-founded biotechnology company that is delivering genetic medicines from promise to performance. Mirai was built to solve one of the field’s central challenges: achieving precise, scalable delivery of diverse nucleic acid payloads to specific cells and tissues, particularly beyond the liver. By combining a large and growing proprietary in vivo biodistribution dataset, machine learning-guided lipid nanoparticle optimization, modular targeted particle design, and integrated translation and manufacturing capabilities, Mirai helps partners accelerate development, reduce technical risk, and pursue high-value programs making delivery a strategic advantage. We are seeking collaborative, relentless problem solvers that share our passion for defining the future of genetic medicines together.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Research Associate, Histology contractor to join the Platform Group at Mirai Bio to support laboratory research activities towards development of novel technologies enabling next generation genomic medicines. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of the technical and equipment needs in a lab as well as significant hands-on experience with standard histology, cell culturing and in vitro cell biology techniques. They will work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performing laboratory assays and tasks including processing tissues for histology, plate-based reporter assays and additional in vitro assays
  • Review data slides to streamline optimization and data analysis of immune histochemistry and immuno florescence readouts
  • Help manage external vendors and CRO in support of histology assays
  • Developing new assays or optimizing existing ones based on in-depth knowledge of laboratory techniques.
  • Analyzing and accurately documenting assay results in an electronic lab notebook or other technical reporting formats

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS or MS in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or related scientific discipline
    • BS + 5 years of relevant industry or research experience
    • MS + 3 years of relevant industry or research experience
  • Previous experience with histology evaluation and in vitro cell based assays is required
  • Strong cell culture experience, including experience executing protocols, troubleshooting assays is preferred
  • Prior experience working with lipid nanoparticles is a plus
  • Proven ability to work independently and cross-functionally with highly skilled teams in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and technical environment
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Motivated, curious, and comfortable working with highly technical projects and personnel
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical information in a clear and thorough manner

ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING:

Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths without fulfilling every qualification. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background and interest in Flagship.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

The salary range for this role is $38 - $51. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. title: Sterile Processing Technician
description:
Sterile Processing Technician

The Sterile Processing Technician is responsible for the cleaning, decontamination, preparation, assembly, sterilization, storage, and distribution of surgical instruments, supplies, and equipment. This position helps ensure that instruments and supplies are properly processed and readily available to support safe, efficient, and high-quality patient care. The Sterile Processing Technician works collaboratively with perioperative staff to meet the needs of scheduled surgical and procedural cases.


Primary Responsibilities:

  1. Support the mission, vision, and values of the organization.
  2. Follow established protocols for cleaning, decontaminating, preparing, packaging, disinfecting, sterilizing, and storing medical and surgical instruments, supplies, and equipment.
  3. Inspect, assemble, and prepare surgical instrumentation and instrument sets according to established procedures.
  4. Distribute medical and surgical supplies and equipment from sterile processing areas to appropriate areas within the facility.
  5. Adhere to standard precautions, including appropriate use of personal protective equipment.
  6. Follow safety procedures and manufacturer instructions when handling cleaning solutions, supplies, instruments, and equipment.
  7. Safely operate equipment used in sterile processing according to manufacturer instructions for use.
  8. Monitor, interpret, and document physical, chemical, and biological indicators for sterilization processes.
  9. Prepare and distribute surgical case carts according to physician preference lists and anticipated procedural needs.
  10. Inventory, receive, organize, and restock instruments and supplies used for sterile processing and surgical services.
  11. Maintain accurate documentation of sterilization processes and outcomes in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  12. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and appropriate workflow within sterile processing areas.
  13. Comply with organizational policies, regulatory and accreditation standards, and applicable professional guidelines.
  14. Communicate effectively and professionally with members of the perioperative team.
  15. Participate in quality improvement initiatives related to sterile processing services.
  16. Maintain the privacy and confidentiality of patient and organizational information.

title: Analyst II, Systems Operations
description:
Job Purpose

Working for Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) as part of the ICE Data Services Systems Operations team will provide you with the opportunity to experience supporting one of the most famous and widely known, publicly visible companies in the world. The technology we work with day to day is necessarily on the bleeding edge. Our triumphs and shortcomings make the news and give this position a level of excitement and importance not available in a typical operational/support role.

The Operations Support Analyst will provide immediate assistance to back office, support personnel, and IT staff to achieve the highest customer satisfaction and minimize the impact of IT related problems. The Operations Support Analyst must be a motivated team player that can see projects to completion, work independently, and be willing to assist other staff in areas not specific to their duties.

The Operations Support Analyst role is not a typical NOC/helpdesk role - it is part of a highly specialized support organization that is responsible for the daily operations of multiple industry leading trading exchanges, clearing systems, and data distribution services. This position requires identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving both internal system problems, as well as external customer-related IT issues. The role requires a blend of general technical and business knowledge, as well as a comprehensive understanding of the overall architecture of the ICE exchanges, divisions, clearing, and infrastructure. This position is not a Systems Administrator or Network Engineering position; however, prior experience in these areas is desirable. Job level will be determined based on years of relevant experience.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot day-to-day issues and provide direct support to engineering and IT support groups.
  • Work with internal partners to communicate important information about system maintenance, changes, events, and to address their concerns regarding any aspect of the services.
  • Interact with third-party vendors, coordinate, and collaborate with various internal business units.
  • Maintaining operations and administration of proprietary systems is an integral part of the position.
  • Assist other ICE staff with problem solving and escalation procedures.
  • Quickly assess an issue(s) and provide management with well-conceived short and long-term actions for restoration of service(s).
  • Ownership of production incidents including communication, escalation, and follow-up for root-cause analysis.
  • Understand the various trading and clearing platforms, data distribution services, general network architecture, and apply technical knowledge to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Prepare documentation for troubleshooting and escalation procedures.
  • Follow organizational practices regarding Incident, Problem, and Change Management along with the creation of database records for these disciplines.
  • Scheduling flexibility is required.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Systems/Application support experience OR Associates/Bachelor’s degree.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to be organized and decisive while under pressure, when managing urgent and critical production issues as and when they occur.
  • Team Player - able to interface/liaison effectively with a variety of technical/non-technical contributors throughout the organization.
  • Logical approach, critical thinking, and analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to identify the root cause(s) of a problem.
  • Demonstrate reliability, flexibility, and attention to detail.

Preferred Knowledge and Experience

  • Financial markets, trading, and clearing systems.
  • Technology and/or application support.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to debug/write shell scripts. Basic knowledge about Java Coding/Debugging.
  • Proficiency in Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Network and network forensic analysis (packet capture analysis).
  • Understanding and working knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, and Multicast technologies.
  • Working knowledge of internetworking and various LAN/WAN technologies.
  • Working knowledge of router, switch, firewall, and proxy technologies: Apache, DNS, LDAP.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring and support solutions; BigPanda, PagerDuty and Rundeck.

title: Integration & Test Engineer (Falcon & Dragon)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

INTEGRATION & TEST ENGINEER (FALCON & DRAGON)

You will work on launch vehicles and spacecraft that deliver satellites into Earth's orbit, ferry humans to and from the International Space Station, and ultimately extend humanity’s reach beyond the Earth and moon.   • Collaborate with other engineers, subject matter experts, and technicians to solve large-scale production challenges
  • Work with design engineers to evaluate designs for manufacturability and implementation in a rapidly evolving production environment
  • Resolve product non-conformances and collaborate with the quality team to implement root cause corrective actions
  • Identify, plan, and execute capital equipment, machine, and layout upgrades to meet volume production demand
  • Develop and refine floor layouts, capacity models, and product flow analysis to ensure on-time vehicle delivery to manifest

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace, materials or industrial engineering
  • 1+ years of engineering experience in manufacturing or production (internship and school projects experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master’s degree in mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace, materials or industrial engineering
  • Involvement in a professional engineering society or collegiate design project
  • Experience with the build, assembly, or integration of large mechanical assemblies
  • Knowledge of metallic manufacturing techniques, processes, and equipment related to welding, metal forming, fastening, drilling, bonding and automation
  • Mechanical component and/or tooling design and analysis experience using 3D CAD software
  • Experience with design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA)
  • Experience transition complex products from R&D to high-volume manufacturing in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience writing work instructions and procedures for critical aerospace parts
  • Experience in a production environment within the aerospace industry

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:
Level I: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00/per year
Level II: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Director Global Tax
description:
Job Summary


The Director Global Tax will oversee ICAT Logistics Global and US tax planning and compliance for the Company’s legal entities, optimizing ICAT’s global tax positions, ensuring compliance, and driving strategic initiatives through hands-on execution and cross-functional collaboration. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely tax filings, managing relationships with external tax service providers, and coordinating closely with internal accounting, legal, and operations to gather and validate compliance data. The position will review tax calculations, support schedules, and related journal entries, while ensuring adherence to applicable tax laws and regulations. The Director Global Tax will lead process improvements, leverage tax technology to enhance efficiency, and act as the primary contact for audits, tax notices, and inquiries from partners and taxing authorities.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Tax Leadership

  • Track U.S. and international tax law developments to proactively identify risks and opportunities for the company.
  • Lead complex cross-functional projects (i.e.: Transfer Pricing, Global Tax structuring, Entity rationalization, M&A, etc.), partnering with external consultants and teams across Finance, Legal, HR, and other business units.
  • Develop and implement tax strategies that are aligned with and support business initiatives, including restructuring, business realignment, and transaction readiness.
  • Provide technical analysis and recommendations for organizational actions such as entity structure changes, capital management, and intercompany transaction optimization.
  • Collaborate regularly with Treasury and Finance to develop and execute cross-border cash flow strategies, manage intercompany settlements, and oversee ongoing repatriation activities.
  • Champion process automation and data analytics to enhance efficiency and transparency.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for tax implications and requirements throughout the organization.

US and Global Compliance & Reporting

  • Own the calculation, documentation, and ongoing review of global transfer pricing policies, ensuring alignment with business operations and evolving regulations.
  • Manage global tax compliance, including corporate income tax, VAT/GST, and withholding tax across multiple jurisdictions
  • Review and approve workpapers, supporting schedules, and journal entries related to tax accruals, payments, and refunds
  • Prepare the global income tax provision in accordance with US GAAP including quarterly and annual tax provision calculations and supporting workpapers
  • Oversee all aspects of international tax compliance, including U.S. calculations (Subpart F, GILTI, BEAT, FDII, 163(j), 987, FTC), and coordination of foreign compliance with external advisors.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of earnings and profits pools, tax pools, PTEP, U.S. tax basis, and required elections/disclosures for foreign subsidiaries.
  • Lead all aspects of BEPS compliance, including Country-by-Country Reporting and Pillar II GloBE minimum tax, proactively addressing risks and implementing required changes.
  • Lead quarterly and year-end income tax accounting for non-U.S. operations, ensuring alignment with IFRS, US GAAP, and local standards.
  • Serve as the primary contact for global tax audits and controversy management, coordinating with external advisors to defend positions and resolve disputes.

Leadership & Execution

  • Provide clear direction and guidance to geographically dispersed finance teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Demonstrate strong project management, analytical, and forensic accounting skills to ensure rigorous execution and clear audit trails.
  • Communicate complex tax concepts in accessible terms for non-tax stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Manage the selection and management of external tax advisors and vendors to maximize value, control costs, and ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Uphold high standards of ethics, internal control, and regulatory compliance.

We are not accepting inquiries from recruitment agencies or third-party vendors for this position. Unsolicited outreach will not be considered.

På grund af fortsat høj aktivitet og en stærk ordretilgang udvider vi endnu en gang vores EL-afdeling. Derfor søger vi en el-konstruktør, der har lyst til at blive en del af et voksende team, hvor samarbejde, faglig udvikling og teknisk kvalitet er i fokus.

Som el-konstruktør hos Gibotech bliver du en del af et stærkt teknisk miljø, hvor du arbejder med udvikling og konstruktion af automatiserede løsninger til industri- og hospitalssektoren. Du får en alsidig hverdag med kontakt til både mekanik, software, indkøb, produktion og montage, og du får mulighed for at præge de tekniske løsninger gennem hele projektforløbet.

Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for kolleger i både El-afdelingen samt andre afdelinger og får stor indflydelse på tekniske beslutninger samt udviklingen af fremtidens maskinløsninger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

I EL-afdelingen står et hold af engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger, som hjælper hinanden og deler viden på tværs af projekter klar til at tage i mod dig. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem samarbejde, sparring og en åben dialog, hvor alle bidrager med deres erfaring og idéer. Vi prioriterer faglig sparring højt og arbejder tæt sammen med både software-, mekanik-, projekt- og QHSE-afdelingen for at finde de bedste løsninger for vores kunder. Der er altid en kollega at spørge til råds, uanset om det drejer sig om tekniske udfordringer, standarder eller nye arbejdsmetoder.

Som en del af EL-afdelingen får du ansvar for egne projekter, hvor du arbejder med:

  • Elektrisk og pneumatisk konstruktion af maskiner og anlæg
  • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af el-dokumentation gennem hele projektforløbet
  • Valg af komponenter og tekniske løsninger i samarbejde med projektteamet
  • Udarbejdelse af indkøbslister og teknisk grundlag til indkøbsafdelingen
  • Sparring med mekanik-, software- og projektafdelingerne om den samlede maskinløsning
  • Teknisk support til produktion og montage under opbygning og idriftsættelse
  • Udvikling af testløsninger til tavletest og kvalitetssikring
  • Sikring af overholdelse af gældende standarder, sikkerhedskrav og dokumentationskrav med hjælp fra kvalitetsafdelingen
  • Bidrag til løbende udvikling og forbedring af afdelingens arbejdsgange, værktøjer og standarder

Du følger projekterne fra de første konstruktioner til den færdige levering og får dermed et bredt indblik i hele maskinens opbygning og funktion.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund som el-installatør, automationsteknolog, maskinmester, elektrisk konstruktør, stærkstrømstekniker eller lignende. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at udvikle dig og arbejde bredt med teknik.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med el-konstruktion eller teknisk projektarbejde
  • Har interesse for automation, maskinbygning og industrielle løsninger
  • Har forståelse for samspillet mellem el, mekanik og software
  • Er struktureret og kan holde overblik over både detaljer og helhed
  • Trives i samarbejde med forskellige faggrupper
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til løbende at udvikle dine kompetencer

Hvad du kan forvente hos os?

Hos Gibotech bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor teknologisk nysgerrighed, kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af fagområder, og du får mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for flere tekniske discipliner.

Du får ansvar og indflydelse på dine opgaver og er med hele vejen fra idé til drift. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af fagområder og står sammen, når løsningerne skal fungere i praksis – med fælles fokus på at skabe reel værdi for vores kunder.

Kulturen er uformel, tonen er direkte, og der er højt til loftet. Med base i Odense og projekter i både Danmark og udlandet tilbyder vi en varieret hverdag med tekniske udfordringer, stærkt kollegaskab, sociale arrangementer via personaleforeningen og heriblandt personalegoder som sodavand, morgenbrød, fredagsbar samt op til flere årlige sammenkomster.
