title: Sr. NVH Technician
description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary We are seeking an NVH Development Technician to drive hands-on noise and vibration development within our NVH team. This is a development-focused role: you will instrument vehicles, run subjective and objective NVH evaluations, build and iterate on countermeasures, and work side-by-side with engineering staff to root-cause and resolve challenging prototype issues. Vehicle repair and part-swap work is part of the job, but it exists in service of development — enabling rapid build-test-learn cycles on prototype hardware. The ideal candidate brings strong measurement and diagnostic instincts, a collaborative attitude, and the ability to deliver high-quality work with minimal supervision while helping improve the quietness and overall quality of Rivian vehicles. Responsibilities - Vehicle NVH development: Troubleshoot, diagnose, and develop solutions to vehicle noise and vibration issues across full-vehicle and subsystem levels, iterating on countermeasures and assessing their effectiveness. - Instrumentation & measurement: Plan and install NVH instrumentation on development vehicles, configure data acquisition systems, and capture high-quality measurement data for engineering analysis. - Test execution: Conduct road, track, and facility-based NVH evaluations; perform subjective assessments and document findings to support engineering decisions. - Development support: Partner with engineering teams to enable rapid build-test-learn cycles, turning proposed design changes into testable vehicle configurations quickly. - Capability building: Maintain and improve NVH instrumentation, tooling, and workshop capability; contribute to test procedures and best practices. - Vehicle readiness: Perform repairs, part changes, and inspections needed to keep development vehicles available and in known configuration. Qualifications - Demonstrated ability to root-cause vehicle NVH issues on prototype and development hardware, and to propose, build, and validate countermeasures. - Familiarity with NVH test methodologies (road and track evaluations, chassis dyno, static and operational testing) and the ability to execute test plans independently and repeatably. - Strong subjective evaluation skills, with the ability to describe, rate, and correlate vehicle NVH characteristics to measured data. - Experience fabricating, fitting, and iterating on development-level countermeasures (damping, isolation, sealing, absorption, bracketry) on prototype vehicles. - 5+ years of experience in automotive repair, prototype build, or a closely related technical field, with the ability to perform repairs, part swaps, and vehicle inspections in support of development work. - Strong understanding of vehicle systems, ideally EV architecture, with a focus on safety. - Organization & Work Ethic: Motivated self-starter with strong attention to detail, eagerness to learn, and the ability to support multiple development programs in a fast-paced environment. - Strong communication skills, clean driver's license, and ability to travel up to 20%. Pay Disclosure The Hourly rate range for this role is $51.44 - $64.30 for California based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com. Equal Opportunity Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. Candidate Data Privacy and Technology Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role. AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate. Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way. Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

title: Technical Lead, QA
description:
Who We Are
Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity.

With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure. PaletteAI Launchpads help teams start quickly with urgent outcomes such as VMware migration, token cost control or edge modernization, then scale into enterprise-wide lifecycle management, governance and fleet operations on the same platform.

About The Team
The Release Engineering QA team at Spectro Cloud owns the release quality of our core platforms. We are the final gate before every GA, patch, and hotfix reaches enterprise customers.
We operate at the intersection of modern cloud-native technologies and release engineering discipline. The team designs and maintains automated release pipelines and regression, upgrade, and compatibility test suites across APIs, UIs, and backend services, while pioneering AI-assisted workflows to accelerate test design, execution, and coverage. Given the breadth of our enterprise offerings, we certify complex release matrices across diverse Kubernetes distributions (such as K8s, K3s, and RKE2), operating systems, cloud providers, edge topologies, and air-gapped environments.
As release quality advocates, we collaborate closely with Software Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams throughout the release lifecycle. From defining release test strategies in TestRail and establishing automated CI/CD release gates to validating upgrades and verifying bug fixes, our mission is to deliver dependable, enterprise-grade releases to our global customers on a predictable cadence.

Minimum Qualifications
● 12+ years of IT experience with a strong track record in software quality engineering and test automation for complex, distributed systems.
● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
● Deep, hands-on experience designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up for both API and UI (must-have).
● Subject-matter expertise in Kubernetes: architecture, operators, CRDs, scheduling, storage, and multi-cluster topologies (must-have).
● Subject-matter expertise in networking: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, CNI plugins, service mesh, ingress/egress, and network policies (must-have).
● Hands-on experience testing AI inference workloads: GPU-based serving, model deployment frameworks (e.g., Triton, vLLM, KServe), throughput/latency benchmarking, and inference accuracy validation (must-have).
● Expert-level proficiency in Go, with production-quality code; comfortable reading and contributing to product code, not only test code.
● Extensive hands-on experience with containers and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or VMware/bare-metal).
● Strong proficiency in Linux-based operating systems and low-level troubleshooting/debugging (must-have).
● Demonstrated experience leading test architecture and technical direction across multiple teams as a Staff or Principal-level individual contributor.
● Proven ability to influence engineering peers and leadership without direct authority.
● Strong understanding of modern testing methodologies: contract testing, chaos/resilience testing, performance and scale testing, and CI/CD-driven quality gates.

Preferred Qualifications
● Deep experience leading development of automation using Go-based test frameworks like Godog at scale.
● Experience testing Kubernetes lifecycle management, cluster APIs (CAPI), or edge/IoT Kubernetes deployments.
● Experience with LLM/GenAI inference stacks, distributed inference, and GPU cluster operations.
● CKA, CKAD, or CKS certification.
● Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) applied to test infrastructure.
● Prior contributions to open-source Kubernetes or cloud-native testing projects.
● Track record of setting and delivering on multi-quarter technical strategy for quality/automation organizations.
● Experience partnering with customer-facing teams on escalations and driving preventative quality improvements from field learnings.

What We Offer

  • The On-Target Earnings for this role is $280,000-$304,0000 + Equity.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including 100% employer-paid base-level coverage for employees.

  • Retirement Savings: Access to a company-sponsored retirement savings plan.

  • Time Off: Flexible paid time off (PTO), 12 paid company holidays, and volunteer time off to support the causes you care about.

  • Paid Family Leave: Up to 12 weeks of paid maternity leave and 8 weeks of paid paternity leave.

  • Office Perks: Catered lunches on in-office days and a collaborative, team-oriented work environment.


This location for this role is based out of San Jose, CA. We are work in a hybrid capacity, with 3 days in office and 2 days remote.

Work Authorization/Visa: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer is unable to sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization for this opportunity now or in the future.

title: Sr. Director, Value Creation Insights
description:
What You'll Do

The Sr. Director, Value Creation Insights leads the analytics and insights function responsible for translating Avalara's commercial data into decisions that drive revenue growth, improve go-to-market efficiency, and advance the company's strategic priorities. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, operations, and strategy, owning a team of analysts, thought leaders, and analytics engineers who collectively serve as the quantitative backbone of Avalara. The team is approximately 30 people, blending onshore and offshore talent across multiple time zones, and the Sr. Director is expected to lead a globally distributed organization with the same rigor, cadence, and quality bar as a fully onshore team.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role. The Sr. Director operates as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations, and is expected to independently identify opportunities, build consensus across stakeholders, and drive analytical initiatives from inception through to adoption.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Revenue & Forecasting Analytics

  • Own the design and maintenance of Avalara's revenue forecasting models, including providing feedback on policy and revenue recognition
  • Lead development and governance of the demand generation reporting platform, which will serve as the company's primary source of truth for funnel performance including opportunity stage tracking, TOFU metrics, and marketing pipeline KPIs
  • Partner with FP&A on forecast methodology, variance analysis, and reconciliation
  • Drive identification and resolution of forecast discrepancies, including being the driver of discovery and remediation of any assumption misses

Predictive Modeling & Scoring

  • Lead the design and ongoing evolution of Avalara's prospect and customer scoring ecosystem, including product fit scores (A–D grade), propensity-to-buy models, ICP scoring\, and customer health metrics
  • Own the alignment process across GTM stakeholders to define model success metrics, validate predictive performance, and ensure score adoption by Marketing, Sales Development, and Sales
  • Drive operationalization of scoring tools by ensuring models are not only built but actively embedded into sales workflows, SDR outreach, prospect targeting, and account prioritization

Data Infrastructure & Governance

  • Oversee the team's analytics engineering function, including Fivetran-based ingestion, dbt model development, Snowflake schema design, and data pipeline quality for commercial datasets
  • Own the integration and governance of third-party data sources including ZoomInfo, Cognism, D&B, and Clay
  • Manage Snowflake data access, permissions, and ingestion pipelines for commercial data domains (Salesforce, Gong, Google Ads, AvaTax, Marketo, and more)
  • Partner with the Data Platform Engineering team on infrastructure decisions, the migration off legacy Hex / Power BI reporting onto Omni Analytics, and capacity planning
  • Own governance of core metric definitions and calculation logic (e.g., funnel stages, scoring inputs, forecast components) that feed into company-wide KPIs, ensuring consistency between this team's models and the definitions maintained centrally by GAI

AI-Enabled Analytics & Platform Modernization

  • Own and drive the AI roadmap for the team's analytical domains (forecasting, scoring, GTM/commercial analytics), defining where LLM-powered insight generation, conversational analytics, and agentic workflows create real business leverage
  • Lead the team's transition from traditional dashboard-based BI (Hex, Power BI) to Omni Analytics as the semantic layer and conversational analytics interface, including model/metric layer design so that natural-language querying returns governed, trustworthy answers
  • Design and ship AI agents embedded directly into GTM, Finance, and Sales workflows (e.g., automated deal/account insights, forecast variance flags, scoring explainability) rather than standalone reporting, with clear ownership of accuracy, guardrails, and adoption
  • Evaluate build-vs-buy tradeoffs for AI/LLM tooling, balancing speed, cost, data security, and long-term flexibility, and bring recommendations to the VP with a clear point of view

Stakeholder Partnership & Executive Communication

  • Serve as the analytics partner to senior leadership across Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Finance, translating complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable narratives
  • Drive cross-functional alignment on key company metrics including OKR definitions, MBO criteria, and performance measurement frameworks
  • Present analytical findings, forecast updates, and strategic recommendations directly to VP and C-suite stakeholders
  • Build and maintain a formal operating model with FP&A that ensures a single source of analytical truth reaches executive leadership

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop a team of roughly 30, including direct reports at the analyst to principal analyst level plus analytics engineers, across prospect analytics, value creation, marketing analytics, financial insights, and AI-enabled analytics, spanning onshore and offshore locations
  • Build and manage a globally distributed team model, including offshore hiring, onboarding, and time-zone-aware working norms that keep quality, security, and stakeholder responsiveness consistent regardless of location
  • Own performance management, goal setting, and career development for team members
  • Establish team prioritization processes, sprint cadences, and stakeholder intake workflows
  • Set technical and analytical standards for the team, including coding practices, modeling methodology, documentation, and reproducibility

Strategic Initiatives

  • Identify and drive high-priority analytical initiatives proactively by not simply responding to requests, but surfacing opportunities where data can create business value and taking ownership of moving those opportunities to action
  • Lead complex, organization-wide data transitions and knowledge transfers while protecting business partner continuity
  • Represent the team's AI-enabled analytics work in company-wide AI and automation forums, and bring back emerging tooling, patterns, and risks relevant to the team's roadmap

What Success Looks Like

Business partners proactively seek out the team's analytical perspective before making key decisions

  • Scoring models and analytical tools are embedded in day-to-day GTM workflows
  • Business partners get trustworthy answers via conversational analytics and embedded AI agents for a majority of routine questions, freeing the team to focus on higher-value analysis
  • Forecasts and models are methodologically sound, documented, and reproducible with clear telemetry connecting analytical work to business outcomes
  • The team operates with transparency: work is documented, peer-reviewed, and can be picked up by any team member
  • Executive leadership has a single, trusted analytical foundation that serves as the ground for insights and narrative


What You'll Need to be Successful

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or data engineering, with at least 4 years in a people management role
  • Deep expertise in Snowflake, SQL, dbt, and modern data stack tooling; experience with Omni, Power BI, Hex, or similar BI/semantic-layer platforms
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-powered / conversational analytics tools and building AI agents or automated workflows on top of a governed data model (vs. one-off prompting); able to distinguish genuine analytical leverage from AI novelty
  • Experience building and managing distributed teams that blend onshore and offshore talent across time zones, with a track record of sustaining quality, security, and stakeholder trust at that scale
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and machine learning concepts applied to commercial use cases
  • Proven ability to work with and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions
  • Experience owning complex, multi-stakeholder analytical initiatives from problem framing through to business adoption
  • Exceptional communication skills with strong ability to translate technical output into executive-ready narratives
  • SaaS business model fluency, including ARR, GRR, NRR, bookings, revenue recognition, and GTM funnel mechanics
  • Experience with Salesforce data, marketing automation platforms, and CRM analytics a strong plus


Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Early Childhood Specialist I
description:
Job Summary:

The Early Childhood Specialist I is part of a transdisciplinary early intervention team that provides developmental intervention to infants and toddlers with disabilities and their families in natural and inclusive environments who are found to be eligible for Early Start services at EPU. With the family at the center, ECS serves as the Primary Provider for the family and manages communication, consultation, and skill-sharing across disciplines to support seamless transdisciplinary service delivery, reduce fragmentation, and confusion for families.

Essential Functions:

  • Serve as primary provider to ensure all early intervention activities and services meet the outlined objectives and goals of the Individualized Family Service Plan (IFSP) for assigned infant and toddlers with disability and their families.
  • Responsible to understands and demonstrates appropriate dispositions of the Six Foundational Principles as outlined in the Early Start Personnel manual.
  • Identify child and family strengths, typical routines and activities, preferred teaching and learning strategies in partnership with the family.
  • Provide direct services for all children/families on case load in natural and inclusive environments. Maintain a minimum of 45% productivity threshold during a regular 40-hour work week schedule. Direct service productivity standard will be modified based on individual staff’s scheduled work hours.
  • Implement evaluation and assessment activities in accordance with current state laws, regulations, and timelines. Conduct all necessary developmental assessment of assigned infants and families prior to scheduled IFSP meetings.
  • In coordination with the family and other team members involved, design, develop and set goals and objectives that are developmentally appropriate, functional in nature, and related to on-going routines of the natural environments for the family.
  • Facilitate and support a communication process with the family and team regarding evaluation and assessment procedures and outcomes.
  • Complete Hawaii Early Learning Profile (HELP birth through 3) on a regular basis to track child’s development and inform individualized early intervention service approach for each child/family in care.
  • Prepare comprehensive written and/or oral reports that integrate own findings and results from parents/caregivers, other agencies/ professionals, emphasizing child strengths and functional concerns in developmental domains.
  • Collaborate with staff, family and other team members to link ongoing evaluation and assessment with all intervention planning utilizing the child and family’s everyday routines, relationships, places and partnerships.
  • Coach and support Early Intervention Assistants to assure designated services on the IFSP are provided in natural environments.
  • Make appropriate internal and external referrals for families served.
  • Participate in consultation and skill-sharing with specialty services (i.e. Speech, Occupational, Physical Therapist, and/or Parent Coach) when needed.
  • Seek understanding in the individual nature of child/family learning styles and adapt developmentally appropriate intervention strategies to better meet child/family individual needs, priorities and context.
  • Facilitate a smooth transition for child and family into next program placement.
  • Maintain, manage, and process client records and information in a confidential manner that meets HIPAA and other applicable confidentiality regulations.
  • Complete an accurate data entry for services rendered in the Apricot 360 system on a daily basis.
  • Foster strong collaboration, clear and consistent communication with the Service Coordinators at the Regional Center that are assigned to the infants/toddlers on caseload.
  • Seek guidance, coaching, supervision from the assigned Lead Early Childhood Specialist, schedule joint home visits and incorporate guidance and feedback to continuously learn, improve and grow in the work with infants, toddlers with disabilities and their families.
  • Position requires answering phones, various computer activities and driving of a vehicle for local travel.
  • Collaborate with community agencies who may also be serving the family assigned.
  • EPU facility hours are Monday – Friday; 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; however, ECS ensures non-traditional work hours are made available to serve and support families when warranted based on family needs. Therefore, position hours may vary, which may include evening or weekends, depending upon the needs of the program and families we serve.
  • The position requires the ability to meet with children/families outside of the EPU Center. In order to meet this expectation staff are required to have reliable transportation for local travel.
  • Required to hold valid California Driver's license and good driving record with no serious violations for the previous two-year period and be able to provide proof of current automobile liability insurance.
  • Required to perform other duties as they are assigned by the Director, Sr. Manager, Supervisor and/or President/Chief Executive Officer.

title: Vice President, Product Management
description:
WD seeks a visionary and commercially decisive Vice President of Product Management to lead the full lifecycle of our product portfolio — from strategic roadmap through market delivery and commercial execution. This is a high-impact enterprise leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer outcomes.

The VP of Product Management will own the integrated product strategy across Roadmap & Product Marketing driving alignment across R&D, Sales, Finance, and Operations to deliver profitable, market-leading storage solutions. This leader will shape how WD competes, grows, and wins in cloud, enterprise, and emerging segments.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), this role is a critical member of the product leadership team and is expected to be part of the succession plan for the current CPO.

Scope of Leadership

This role carries full VP-level organizational accountability, including:

  • Leading a multi-functional organization spanning Product Roadmap, Product Marketing & Product Introduction — each led by a Sr Director reporting directly to this role
  • Managing and developing Sr. Director/Director-level leaders, setting direction, building organizational health, and holding them accountable for results across their respective domains
  • Owning enterprise-wide product decisions that cross business units, geographies, and customer segments
  • Representing the product organization at the ELT level, in board-level discussions, with strategic customers, and in external forums
  • Setting the organizational culture and talent strategy for a large, globally distributed product management team

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Roadmap Leadership

  • Define and own the multi-year product roadmap strategy across HDD, SSD, and emerging storage platforms aligned to market segment needs
  • Drive strategic technology roadmaps and investment decisions for advanced storage solutions spanning cloud, enterprise, and consumer markets
  • Lead cross-functional alignment between R&D, Product, and Business units on technology direction and portfolio prioritization
  • Evaluate product architecture decisions and technology integration strategies, guiding teams on advanced storage technology implementation and risk mitigation
  • Establish product portfolio governance — balancing innovation investment, time-to- market, and customer commitments
  • Advise leadership on technology partnerships, acquisitions, and innovative investments that expand or strengthen the product portfolio
  • Drive critical product design reviews and technology assessments to ensure roadmap integrity and execution quality

2. Product Marketing

  • Lead the product marketing function to build compelling, differentiated value propositions for each market segment
  • Partner with Sales and the Chief Sales & Marketing Officer to develop go-to-market strategies for advanced storage technologies
  • Drive competitive positioning frameworks and customer-facing technical narratives that enable Sales to win
  • Lead strategic engagements with key customers to co-develop product roadmaps and validate market requirements
  • Champion WD's innovation story externally — at industry conferences, analyst briefings, media engagements, and customer forums
  • Build segment-specific messaging across cloud, enterprise, consumer, and emerging verticals

(A) Demand Planning

  • Lead demand planning processes in close partnership with Sales, Finance, and Operations to build accurate, forward-looking demand signals
  • Establish monthly and quarterly demand review cadences aligned to the S&OP process
  • Drive forecast accuracy improvement as a measurable organizational capability

(B) Supply Allocation

  • Own supply allocation decision frameworks that balance customer commitments, revenue optimization, and strategic account prioritization
  • Partner with Global Operations and Manufacturing on supply constraint scenarios and allocation trade-offs
  • Serve as the executive decision-maker for escalated allocation conflicts across business units and geographies

(C) Long-Term Agreements (LTAs)

  • Lead the strategy, negotiation framework, and governance for Long-Term Agreements with strategic customers
  • Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to structure LTAs that deliver volume commitments, pricing stability, and supply security
  • Ensure LTA portfolio is actively managed — tracking performance, renegotiation timelines, and risk exposure

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the primary product and commercial interface to Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations at the ELT level
  • Partner with Manufacturing and Operations teams to understand cost structures and production scalability that inform product and pricing decisions
  • Collaborate with Finance and Strategy teams on technology investment ROI analysis, business case development, and portfolio trade-offs
  • Develop and maintain strong executive relationships with key customers, analysts, and industry partners
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Business, or related field strongly preferred• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in product management, commercial strategy, or storage technology — with at least 3 years at the VP level or above
  • Proven experience leading Sr Directors and managing multi-functional organizations with enterprise-wide accountability
  • Demonstrated track record of owning full product lifecycle — from roadmap definition through commercial execution, pricing, and customer delivery
  • Deep experience in demand planning and supply allocation in a hardware or technology company
  • Strong business acumen with demonstrated ability to build and defend business cases, manage P&L drivers, and deliver revenue and margin results
  • Experience leading LTA negotiations with Tier 1 customers in enterprise or cloud markets
  • Exceptional executive communication skills — equally compelling in a boardroom, acustomer briefing, and a media interview
  • Willingness to travel internationally (25–30%), including Asia-Pacific regions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in HDD, SSD, NAND, or storage controller product management
  • Deep familiarity with cloud hyperscaler procurement dynamics and supply chain structures (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta)
  • Board or advisory experience with technology companies or academic institutions
  • Track record of driving significant revenue growth or margin improvement through product strategy and commercial execution
  • Experience leading organizations through a post-merger, post-split, or major business transformation

description:
Tatari is on a mission to revolutionize TV advertising. Founded in 2016 to help transform the antiquated world of TV advertising through the intelligent application of AI and machine learning, Tatari helps some of the world’s fastest growing brands including Chime, Calm, Tecovas, Manscaped, Saatva, and Liquid I.V., reach their customers using linear and streaming TV ads. Our platform combines sophisticated media buying with proprietary analytics to turn TV advertising into an automated, digital-like experience, enabling businesses of any size to advertise on TV.

That approach has earned Tatari broad industry recognition, including being named Best CTV AdTech Platform in the 8th annual MarTech Breakthrough Awards, as well as honors from Digiday (Best Connected TV Platform), AdExchanger (Most Innovative TV Advertising Technology), and Business Insider (Hottest AdTech Companies). Tatari has also been recognized as the Best Place to Work by Inc. Magazine. Backed by an executive team of former founders and senior leaders from companies including Shazam, TrueCar, AdapTV, LiveRail, Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Yahoo, Tatari continues to scale rapidly as TV advertising enters its next major era.

Tatari is looking for a part-time (20 hours weekly) People Operations Coordinator to join the People Operations (POPs) team. In this position, you will work closely with the USA POPs team to ensure that tasks and projects are executed to the same standards across the globe, and be the champion and voice for our global population. Some days that means making sure a new hire’s laptop actually arrives, and other days it’s untangling a benefits question or planning a virtual team event people genuinely want to attend. You make everyone at Tatari feel like one company, no matter what time zone you’re in.

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the liaison between USA POPs team and our team in Ukraine and Europe (~25 people)
  • Manage the full lifecycle of the European team and ensure that our practices are compliant and up-to-date with current regulation. This includes, but not limited to, helping with onboarding and offboarding, ensuring that payroll and expense management are completed on time, triaging benefit issues, data and record keeping are correct and updated, hardware management, etc.
  • Drive company culture, including planning and executing remote team building events, holding regular 1:1s to develop strong relationships with each person, etc.
  • Support minimum recruiting tasks, including scheduling interviews, conducting preliminary interviews for open roles on the European team, etc.
  • Be part of the broader POPs team and help with ad hoc projects, such as planning large company events, translating documentation for the internal website, etc.

Qualifications:

  • This is a part-time position and requires working hours of 4-8pm Kyiv time on business days
  • 1+ year in HR, People Operations, or an administrative role
  • Fluency in Ukrainian (spoken and written) and B1/B2 English or higher
  • Good judgement and discretion – you’ll handle sensitive information and people need to trust you with it.
  • Comfortable working independently across time zones and knowing when to escalate
  • Bonus: hands on experience with Rippling, Remote (EOR), Workday, Expensify, and Greenhouse.

We understand that circumstances in Ukraine can be unpredictable, and we’ll work with you on flexibility around outages and safety.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary including quarterly tax assistance (only for Ukraine tax residents)
  • Competitive time off plus company wellness days throughout the year
  • Team building events
  • Annual continued education benefit
  • Newbie Productivity Perk
  • Monthly stipend
  • Currently remote but may be hybrid when there is a physical office

At Tatari, we believe in the importance of cultivating teams with diverse backgrounds and offering equal opportunities to all. We strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and diversity is celebrated.

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
Functieomschrijving
Werk aan innovatieve data oplossingen met Azure, AI en Databricks in een hecht team bij ilionx te Zwolle. Technische diepgang, humor, kennissessies maar ook padel: hier bouw je én heb je plezier!

Jouw rol als Azure Data Engineer

Als Azure Data Engineer bij ilionx te Zwolle werk je aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van schaalbare, robuuste dataoplossingen in de Azure cloud. Je transformeert ruwe data naar waardevolle inzichten met moderne technologieën als Databricks, Microsoft Fabric en Snowflake. Daarbij ontwikkel je data pipelines met tools als PySpark, Python, DBT, SQL en Matillion en werk je aan het realiseren van data lakehouses en dataplatformen. Ook onderzoek je hoe innovatieve technologieën zoals generatieve AI van waarde kunnen zijn binnen onze data engineeringpraktijk.

Je draagt bij aan uiteenlopende projecten: van het migreren van on-premise omgevingen naar Azure tot het ontsluiten van bronsystemen in de zorg of het inrichten van AI-ready dataplatformen. Onze klanten bevinden zich onder andere in sectoren als zorg, overheid, finance, energie en onderwijs. Je werkt zelfstandig of in teamverband, afhankelijk van het project, en hebt veel invloed op de technische keuzes en de richting van je werk.

Naast klantopdrachten krijg je ook de kans om bij te dragen aan onze interne proposities, zoals het ilionx Dataplatform of ZorgControl. Binnen deze trajecten experimenteren we met nieuwe technieken en best practices, gericht op toekomstbestendige dataoplossingen.

Binnen ilionx bepaal je zelf hoe je je ontwikkelt: wil je je verdiepen in de keiharde techniek of doorgroeien richting architectuur? Of geef je liever je kennis door als interne trainer? Ook specialiseren in specifieke richtingen zoals Dataplatforms, Data Science of AI behoort tot de mogelijkheden. Jij kiest het pad, wij faciliteren het.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salarisrange tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- op 40 uur met bonus!

  • Een uitgebreide leaseregeling voor zowel auto als fiets

  • Een gevarieerd werkveld: extern, intern of een mix

  • Een flexibele werkomgeving en wij omarmen het hybride werken

  • Een flinke focus op de AI transitie, daar zijn wij volop mee bezig

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Een afgeronde HBO/WO diploma

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met BI en/of Data Engineering

  • Je ziet de kansen van AI en denkt vooruit

  • Kennis van en ervaring met: Python en Spark

  • Kennis van: Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake, Synapse

  • Kennis van dimensionaal datamodelleren en logical modelling

  • Kennis van de data architecture concepten Medallion en Mesh

  • Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vloeiend in woord en geschrift
    Deze eisen geven een richting aan het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren!

Het team

Het multidisciplinaire team in Zwolle kent een hechte en open sfeer met veel vrijheid! Binnen het team combineren we verschillende expertises zoals data engineering, platform engineering, data analytics en specifiek front-end. Er is een goede balans tussen junior, medior en senior collega's, wat zorgt voor een omgeving waar je kunt leren en jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen.

We werken veel samen op kantoor in Zwolle, wat zorgt voor korte lijnen en een sterke teamdynamiek. Onze cultuur is no-nonsense en gericht op samenwerking! Initiatief wordt gewaardeerd, en successen vieren we samen. Tussen het werk door spelen we fanatieke FIFA potjes op de PS5 of zoeken we elkaar op voor een padelwedstrijd. Zo bouwen we niet alleen aan data-oplossingen, maar ook aan een team dat voor elkaar klaarstaat.

Zoek jij een nieuwe plek voor de komende jaren en wil je impact maken binnen een team dat samen wil winnen? Dan kun je als dataspecialist perfect je plek vinden binnen ons Data & AI team te Zwolle!

Met ruim 10+ kantoren zijn wij landelijk vertegenwoordigd en op die manier kunnen wij regionaal vanuit verschillende vestigingen écht het verschil maken. Sluit jij je aan bij één van onze ilionx datateams in jouw regio?

Lees hier praktijkervaringen van jouw toekomstige ilionx data collega’s.

title: SFO og timer i indskolingen – gør en forskel i børns hverdag (genopslag)
description:
Brænder du for at skabe en tryg, legende og udviklende dag for børn i indskolingen? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi søger en pædagogisk uddannet medarbejder til en fast stilling i vores 0. årgang og SFO med start hurtigst muligt.

Om Bording Skole og SFO’en

Bording Skole er en arbejdsplads med tæt teamsamarbejde, høj faglighed og et stærkt fokus på fællesskaber, trivsel og udvikling. Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne dialog, tillid og ansvar, og vi ønsker at være et sted, hvor både børn og medarbejdere føler sig hjemme, set og anerkendt.

Et af vores kendetegn er et velfungerende samarbejde mellem lærere og pædagoger. I både skole og SFO arbejder vi i forpligtende teams, hvor vi deler viden, planlægger sammen og skaber fælles rammer for børnenes dag. Det betyder, at vi sammen løfter opgaven omkring trivsel, fællesskaber og sammenhæng mellem skole og fritid.

Vi skaber hver dag rammer for udvikling, relationer og leg, og vi lægger vægt på, at børnene møder voksne, der er nærværende, tydelige og engagerede – både i undervisningsdelen og i fritidsdelen.

På 0. årgang bliver dit arbejde sammen med teamet at være tæt på børnene i overgangen fra børnehave til skole og skabe trygge rammer, hvor relationer og trivsel er i centrum. Derudover understøttes legende læring, sociale færdigheder og gode klassefællesskaber gennem hverdagens aktiviteter.

I SFO’en arbejder vi målrettet med inklusion og deltagelsesfremme gennem Støtten. Her tilknyttes børn, der har brug for tættere voksenkontakt og/eller en mindre, overskuelig enhed. Vi arbejder ud fra en forståelse af, at deltagelse kan se ud på mange måder, og at børn kan have brug for forskellig støtte for at kunne være en del af fællesskabet. Det er et vigtigt pædagogisk arbejde, hvor vi hjælper børnene ind i fællesskaber på måder, der giver mening for dem.

Dine opgaver

I skole og SFO vil du blandt andet:

  • Skabe trygge og inkluderende fællesskaber for børn i indskolingen
  • Planlægge og gennemføre aktiviteter inden for fx leg, bevægelse, kreativitet eller udeliv
  • Understøtte børns trivsel og relationer i hverdagen
  • Bidrage til vores aftenklub for 5.–7. klasse i vinterhalvåret
  • Indgå i tæt samarbejde med kolleger i både skole og SFO
  • Deltage i teammøder og planlægning
Vi søger dig, der
  • er pædagogisk uddannet
  • har lyst til at arbejde med børns trivsel og udvikling
  • kan skabe struktur, nærvær og tydelighed
  • trives i et teamsamarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet
  • kan tage initiativ og byde ind med aktiviteter – gerne musik, udeliv eller værkstedsaktiviteter
  • har lyst til at arbejde med de ældste børn i aftenklubben
Vi tilbyder
  • En skole med engagerede og dygtige kolleger
  • Et stærkt og varmt fællesskab på tværs af funktioner
  • En hverdag med humor, fleksibilitet og faglighed
  • En arbejdsplads med åbenhed, dialog og tillid
  • Gode muligheder for at sætte dit præg på aktiviteter og miljø
Ansættelse

Stillingen er på 34 timer pr. uge med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Ønskes et lavere timetal går vi gerne i dialog om det.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst

title: Art Therapist - Part Time
description:
Mō mātou | About Hōhepa

When you join Hōhepa, you become part of our community of people, staff, volunteers, and contractors who all have a common goal - helping people to reach their full potential and lead enriched and meaningful lives in a holistic, supportive environment. We are a community leader providing services and support for people living with an intellectual disability to live their best lives and find a valued place in our society. Inspired by Dr Rudolf Steiner’s principles of anthroposophy, we seek to understand each person and situation as unique, not a one size fits all philosophy.

Mō te tūranga | About the Role

The Art Therapist provides therapeutic services using creative processes such as drawing, clay, collage, textiles or other forms of making to support the emotional, social and psychological wellbeing of people supported by Hōhepa Canterbury. The role works within a person-centred, trauma-informed, neuro-affirming and strengths-based framework to promote communication, participation, meaningful choice and self-expression.

You will be energetic, empathetic and able to work alongside individuals and groups to deliver therapy sessions that support emotional wellbeing, communication, participation and personal development.

The role involves assessing therapeutic needs, establishing meaningful goals and developing art therapy interventions that are responsive to individual communication styles, emotional needs, strengths and personal goals.

This position's salary scale is between $68,000 and $78,000 per annum (pro-rata)

Nga haora kua tohua | Hours will be

16 per week, working two full days to include Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday

Mō koe | About You

Your person-centred approach is what really matters at Hōhepa. You will have experience delivering art therapy services and a strong commitment to person-centered practice. Your enthusiasm and passion for helping others will make a real difference in people’s lives.

You will have experience with supporting individuals to safely express and process emotions, experiences, transitions, grief, trauma and significant life events through creative practice.

To thrive in this role you will:

  • Be self-motivated, energetic and flexible with a high level of initiative.

  • Hold a relevant art therapy qualification and have experience delivering art therapy services.

  • Be able to build effective therapeutic relationships.

  • Collaborate with colleagues within the Practice Team.

  • Have a kind nature with a can-do attitude and willingness to learn and continue to develop your skills.

  • Have a commitment to upholding the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi in all aspects of the role.

Nga hua o te mahi ki a Hōhepa | Benefits of working at Hōhepa

At Hōhepa, as part of our team you will:

  • Work in a fun, friendly and supportive team environment.

  • Have the opportunity to achieve long service leave.

  • Be able to access Christchurch City Council Gym and Pool Membership discounts and Untamed Organic Vegetable discount.

  • Have access to our online wellbeing platform.

  • Join us to celebrate festivals, events and successes.

Applicants will be progressed as they apply, so if this sounds like you, please apply now!

Applicants must have a NZ full driver’s licence and ability to work in New Zealand.

Please note that the 90-day trial period will apply to any successful applicant who hasn’t previously worked for Hōhepa Canterbury

Be a part of Limit Break's extraordinary journey, where your creativity and passion will know no limits.

About the Role:

Unleash your potential at Limit Break as we seek an exceptional Unity Engineer to spearhead an exciting new venture! We are embarking on a groundbreaking journey to develop a cutting-edge, mid-core, 3D mobile game from concept to reality.

At the outset, you'll collaborate closely with a small yet dynamic team to craft and refine the game's prototype, ensuring alignment with executive stakeholders. As the project gains momentum, you'll take charge of scaling the team from pre-production to full production, collaborating with leads and directors across various disciplines.

This role offers an inquisitive and driven individual a rare chance to shape the workflow and assemble a top-notch team for an ambitious gaming project. Join a passionate and experienced organization where bright minds thrive, and your dedication to gaming excellence will be celebrated.

You will have the opportunity to play an active role as a core member from the beginning of the team. Leave your mark on the gaming world and be part of an engaging, forward-looking team!

Responsibilities: What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, and maintain robust gameplay systems in Unity (C#)
  • Collaborate with designers and artists to bring features to life
  • Design and implement modular, data-driven systems in Unity that can respond to live configuration and content changes.
  • Interface with our backend team to ensure smooth client-server communication
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and help mentor junior developers
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to performance, crashes, and build size using Unity’s profiling and debugging tools
  • Take full ownership of features—seeing them through from concept to polish—and make them the best they can be

Qualifications: Who you are and what you’ve done

  • 8+ years of professional experience in game development, 5+ years working in Unity.
  • Strong Unity and C# skills, with a deep understanding of the engine lifecycle.
  • Has shipped one or more live service games targeting mobile with Unity.
  • Confidently work within a large, established Unity codebase, refactoring and extending existing systems with minimal disruption.
  • A proactive mindset and pride in taking ownership of features from start to finish.
  • Strong understanding of Unity’s architecture, including best practices for MonoBehaviours, ScriptableObjects, Prefabs and Addressables.
  • Can work autonomously, but communicate clearly, and collaborate with other engineers, designers and artists.

Nice to have. What an ideal candidate looks like

  • Bilingual preferred in English and Japanese.
  • Knowledge of backend tech including GoLang, Redis, SQL, and Docker.

As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

As a Manufacturing Supervisor, you will be at the helm of our production operations, ensuring that our manufacturing processes run smoothly and efficiently. You will oversee a team of dedicated production workers, manage production schedules, and maintain high-quality standards. Your leadership will be key in driving productivity, ensuring safety, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the facility.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

Supervision and Leadership:

  • Lead, manage, and supervise a team of production workers from Leads to general labor.
  • Assign tasks and monitor the daily activities of the production team.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback to employees.

Production Management:

  • Ensure sub-department production schedules and targets are met.
  • Monitor sub-departments production processes and adjust schedules as needed to meet demand.
  • Coordinate with other sub-departments to ensure smooth workflow and efficient production.

Quality Control:

  • Implement and enforce quality control standards and procedures for responsible sub-department.
  • Inspect products to ensure they meet quality specifications for responsible sub-department.
  • Identify and resolve production and quality issues within the time frame of job schedule for responsible sub-department.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Enforce safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment for responsible sub-department.
  • Conduct regular safety inspections and coordinate training sessions for responsible sub-department.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company standards for responsible sub-department.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify areas for improvement in sub-department production process.
  • Implement and execute lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Implement and execute cost reduction and efficiency improvement projects.

Reporting and Documentation:

  • Maintain accurate and updated records of sub-department production activities and initiatives, including output, quality, inventory levels, implementations, etc. of responsible sub-department.
  • Prepare and submit sub-department operations reports to management.

Resource Management:

  • Manage the allocation of sub-department use of materials, machinery, and workforce to optimize production efficiency.

Training and Development:

  • Identify training needs and provide ongoing training and development opportunities for sub-department production staff.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Inform the direct manager of any planed or unplanned leave presented during the work scheduled.
  • Maintain open and constant communication about all sub-department matters with the direct manager.

Equipment Maintenance:

  • Oversee routine maintenance and repair of production equipment to ensure optimal performance.
  • Coordinate with the maintenance team to schedule and manage equipment downtime.

Performance Metrics:

  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve production performance for responsible sub-department.
  • Use performance data to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement initiatives for responsible sub-department.

Conflict Resolution:

  • Address and resolve conflicts or issues among production staff promptly and effectively.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

High School Diploma or Equivalent:

  • A foundational requirement, demonstrating basic education and readiness for further training and development.

Associate’s Degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, or Related Field:

  • Provides specialized knowledge in manufacturing processes, quality control, and technical skills.

Skills/Experience:

  • Previous Supervisory or Leadership Experience: Preferably 1-2 years, showing capability in managing teams, handling conflict resolution, and providing guidance and mentorship.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing Principles: Practical experience in implementing lean methods, 5S, Kaizen, and other continuous improvement techniques.
  • Understanding of Quality Control Procedures: Experience in maintaining quality standards, conducting inspections, and addressing quality issues.
  • Familiarity with Safety Standards and Regulations: Hands-on experience in enforcing safety protocols, conducting safety audits, and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory bodies.
  • Project Management Experience: Leading or participating in projects aimed at process improvement, new product introduction, or equipment upgrades.\
  • Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Proven track record of identifying issues, analyzing data, and implementing effective solutions.
  • Excellent Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Ability to effectively communicate with team members, management, and other departments.
  • Experience with Performance Metrics and Reporting: Developing, tracking, and analyzing KPIs to measure production performance and drive improvements.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with manufacturing equipment, understanding of mechanical and electrical systems, and ability to troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Team Building and Training Experience: Skills in building cohesive teams, providing training, and fostering a collaborative work environment.

Physical Demands

Specific eyesight requirements:

  • Ability to distinguish between colors.
  • Visual acuity to read fine print on documents and screens.
  • Depth perception to operate machinery safely.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Standing and Walking:

  • Prolonged periods of standing and walking throughout the manufacturing facility.
  • Frequent movement within the production area to supervise and assist team members.

Lifting and Carrying:

  • Ability to lift and carry materials and equipment weighing up to 35 pounds.
  • Occasional lifting of heavier items with the assistance of equipment or team members.

Bending, Stooping, and Kneeling:

  • Regular bending, stooping, and kneeling to inspect machinery, perform maintenance tasks, and handle materials.

title: Communications Lead (Maternity Cover)

As our new Communications Lead, your decisions and drive will be essential for keeping our high momentum going, and for upgrading the European energy grid.

The role

As Communications Lead, you will make sure that Hybrid Greentech utilises a clear external voice through our brand and press presence, and that our brand remains recognised and synonymous with the pioneering innovation that can help us attract new talent.

The role covers the full communications palette of functions, and you must be comfortable with assuming the responsibility of owning the external and internal communications, and employer branding activities as a one-person function. You will however work in close collaboration with the CEO, CFO and the management team, as well as our external partners and investors.   • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for key internal and external stakeholders – including the CEO, commercial leadership, and investors – to keep materials and messaging aligned.

Experience and skills (required)

What we offer

  • Direct collaboration with our CEO and leadership team, and exposure to investors and external partners.
  • A collaborative environment with high degrees of trust and strong cross-functional execution.
  • Competitive compensation for the contract period.
  • The opportunity to work with a fast-growing energy technology company that is shaping the future of renewable energy systems and driving the green transition of Northern Europe.

Ready to keep our story moving?

If you're excited about stepping into a high-powered, highly autonomous communications maternity cover role at a rapidly scaling greentech company, we would love to hear from you.

Contract

About Hybrid Greentech

Hybrid Greentech helps Battery Energy Storage Systems and flexible assets perform across their full lifecycle, from project readiness to real-time multi-market trading. As a vertically integrated VPP, BRP and energy retailer we combine analytics, EPC management, asset integration and automated trading to turn flexibility into reliable value for asset owners. Our international team of +40 professionals is based in Høje Taastrup, Denmark, from where we are building the technology that makes renewable energy ready for the future of the European grid.

title: Supply Chain Engineer, Mechanical
description:
Who We Are

GITAI is a vertically integrated space and defense company building the next generation of hardware for low-Earth-orbit missions.

At our core is the space robotics technology that has defined GITAI from the beginning. A small, highly capable engineering team applies that foundation across satellite buses, in-orbit servicing robotics, and mission hardware for applications such as Earth observation. Today, a major focus of our work is supporting U.S. national security missions, particularly through proliferated LEO satellite constellations and other next-generation space systems.

We design, build, integrate, and test much of our hardware in-house. Electrical, mechanical, software, manufacturing, integration, and test teams work closely together, allowing a small team to own complete systems rather than isolated components. This vertical integration helps us move quickly, learn directly from hardware, and shorten the path from architecture to a working system.

We are still early. The systems, the company, and the market are all being built at the same time. Requirements change, technical problems are often ambiguous, and many answers do not yet exist. We are looking for exceptional engineers and operators who want broad ownership, can work across disciplines, and are willing to stay close to the hardware until the mission succeeds.

Your Mission

As a Supply Chain Engineer, Mechanical at GITAI, you will own the manufacturing and supplier path for mechanical parts, assemblies, and subsystems. You will work directly with mechanical engineers, understand the intent behind their designs, and determine the fastest practical way to manufacture and test the hardware. That may involve an existing supplier, a new machine shop or specialized vendor, a different manufacturing process, or work performed internally at GITAI. You should be able to review a drawing, understand the critical features and manufacturing challenges, and quickly recommend a path forward. Your work should allow GITAI to run more design, build, test, and redesign cycles in less time.

What You’ll Drive

  • Own sourcing and supplier execution for mechanical parts, assemblies, and subsystems from engineering release through manufacturing, testing, and delivery.
  • Work directly with mechanical engineers to understand drawings, GD&T, materials, tolerances, design intent, and test requirements.
  • Select the right manufacturing and test path, including existing suppliers, new suppliers, and internal GITAI capabilities.
  • Find and qualify suppliers for machining, sheet metal, fabrication, additive manufacturing, special processes, mechanical assemblies, and specialized testing.
  • Own RFQs, quote evaluation, supplier selection, pricing and lead-time negotiation, and purchase execution.
  • Evaluate manufacturability, supplier capability, cost, lead time, and iteration speed, and recommend changes when a different approach will move hardware faster.
  • Drive suppliers through delivery, resolving schedule, quality, and manufacturing issues directly when they arise.
  • Build a supplier network that supports rapid engineering iteration and continuously improve how GITAI gets mechanical hardware made and tested.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a closely related engineering field.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, technical sourcing, supplier development, or supply chain for physical hardware.
  • At least 1 year of full-time experience as an internal employee at a VC-backed hardware startup while the company was at Seed, Series A, or Series B stage.
  • Strong ability to read mechanical drawings and understand GD&T, materials, tolerances, manufacturing processes, and mechanical design intent.
  • Experience working directly with suppliers on complex mechanical parts, assemblies, or subsystems from RFQ through delivery.
  • Ability to assess a supplier’s technical capability and make practical decisions across manufacturability, quality, lead time, cost, and engineering iteration speed.
  • Strong supplier negotiation skills and the ability to develop new supplier relationships without relying on the purchasing leverage of a large company.
  • Strong engineering judgment and willingness to use new suppliers, processes, tools, or internal capabilities when they provide a better path.
  • U.S. citizenship is required due to the nature of GITAI’s work with U.S. government customers and programs.

Location & Employment Details

  • Location: Torrance, CA, onsite. Occasional travel to supplier and test sites is expected based on program needs.
  • Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt
  • Typical Work Hours: Monday to Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM onsite. Flexibility is expected based on mission schedules and program needs.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $125,000–$165,000 per year
  • Final compensation will be determined based on experience, technical depth, supplier capability, and role fit.
  • This position is also eligible for equity.

Benefits

  • Health Insurance – Platinum medical plan with 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees; 90% for dependents
  • 401(k) Plan – Company match up to 3.5%, with traditional and Roth options
  • Equity – Stock option eligibility depending on role
  • Relocation Support – Available for qualifying positions
  • Time Off – 12 paid holidays per year, 12 days of paid vacation per year, and paid sick leave (in accordance with applicable law)
  • Office Perks – Free snacks and drinks, plus regular team events

GITAI does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing or recruiting agencies. We work only with recruiting partners that have been specifically engaged by GITAI. No fees will be paid for resumes submitted without a prior agreement.

Compensation may include base salary or hourly pay and, depending on the position, equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skillset, and other job-related factors.

LA salary range
$125,000—$165,000 USD

Important Notice

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
  • To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), GITAI Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable.

Employment with GITAI USA is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Port Agent – Cruise & Port Agency
description:
Can you keep an overview in a busy operational environment, bring structure to your tasks and make the right priorities when plans change? Do you enjoy working with people, taking responsibility and finding solutions?

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. As a Port Agent, you will become part of our 24/7 duty setup, acting as the link between our customers, vessels, ports, authorities, suppliers and other stakeholders. Flexibility is important part of the position, and it requires working outside normal office hours in connection with vessel operations, including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends.

About the role

As part of the team, you will be involved in planning, coordinating and following vessel calls from the initial preparations until the vessel has departed again. The role combines office-based planning and administration with hands-on operational work at vessels and terminals. You will work with a broad variety of vessels, including cruise ships, cargo vessels and navy vessels calling at Danish ports. The role is primarily based in Greve, but occasional work in Copenhagen is required, as Copenhagen is a major part of the daily operation.

Following your training and as your experience develops, you will take responsibility for coordinating your own vessel calls and daily operations, always with experienced colleagues and managers available for support and sparring. You will act as the customer’s local representative and help ensure that each port call is handled safely, professionally and according to the agreed operational plan.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Coordination and handling of vessel port calls
  • Planning and coordination of daily port operations
  • Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers
  • Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required
  • Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation
  • Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services
  • Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements
  • Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up
  • Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change
  • Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

Who are you

Previous experience in ship agency, shipping or a similar operational role is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership and follows tasks through
  • Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable
  • Remains calm and structured under pressure
  • Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders
  • Works well both independently and as part of a team
  • Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment
  • Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

What we offer

At Blue Water Shipping, you will become part of an informal working environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on cooperation, responsibility and professional development.

You will have the opportunity to learn the port agency profession through hands-on experience and daily sparring with colleagues and managers.

We offer:

  • A varied working day with responsibility and operational challenges
  • Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries
  • Training and continuous professional development
  • The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers
  • Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping
  • Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals
  • A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

Contact

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

What we do – Together we create solutions

We are a proud family-owned company, founded in Denmark in 1972, and a global provider of all logistics services within modern supply chain management. Our value foundation is still thriving today, driven by a pronounced entrepreneurial spirit and sound business practices. Therefore, our employees are offered a strong professional environment with great freedom, ensuring our customers the best service. Blue Water Shipping is represented by more than 2,700 employees worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise, enabling us to offer complete and tailored solutions for any shipping need anywhere in the world.

description:

  1. Support the mission, vision, and values of the organization.
  2. Position imaging equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance, according to specification of examination.
  3. Position patient on examining table and set up and adjust equipment to obtain optimum view of specific body area as requested by physician.
  4. Evaluates patient information for potential risk factors related to contrast administration.
  5. Monitor patients' conditions and reactions, reporting abnormal signs to physician.
  6. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure safety and comfort during scan.
  7. Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to comply with government regulations and to ensure safety of patients and staff.

  9. Determine patients' x-ray needs by reading requests or instructions from physicians.
  10. Prepare contrast material, radiopharmaceuticals, or anesthetic or antispasmodic drugs under the direction of a radiologist.
  11. Process exposed radiographs using film processors or computer-generated methods as needed
  12. Operate mobile x-ray equipment in operating room, or at patient's bedside as needed.
  13. Make exposures necessary for the requested procedures, rejecting and repeating work that does not meet established standards.
  14. Operate or oversee operation of radiologic imaging equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes.
  15. Operate digital picture archiving communications systems.
  16. Perform procedures, such as routine contrast studies, routine fluoroscopy, or examinations of the head, trunk, or extremities under supervision of physician.
  17. Provide assistance to physicians or other technologists in the performance of more complex procedures.
  18. Record, process, and maintain patient data or treatment records and prepare reports.
  19. Take thorough and accurate patient medical histories as needed.
  20. Key commands and data into computer to document and specify scan sequences, adjust transmitters and receivers, or photograph certain images.

  22. Participate in the setup of operating or procedure rooms to ensure all necessary equipment is ready.
  23. Assist with on-the-job training of new employees or students or provide input to supervisors regarding training performance.
  24. Maintain a current file of examination protocols, following current standards and State regulations.

  26. Coordinate work with operating room personnel for surgical and/or interventional procedures.
  27. Comply with organizational policies, regulatory and accreditation standards, and professional guidelines.
  28. Exhibit professional interpersonal and communication skills.
  29. Assist with improving the quality of sterile processing services.
  30. Assist with identifying pertinent evidence to establish benchmarks as directed.
  31. Maintain privacy and confidentiality of individuals and health information.
