title: Control Room Operator
description:
Job Summary

The Control Room Engineer/Operator is responsible for the operation and control of the PV farm system (i.e., PV Modules, DC Combiner Boxes, Inverter Station, Weather Stations) and its auxiliaries, including all Low, Medium, and High Voltage Systems and associated transmission lines through the Supervision, Control and Data Acquisition System (SCADA) to ensure continuous, safe, reliable, and efficient power generation of the Solar Power Plant.

Key Accountabilities

1. Plant Operation

  • Takes charge of the start-up, synchronization, and shutdown of the solar power plant and its respective auxiliaries.
  • Ensures normal plant operation, including load variations.
  • Records, monitors, and evaluates operating system parameters such as irradiance/solar resource, temperature, wind speeds, energy dispatch levels, and load curves.
  • Initiates necessary recommendations to the Shift Charge Engineer for optimum performance to prevent breakdowns.
  • Monitors and interprets SCADA alarm indications of equipment malfunction and coordinates with the Shift Charge Engineer and Operation Ground Engineer for alarm rectification.
  • Operates the control system of the High Voltage plant substation equipment and HV/MV/LV switch gears during normal operations, maintenance activities, and abnormal/emergency situations.
  • Troubleshoots abnormalities during shifts and initiates remedial measures to prevent unnecessary downtime.
  • Coordinates closely with utility companies (e.g., DELTA for Meralco and/or its Systems Control Center and Systems Operations Area/Regional Control Centers for NGCP) and ensures all communications are properly recorded and logged.
  • Complies with all dispatch instructions from utilities (Meralco or NGCP) during emergency conditions in coordination with the Plant Manager and Operations Head.
  • Works closely with the Forecasting Team and Trading Team for the Electricity Market (IEMOP/WESM).

2. Regulatory Compliance

  • Coordinates with plant dispatch to regulate line voltage, frequency, load, and other power quality requirements in accordance with the Philippine Grid Code and Philippine Distribution Code.
  • Ensures dispatch levels of power and reactive power are within regulatory and contractual limits (Power Supply Agreement with Meralco) at all times.

3. Environmental, Safety and Health Compliance

  • Complies with and implements Environmental, Safety, and Health policies and procedures.

4. Other Duties

  • Performs other related duties as assigned or required


Requirements

Requirements

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communications Engineering.
  2. At least two (2) years of related experience in the energy industry, preferably in the design or construction of a power plant.
  3. Ability to understand electrical drawings and schematics.

title: Senior Space Designer
description:
The core of the Fritz Hansen vision is Extraordinary Design Improving Life – for people & planet. Fritz Hansen has shaped the Danish and Nordic design tradition for more than 150 years

At Fritz Hansen, the integration of our furniture into thoughtfully curated spaces is a defining element of the brand experience. As a senior space designer, you will bring the Fritz Hansen DNA to life through inspiring and relevant environments ac ross our global markets.

You will join our specialised Space Design team and work across showrooms, branded retail spaces, fairs & events and contract projects, collaborating with colleagues across Design, Marketing and Sales as well as external partners.

The role

You will be responsible for spatial design projects from concept through visualisation to implementation. Combining a strong spatial understanding with an eye for materials, finishes, lighting, and furniture composition, you will create environments that communicate the Fritz Hansen identity while supporting commercial objectives, enhancing customer engagement, and driving business impact.

As part of your role, you will use 3D visualization to bring ideas and concepts to life, creating and compelling communication for colleagues, customers and partners.

Key responsibilities

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of how Fritz Hansen presents its products and brand across a variety of physical environments and touchpoints
  • Translate concepts, narratives and commercial briefs into compelling 3D environments and visualisations that balance design ambition with executional feasibility and budget considerations.
  • Develop floorplans, moodboards, material palettes, and spatial concepts for residential, commercial, hospitality, and other brand-related activities.
  • Develop interior solutions for showrooms and branded retail partners, ensuring they are aligned with the Fritz Hansen brand DNA.
  • Develop and maintain the Fritz Hansen Retail Store Concept, ensuring that it continuously reflects the brand, collection and commercial needs.
  • Work with materials, finishes, colours and lighting to create coherent and elevated spatial experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with global and local stakeholders, external designers, suppliers, and implementation partners throughout the design and execution process.
  • Play an active role in the launch of new products by developing spatial storytelling and presentation principles that showcase product features, craftsmanship, and commercial relevance.
  • Work closely with design, heritage, marketing, sales, and regional teams to execute product launches into engaging spatial concepts and customer experiences.
  • Ensure design concepts can be successfully implemented across markets by balancing creative excellence, operational practicality, and investment considerations.
  • Bring new perspectives, ideas and inspiration to the team and contribute to the continuous development of our design methodologies, tools, and ways of working.

What you bring

You are an experienced interior or space designer with a strong understanding of how spatial design can communicate a brand and create a compelling customer experience.

You have a strong aesthetic sense and an eye for detail, while also understanding the practical and commercial aspects of delivering projects. You are comfortable moving between the conceptual and the technical — from developing an initial idea and selecting materials to creating detailed drawings and 3D visualisations.

You are confident taking ownership of projects and driving them forward, while working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation.

You are curious, structured and solution-oriented, and you enjoy working in an environment where design, craftsmanship, commercial thinking and brand identity come together.

You are curious about new technologies and AI, and interested in exploring how they can support and develop the design process.

Skills & experience

  • Several years of experience within interior design, space design, retail design or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of materials, finishes and lighting.
  • Experience with spatial planning, floorplans and technical drawings.
  • Ability to communicate concepts through 3D, drawings, moodboards and presentations.
  • Experience within furniture, design, architecture or retail is an advantage.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • English is a must, Danish is a benefit

Software

Design: Rhino – essential. Revit – an advantage.

Rendering & visualisation: Enscape and KeyShot is essential

Graphic design: Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop

About Fritz Hansen

Fritz Hansen is an internationally recognised Danish design brand with a long-standing heritage in furniture and spatial design. We work with some of the most iconic designs in modern furniture and continue to evolve how the brand is experienced across the world.

In Space Design, you will join a small and specialized team with a broad scope and the opportunity to influence how Fritz Hansen is experienced physically across global markets.

If you are passionate about creating spaces with a strong sense of identity, quality and purpose, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV and portfolio.

Location: Fritz Hansen HQ, Alleroed, Denmark

Department: Space Design, Design & Heritage team

Employment: Full-time

Application deadline: October 1st, 2026

For questions regarding the position, please contact people@fritzhansen.com.

Fritz Hansen has crafted extraordinary design since 1872 and stewards many of the world's most recognised furniture designs. Today we embody a modern, conscious, Nordic lifestyle manufacturing premium furniture, lighting and accessories made in collaboration with leading artists, designers, and architects from around the world. The brand has collaborated with Arne Jacobsen, Cecilie Manz, Hans J. Wegner, Piero Lissoni, and Poul Kjærholm, among others. By collaborating with partners and suppliers who share our values, we combine our expertise with specialist knowledge to bring about positive change. Our mission is to create visionary, long-lasting designs that elevate the everyday.

Today Fritz Hansen designs are sold in more than 85 countries through 2,000 points of sale, including flagship stores in Copenhagen and Tokyo. The company employs almost 220 people worldwide and maintains its headquarters north of Copenhagen, serving design-passionate customers through contract and retail.

title: Multidisciplinary Designer, Graphic & Motion
description:
Title: Multidisciplinary Designer, Graphic & Motion
Department: Creative
Reports To: Art Director
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Position Summary:

The Multidisciplinary Designer creates compelling visual work across campaigns, social media, digital platforms, print, merchandise, and in-arena experiences. This is a graphic-design-led role for a versatile designer with strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, and visual storytelling, as well as the ability to bring ideas to life through animation and motion design.

The ideal candidate can translate creative direction into polished, cohesive executions across a variety of formats and extend static design systems into motion. Motion design is an important component of this position but is not its sole focus.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop creative concepts and visual assets for marketing campaigns, social media, digital platforms, print materials, merchandise, and in-arena experiences.

  • Translate creative direction and established brand systems into polished, cohesive designs across multiple platforms and formats.

  • Extend static concepts and campaign systems into engaging motion graphics and animated content.

  • Animate typography, graphic elements, transitions, and campaign assets for social, digital, and in-arena use.

  • Design for a variety of formats, aspect ratios, resolutions, and display environments, including venue screens and ribbon boards.

  • Collaborate with creative, marketing, content, social media, partnership, and other internal teams to support organizational priorities.

  • Prepare production-ready files and final assets for digital, print, merchandise, environmental, and live-event applications.

  • Manage multiple projects and shifting priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  • Maintain organized project files, version control, and consistent asset-delivery practices.

  • Stay current on trends and emerging practices across design, motion, sports, entertainment, and culture.

Qualifications:

  • Two to four years of professional design experience.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in graphic design, typography, layout, composition, color, and visual storytelling.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate creative direction into polished, cohesive executions across multiple platforms.

  • Experience designing for social media, digital, print, merchandise, environmental, or experiential applications.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

  • Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, with portfolio examples demonstrating animation and motion-design capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of motion principles, including timing, pacing, easing, hierarchy, and visual rhythm.

  • Ability to thoughtfully extend static designs into motion.

  • Strong production skills, including file organization, versioning, image preparation, and final asset delivery.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and attention to detail.

  • Interest in sports, entertainment, culture, and contemporary design.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in sports, entertainment, lifestyle, agency, or another consumer-facing environment.

  • Experience designing for large-format displays, venue screens, ribbon boards, or live-event environments.

  • Experience creating reusable design and motion templates for editors, producers, or social media teams.

  • Experience designing for merchandise, apparel, or environmental applications.

  • Familiarity with print production, large-format graphics, and final asset preparation.

  • Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro and basic video-editing workflows.

Compensation & Total Rewards:

We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Base Salary Range: $50,000–$60,000

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents

  • 401(k) with company matching contributions

  • Paid Time Off, plus 11 paid holidays, and Summer Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Company-paid life insurance and long-term disability coverage

  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources

  • Sacramento Kings home game tickets, concert access, Team Store discounts, parking, and other exclusive team member perks!

title: Lager- og produktionsmedarbejder - Falck Teknik
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre, at vores brand- og sikkerhedsmateriel altid er klar til brug? Kan du arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og samtidig være en stærk del af et team? Og er du serviceminded, handlekraftig og glad for en hverdag med stor variation? Så bliv en del af Falck Teknik og bring omsorg ind i din karriere!

Om rollen

For at sikre en effektiv og høj kvalitetsdrift i vores lager- og produktionsfunktion, søger vi en kollega til vores team i Falck Teknik i Greve.

Vi er et team, der hver dag arbejder sammen om at modtage, klargøre, renovere og håndtere brand- og sikkerhedsmateriel, så vi kan levere høj kvalitet til vores kunder og kolleger. Vi producerer bl.a. ildslukkere til militær, forsvar og olieplatforme.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Varemodtagelse
  • Klargøring af produkter, herunder f.eks. ”falckificering” af hjertestartere
  • Renovering og opladning af ildslukkere
  • Ordrehåndtering via Business Central og øvrige IT-systemer

Om dig

Din faglige og personlige udvikling er vigtig for os. Hos Falck får du mulighed for at udvikle og styrke dine kompetencer gennem spændende opgaver, oplæring og en hverdag, hvor der er en god blanding af produktion og klargøring. Vi forventer, at du er serviceminded, handlekraftig og har en kompetent tilgang til dit arbejde. Du forstår vigtigheden af service og kvalitet.

Du har muligvis ikke erfaring med alle aspekter af rollen endnu, men for at give dig de bedste forudsætninger for succes, forestiller vi oss, at du allerede har:

  • En praktisk baggrund fra lager, produktion, værksted eller butik
  • Erfaring med IT og Office-pakken
  • Truckkort og gyldigt kørekort (3.500 kg)
  • Ren straffeattest
  • Gode danskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Det er vigtigt for os, at du i enhver situation optræder professionelt og løsningsorienteret. Vi værdsætter kolleger, der bidrager med konstruktive forslag til forbedringer.

Sammen gør vi en forskel

Hos Falck er alt, vi gør, med til at hjælpe mennesker med at leve et tryggere og sundere liv. Derfor sætter en karriere hos os aftryk i flere liv end dit eget. Uanset om du udvikler eller leverer sundhedsløsninger – eller støtter dem, der gør netop det – får du mulighed for en karriere i en førende sundhedsvirksomhed. Du bliver en del af en global virksomhed med mere end 25.000 kolleger, der sætter omsorg og engagement i centrum for alt, hvad de gør.

Falck Teknik er en del af Falck Danmark og er landets største leverandør af brandudstyr, brandslukkere, brandmateriel, førstehjælpsudstyr og sikkerhedsudstyr. Vi har stærke værdier, gode arbejdsforhold og en kultur, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvar går hånd i hånd.

Har du spørgsmål?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller til, hvad vi kan tilbyde, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef, Bo Kurt Nielsen på bokn@falck.dk eller mobil +45 2168 3798.

Du kan også besøge www.falck.com/careers for at lære mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos Falck, og møde nogle af de mennesker, der hver dag omsætter omsorg til handling.

Før du søger

Du skal kun vedhæfte dit CV og motivation for rollen – der er ikke behov for foto. Til samtalen får du mulighed for at fortælle mere om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Falck. Vi beder ikke om billeder, fordi vi mener, at det første indtryk bedst skabes ansigt til ansigt.

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende, og opslaget tages ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Derfor anbefaler vi, at du sender din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Da vores dygtige kollega går på pension ved udgangen af november, søger vi en ny kollega, der kan tiltræde d. 1. december 2026. Du vil modtage den nødvendige oplæring og arbejdsbeklædning. Der er obligatorisk pensionsordning, personaleforening og gruppelivsforsikring. Du vil blive aflønnet i henhold til gældende 3F-overenskomst.

En kultur, hvor vi passer på mennesker – og hinanden

Omsorg er kernen i alt, hvad vi gør. Vi tager os af de mennesker, vi hjælper – og af hinanden. Med kolleger fra mange forskellige lande, der hver bringer unikke kompetencer, bliver du en del af et professionelt fællesskab bygget på tillid og tæt samarbejde. Vi ser forskellighed som en styrke, fordi det gør os bedre til at forstå og hjælpe de mennesker, vi arbejder for. Du får ledere, der støtter og inspirerer dig, og som arbejder for at skabe et miljø, hvor åbenhed, ærlighed og gensidig respekt er i centrum, og hvor dine bidrag bliver værdsat – uanset hvem du er, og hvor du kommer fra.

title: Technician - Surgical III
description:
Overview

JOB SUMMARY: A clinically competent certified surgical technologist who works under the supervision of the registered nurse in delivering safe and effective care to the patient during the intraoperative period, interacts with patients and health care team members while mainlining the surgical department standards, scrubs all specialties including open heart and spine/neuro with appropriate handling of instruments and equipment for the surgeons.

Responsibilities

Clinical & Surgical Performance

  • Advanced Surgical Scrubbing: Performs scrubbing duties for complex surgical procedures, including open-heart and spine/neuro cases, in strict compliance with departmental policies.
  • Aseptic Technique: Applies advanced principles of aseptic technique appropriately during all surgical interventions and sterile field setup.
  • Surgical Counts: Accurately performs all sponge, needle, and sharps counts at appropriate pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative intervals according to departmental standards.
  • Instrumentation & Equipment: Demonstrates proper utilization of surgical instruments, equipment, suturing, and stapling devices. Prepares instrumentation aligned with physician Physician Preference Cards (PPCs) and scheduled procedures.
  • Medication & Specimen Handling: Labels all medications and solutions on the sterile field. Properly identifies, saves, and hands off specimens to the circulating nurse with clear verbal verification of source and name.

Patient Care Support & Pre-Operative Preparation

  • Care Planning & Information Gathering: Assists circulating RNs in obtaining nursing care information and developing comprehensive patient care plans.
  • Patient Preparation: Assumes responsibility for completing patient preparation for surgical interventions and special procedures, identifying behavioral changes or patient care concerns promptly.
  • Anesthesia & Closure Support: Provides instrumentation and equipment prior to anesthesia induction; assists during procedure closure by offering timely status updates and instrument assessments.

Operational Efficiency, Leadership & Administration

  • Staff Training & Mentorship: Trains and mentors new scrub staff to a competent performance level.
  • Preference Card Management: Evaluates, updates, and documents physician preference cards regarding sutures, equipment, and special requests in a timely manner.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Provides accurate information for O.R. Nursing Records and signs documentation promptly. Adheres to Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) standards and chain-of-command reporting protocols.

Call Coverage & Worksite Maintenance: Participates in call rotations with a 30-minute response time; maintains clean, orderly operating rooms; regularly attends departmental in-service meetings.

Qualifications

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING

  • High school graduate.
  • Surgical Technology School graduate.
  • Must have a current BCLS.
  • Must have a National Surgical Technologist Certificate.
